verses.text: Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu, mu kwezi kwawo kwa kane, no ku musi wakwo wa gatanu, igihe nari nkiri mu bajanywe ari inyagano hafi y’uruzi Kebari i Babiloni, amajuru yarugurutse, maze mbona ivyo Imana inyeretse.
Ivyo vyabaye ku musi ugira gatanu w’ukwo kwezi, hari mu mwaka ugira gatanu umwami Yehoyakimu ari mu kinyago.
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri Ezekiyeli umuherezi, mwene Buzi, ari hafi y’uruzi Kebari, mu gihugu c’Abanyababiloni. Ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kwari kuri we.

Ngize gutya mbona umuyaga w’igihuhusi uje uturutse mu buraruko, mbona n’igicu kinini cane kivamwo imiravyo, gikikujwe n’umuco mwinshi. Hagati muri uwo muriro hasa n’icuma gica ibibatsi kubera umuriro,
kandi muri uwo muriro habonekamwo ibinyabuzima bine. Vyaboneka bifise imero nk’iy’umuntu,
ariko kimwe cose cari gifise mu maso hane n’amababa ane.
Amaguru yavyo yari agororotse, ibirenge vyavyo vyari bimeze nk’ivy’inyana, bigakayangana nk’umwakaka uhinguwe neza.
Musi ya ya mababa yavyo ku mpande zine zose, vyari bifise amaboko nk’ay’umuntu. Vyose uko ari bine vyari bifise mu maso hane n’amababa ane kimwe cose cisangije.
Amababa ya kimwe cose yakora ku mababa y’ikindi. Kimwe cose mu kugenda caguma kija imbere, mu kugenda ntivyahindukira.

Mu maso havyo hari hameze uku: kimwe cose muri ivyo bine, cari gifise mu maso hasa n’ah’umuntu, kandi ku ruhande rw’i buryo kimwe cose cari gifise mu maso nk’ah’intare, ku ruhande rw’i bubamfu kikagira mu maso nk’ah’impfizi; ku rw’inyuma vyose vyari bifise mu maso nk’ah’inkona.

Uko ni ko mu maso havyo hari hameze. Kimwe cose cari gifise amababa abiri ashanje aja hejuru kandi ibaba ryose ryakora kw’ibaba ry’ikindi ku mpande zose, kikongera kikagira ayandi abiri apfuka umubiri waco.
Kimwe cose cagenda gitumbereye imbere yaco. Aho hose impwemu ishatse kuja, vyaca bijayo bitarinze guhindukira.
Ivyo binyabuzima vyari bifise ishusho nk’iy’amakara yaka, canke na ho bigasa n’ibimuri. Uwo muriro waja imbere n’inyuma hagati muri vyo warabonesha cane, kandi wavamwo imiravyo.
Ivyo binyabuzima vyaragendagenda imbere n’inyuma bimeze nk’imiravyo.
Nkiriko ndaraba ivyo binyabuzima, nca mbona ipine rishika hasi, i ruhande ya hamwe mu maso hane havyo.
Ayo mapine uko yasa n’uko yari yubatse vyari bimeze gutya: yakayangana nk’amabuye y’agaciro yitwa topazi kandi yose uko ari ane yarasa. Vyari bimeze nk’aho ipine rimwe ryinjira mu rindi.
Kandi mu kugenda, vyashobora kuja mu mpande zavyo zose uko ari zine, ntivyarinda guhindukira iyo biriko biragenda.
Amaringi y’ayo mapine yagera hejuru hateye ubwoba, kandi yari yuzuyeko amaso impande zose.
Iyo ivyo binyabuzima bigiye, ya mapine ari ku mpande zavyo na yo yaca agenda, kandi iyo bigurutse, na yo yaraguruka.
Iyo impwemu y’ivyo binyabuzima yaja, ni yo n’ayo mapine yaja, kandi ayo mapine yahagurukana n’iyo mpwemu, kuko impwemu y’ivyo binyabuzima yari muri ayo mapine.
Ivyo binyabuzima bigiye, n’amapine yaragenda, bihagaze na yo agahagarara; ibinyabuzima bivuye hasi, ya mapine yavana hasi na vyo, kuko mpwemu w’ivyo binyabuzima yari muri ayo mapine.
Hejuru y’umutwe w’ikinyabuzima cose hari ikimeze nk’igicu gikayangana nk’ikiyo, kandi giteye ubwoba.
Musi y’ico gicu hari amababa ashanje, ibaba ryose rya kimwe rigakora ku ry’ikindi, kandi kimwekimwe cose cari gifise amababa abiri apfuka umutumba waco.

Iyo ivyo binyabuzima bigurutse, narumva urwamo rw’amababa yavyo; rwari rumeze nk’urw’amazi asuma, canke nk’ijwi ry’Iyishoboravyose, canke nk’urwamo rw’ingabo nyinshi. Bihagaze, vyaca bimanura amababa yavyo.
Nca numva ijwi rivuye mw’ijuru rivugira hejuru y’imitwe yavyo, aho vyari bihagaze vyamanuye amababa yavyo.
Hejuru y’ico gicu cari giherereye ku mitwe yavyo hari igisa n’intebe y’ubwami ikozwe mw’ibuye ry’agaciro ryitwa lapisi lazuli, kandi kuri iyo ntebe hari uwufise ishusho nk’iy’umuntu.
Mbona ko uhereye nko mu rukenyerero, uduga hejuru, hasa n’icuma gitukujwe n’umuriro, umenga hakikujwe n’umuriro, kandi kuva ngaho umanuka na ho hasa n’umuriro, kandi ikibengebenge cari kimukikije.

Kurya umunywamazi uboneka umeze ku gicu ku musi imvura igomba kugwa, ni ko ugukayangana kwari kumukikuje kwari kumeze. Uko ni ko nabonye ibisa n’ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho . Ndabibonye nikubita hasi nubamye, maze numva ijwi ry’uwuvuga.
Arambarira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, haguruka mvugane nawe.”
Akivuga, Mpwemu aca anzamwo, arampagurutsa ndahagarara, maze nca ndumva uwariko aramvugisha.
Ambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, ndagutumye ku Bisirayeli, kw’ihanga ry’abagarariji, ryangararije; bo hamwe na ba sekuruza babo bamye bangarariza gushika n’uwu musi.
Abo bantu ndakurungitseko ni abantu bashira isoni, kandi bakomantaye imitima. Genda ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.’
Bemeye kukwumviriza canke banse, kuko ari abagarariji, ivyo ari vyo vyose bazomenya ko uwuvugishwa n’Imana yabagendeye.

Ariko wewe mwana w’umuntu, ntuzobatinye, canke ngo utinye amajambo yabo. Ntuzotinye naho uzoba uri hagati mu gisuru canke mu mahwa, ukaba muri za sikoropiyo. Ntuzotinye ivyo bavuga, canke ngo bagutere ubwoba, naho ari inzu y’abagarariji.
Uzobabwire ijambo ryanje, bemeye kuryumviriza canke batemeye kuryumvirize, kuko ari abagarariji.
Ariko wewe, mwana w’umuntu, wumvirize ivyo ndakubwiye. Ntuzogararize nka bo. Asama, urye ico ndaguhaye.”
Ngize gutya mbona ukuboko kuramvuye kuza aho ndi. Kwari gufise igitabu,
kukizingururira imbere yanje. Mu mpapuro zaco hari handitsemwo amajambo yo gucura intimba, amaganya n’amarira.

headings.text: Ihamagarwa rya Ezekiyeli ngo abe uwuvugishwa

verses.text: Maze arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, rya ibiri imbere yawe, rya uyu muzingo w’igitabu; hanyuma ugende uvugane n’Abisirayeli.”
Maze ndasama, na we ampereza uwo muzingo w’igitabu ngo ndakirye.
Arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, rya iki gitabu ndaguhaye, ucuzuze inda yawe.” Nuko ndakirya, kandi casosa nk’ubuki mu kanwa kanje.
Hanyuma aca ambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, genda rero ku nzu ya Isirayeli ubabwire amajambo yanje.
Sinkurungitse ku bantu b’ururimi utazi canke rugoye, ariko nkurungitse ku nzu ya Isirayeli.
Sinkurungitse ku bantu b’ururimi utazi canke rudatahuritse, bavuga amajambo udatahura. Kuko ndazi iyo mba ari bo nkurungitseko bokwumvirije.
Ariko Abisirayeli ntibazokwumviriza, kuko badashaka kunyumviriza. Bose bakomantaje umutima kandi ni intagondwa.
Ariko na wewe, nzoguha kugira uruhanga rukomantaye nk’urwabo, nkugire uwutagonda izosi nka bo.
Uruhanga rwawe nzorukomeza nk’ibuye, rukomere nk’umunana. Ntuze ubatinye canke ngo bagutere ubwoba, naho ari abagarariji.”
Yongera arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, ntega ugutwi, ushire ku mutima amajambo nkubwira.
Genda kuri benewanyu bari mu kinyago, uvugane na bo. Ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze,’ bavyumviriza canke batavyumviriza, upfe kubabwira.”
Maze Mpwemu arampagurutsa, nca numva ijwi risamirana cane inyuma yanje, rivuga riti: “Ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bushimagizwe muri kino kibanza.”
Rwari urwamo rw’amababa ya vya binyabuzima akoranyeko, n’irya ya mapine, hamwe na rya jwi risamirana cane.
Mpwemu aca aranterura ankura ngaho, ngenda nuzuye umururazi n’umubabaro mu mutima, ariko ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kwari kuri jewe n’inkomezi nyishi.
Nca nja ku bari mu kinyago i Telavivu, hafi y’uruzi Kebari. Hanyuma aho nyene baba, nicara hagati yabo imisi indwi, nuzuye agahinda mu mutima.
Inyuma y’imisi indwi, Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rinzako,
riti: “Mwana w’umuntu, nakugize umuteramyi w’inzu ya Isirayeli; none rero niwumve amajambo nkubwira, uheze ubaburire.

Ninabwira umunyakibi nti: ‘Nta kabuza uzopfa,’ hanyuma nawe ntumuburire canke ngo umuhanure, umwinginge ave mu nzira ziwe mbi, kugira ngo ukize ubuzima bwiwe, uwo munyakibi azopfa azize ivyaha vyiwe, ariko amaraso yiwe nzoyaguharurako.
Ariko niwaburira umunyakibi hanyuma ntave mu bibi vyiwe no mu ngeso ziwe mbi, azopfa azize ivyaha vyiwe, ariko weho uzoba ukijije ubugingo bwawe.

Kandi abagororotsi nibava mu bugororotsi bwabo, bagakora ibibi, hanyuma ngashira igitsitaza imbere yabo, bazopfa. Bitumwe n’uko utababuriye, bazokwicwa n’ivyaha vyabo. Ibikorwa vyiza vyose bakoze ntibizokwibukwa, kandi amaraso yabo nzoyaguharurako.
Ariko niwaburira abagororotsi ntibakore ivyaha, nta kabuza bazobaho, kuko bazoba bakwumviye, kandi nawe ubwawe uzoba wikijije.”
Maze ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kunkorako aho nyene, ambwira ati: “Haguruka usohoke uje mu kiyaya, ico ndahakubwirira.”
Nuko ndahaguruka nja mu kiyaya. Ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bwari ngaho, bumeze nk’ubwo naboneye i ruhande y’uruzi Kebari, ndaheza nubama hasi.
Maze Mpwemu anzamwo, arampagurutsa. Aramvugisha ambwira ati: “Genda wiyugaranire mu nzu yawe.
Kandi wewe, mwana w’umuntu, bazokubohesha imigozi, ntuzoshobora no gusohoka ngo uje mu bantu.
Ururimi rwawe nzorubohera mu kanwa kawe, kugira ngo uzokwame unumye, ntushobore kubakankamira kuko ari inzu y’abagarariji.

Ariko ninagutuma, nzokwugurura akanwa kawe, ushobore kubabwira uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.’ Abazoshaka kukwumviriza uzobareke bakwumviririze, abazokwanka uzobareke, kuko ari abagarariji.

headings.text: Ezekiyeli ahabwa igikorwa co kuba umuteramyi

verses.text: Mwana w’umuntu, fata ibumba urikuremwo itafari, urishire imbere yawe, urishushanyeko igisagara ca Yerusalemu.
Ucerekane gikikujwe n’ingabo zigiteye, wubake ivyo kwuririrako, n’amakambi y’ingabo zigiteye, ugikikuze n’ibigwanisho.
Maze ufate ikarayi y’icuma uyigire nk’igihome c’icuma gihagaze hagati yawe n’igisagara, hanyuma uhindukire ugihange amaso, umere nk’uwugiteye. Ico kizobera inzu ya Isirayeli ikimenyetso c’imburi.
Hanyuma uryamire urubavu rw’i bubamfu, wishireko ivyaha vy’inzu ya Isirayeli. Uzokwishirako ivyaha vyabo imisi uzomara uryamiye urwo rubavu.
Nakugeneye imisi ingana n’imyaka bamaze mu vyaha vyabo. Nuko rero uzokwishirako ivyaha vy’inzu ya Isirayeli imisi amajana atatu na mirongo icenda.
Ivyo niwabiheza, uzoheze uhindukire, uryamire urubavu rw’i buryo, wikorere ivyaha vy’ab’inzu ya Yuda. Nakugereye imisi mirongo ine, umusi umwe mu gishingo c’umwaka.
Maze uzohindukiza amaso yawe urabe ukwugarizwa kwa Yerusalemu hanyuma ubangure ukuboko kwawe kutambaye impuzu, uce uhavugishwako ivyo kurandurwa.
Nzokubohesha imigozi, kugira ngo ntuzoshobore guhindukira uva ku ruhande rumwe uja ku rundi imbere y’uko uheza imisi yo kwugariza kwawe.

Kandi rondera ingano, sayiri, ibiharage, inkore, amasaka n’uburo, ubishire mu bushinguro, maze abe ari vyo ucumbamwo imikate yawe. Ni vyo uzorya mu misi amajana atatu na mirongo icenda uzoba uryamiye urubavu rumwe.
Uzoja urafata igice c’uwo mukate gipima shekeli mirongo ibiri abe ari co urya ku musi ku musi no ku gihe kanaka cashinzwe.
Amazi na yo nyene uzoyanywa ayapimye; uzonywa ica gatandatu c’ingero hini ku musi, kandi uyanywere ku gihe kanaka cashinzwe.
Uzorya umutsima w’ingano; uzowokereze mu maso y’abantu, ucanishije umwanda mukuru w’abantu wumye.”
Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Uko ni ko Abisirayeli bazorya indya zihumanye mu mahanga nzobirukaniramwo.”

Nanje ndavuga nti: “Ntibikabe, ewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji! Sinigeze nihumanya. Kuva nkiri muto gushika ubu, sinigenze ndya igikoko cipfiriye gutyo, canke icishwe n’inyamaswa. Nta kintu gihumanye cigeze cinjira mu kanwa kanje.”
Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Reka nkureke utekeshe indya zawe igishwemu c’amase mu gishingo c’umwanda mukuru w’abantu.”
Yongera kumbwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, ngiye gutuma i Yerusalemu hakena indya. Abantu bazorya ivyokurya bapimiwe bahagaritse umutima. Bazonywa n’amazi bagerewe bihebuye.
Ivyokurya n’amazi bizokena, kandi bose bazodendebukirwa, bacike intege kubera ivyaha vyabo.

Mwana w’umuntu, fata inkota ikarishe cane, uyikoreshe nk’urwembe, wiharangure umutwe, wimwe n’ubwanwa. Hanyuma ufate uwo mushatsi uwugaburemwo ibice bitatu hanyuma ufate umunzane upime ivyo bice bitatu bingana.

Maze imisi yawe yo kwugariza igisagara niyahera, uzoturirire mu gisagara igice kimwe c’umushatsi, ikindi ca gatatu ugicagaguze inkota, uzungurutse igisagara cose, ikindi na co ugishwiragize mu muyaga, kuko nzoshwiragiriza abantu banje n’inkota.
Ariko ufate umushatsi mukeya uwupfundike ku mutamana wawe.
Maze wongere ufate udushatsi dukeya kuri wo, uduterere mu muriro dushe duherengetere. Umuriro uzova muri two uzodomeka inzu ya Isirayeli yose.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: ‘Uku ni ko bizogendera Yerusalemu, igisagara nashize hagati y’amahanga, ndagikikuza amahanga menshi.
Ariko caragararije ivyagezwe n’amabwirizwa vyanje gusumvya ayandi mahanga yose agikikuje. Cataye ivyagezwe vyanje, canka gukurikiza amategeko yanje.’

Ni co gituma Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze ati: ‘Mwangararije gusumba ayandi mahanga yose, mwanka gukurikiza amabwirizwa yanje no kugendera mu vyagezwe vyanje, mbere ntimwashoboye no gushika ku rugezo amahanga abakikuje ariko.
Kubera ivyo, Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze ati: Jewe ubwanje mbaye umwansi wawe, ewe Yerusalemu, kandi nzoguhanira ku mugaragaro, amahanga arorera.
Kandi kubera ibigirwamana vyawe vyo kwankwa urunuka, biri muri wewe, nzoguhana uko ntigeze mpana, kandi uburyo ntazosubira guhana.
Ku bw’ivyo muri mwebwe abavyeyi bazorya abana babo, abana barye abavyeyi babo. Nzobahana, kandi amasigarira yo muri mwebwe nzoyasanzaza atwarwe n’umuyaga.’

Ni co gituma Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze ati: ‘Indahiro ni jewe nyene, ko mwahumanishije Ingoro yanje ibishushanyo vyanyu hamwe n’ibizira mukora, jewe ubwanje nzobakurako ubuntu bwanje, kandi nta n’umwe nzogirira imbabazi ngo ndamukingire.

Ica gatatu c’abantu bawe bazokwicwa n’akaranda canke bicwe n’inzara; ikindi ca gatatu kizomarwa n’inkota ivuye inyuma y’igisagara canyu, ikindi na co gishwiragizwe n’umuyaga, bakurikirwe n’inkota, ibamare.
Ishavu ryanje rizoheza risubire hasi, kandi uburake bwanje buturure, kuko nzoba nihoye. Ninamara kubasukako uburake bwanje, bazomenya ko jewe Uhoraho navuganye uburake.
Nzokugira umusaka n’akajoreza ku banyamahanga bagukikuje, no mu maso y’abahita.
Uzoba igitutsi n’agatwengo, akarorero kabi n’akajoreza mu mahanga agukikuje, ninagucira urubanza mu burake, nkagukankamirana umujinya mwinshi, ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze.
Ninakurasisha umwampi wanje wica ugatikiza, ari co kigoyi, nzoba ndawurashe kugira ngo ndakurandure. Nzokugwizako ikigoyi, nzibire n’ahazanana ivyokurya hose.
Nzokurungikira inzara n’inyamaswa zo mw’ishamba, kandi zizosiga utagira ikibondo. Ivyago n’ugusesa amaraso bizogukubura, kandi nzozana inkota kuri wewe. Ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.’ ”
Uhoraho ambwira ijambo ati:
“Mwana w’umuntu, hanga amaso imisozi ya Isirayeli, uyivugishweko,

uvuga uti: ‘Yemwe mwa misozi ya Isirayeli, nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho Nyeninganji. Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji abwiye imisozi n’imitumba, ibiyaya n’imyonga: Ehe ngiye kubateza inkota, nsambure n’ibibanza musengeramwo ibigirwamana vyo ku mpinga z’imisozi.
Ibicaniro vyanyu bizosenyurwa, n’ivyo mwaturirirako ibimota neza bicike umukungugu; kandi abantu bawe nzobicira imbere y’ibigirwamana vyawe.
Imivyimba y’Abisirayeli nzoyirambika imbere y’ibigirwamana vyabo, amagufa yabo ndayashwiragize hirya no hino y’ibicaniro vyawe.

Aho muba hose, ibisagara vyanyu nzobisiga ari imisaka, n’ibibanza musengeramwo vyo ku mpinga z’imisozi bizosenyurwe, kugira ngo ibicaniro vyanyu bizobe akahebwe n’imisaka, ibigirwamana vyanyu bimenagurwe bikurweho, ibicaniro vyanyu vyo guturira ibimota neza bijanjagurwe, n’ibikorwa vy’amaboko yanyu bikurweho.
Hagati muri mwebwe, abakomeretse ni ho bazopfira, maze muzoca mumenya ko ndi Uhoraho .
Ariko nzosigaza bakeya, bo muri mwebwe bazocika kw’icumu, igihe muzosanzarira mu mahanga yo kw’isi yose.

Maze mu mahanga iyo bazoba bari, aho bazoba bajanywe ari inyagano, bazonyibuka, bibuke ingene nababazwa n’umutima w’ubusambanyi wari muri bo, watumye bahindukira bakanta, hamwe n’amaso yabo yatuma bipfuza ibigirwamana vyabo. Bazokwicuza ibibi bakoze hamwe n’ibikorwa bizira bakoze vyose.
Ni ho bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho , kandi ko mu kubabwira ko nzobateza ivyago kutari ukubatera ubwoba gusa.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Kubita amashi ku yandi wongere udide imigere hasi, uvuge uti: Yooo! Kubera ibikorwa bibi kandi vyo kwankwa Abisirayeli bakoze, bazomarwa n’inkota, ikigoyi n’akaranda.
Uwuri kure azokwicwa n’ingwara y’ikiza, uwuri hafi yicwe n’inkota, kandi uwuzocika kw’icumu akazigamwa na we azokwicwa n’ikigoyi. Uko ni ko nzobasukako uburake bwanje.

Bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho , nibasanga imivyimba y’abantu babo yandagaye mu bigirwamana vyabo, hirya no hino y’ibicaniro vyabo, ku dusozi twose tureture no mu mataba y’imisozi, musi y’ibiti vy’imyungo n’imirinzi, aho bahora baturirira ibimota neza ibigirwamana vyabo.
Nanje nzobaramvurirako ukuboko kwanje, igihugu cabo ndagihindure agahinga, kuva ku bugaragwa gushika i Ribulahi, aho baba hose. Ni ho bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, ibi ni vyo Uhoraho Nyeninganji abwiye igihugu ca Isirayeli: Umuhero! Umuhero uraje ku mpande zine z’igihugu!
None ubu na ho ushitse kuri wewe, kandi nzokwimarirako ishavu. Nzogucira urubanza ku ngeso zawe, maze nguhanire ibizira vyose wakoze.
Sinzokugirira impuhwe, kandi nta we nzosigaza. Nta kabuza nzobahanira ingeso zanyu, n’ibizira vyakorewe muri mwebwe. Ni ho muzomenyera ko ndi Uhoraho .
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ibara ritari bwigere ribaho! Raba, riraje!
Umuhero urashitse! Umuhero urashitse! Uje kubamara! Ng’uwo urashitse!
Uguhona kuragushikiriye, kuragushitseko wa muntu we uba muri iki gihugu. Igihe kirashitse! Umusi uri hafi! Ni umusi w’agatengo, si uwo kunezerererwa ku misozi.
Ngira ndagusukeko uburake bwanje, ndakwimarireko ishavu; nzogucira urubanza ruhwanye n’ingeso zawe, nguhanire ibibi n’ibizira vyose wakoze.
Sinzokugirira impuhwe, kandi nta we nzosigaza, nzoguhemba ibikwiranye n’ingeso zawe, hamwe n’ibibi n’ibizira vyose biri muri wewe. Ni ho uzomenyera ko ari jewe Uhoraho ngukubise.
Raba, uwo musi! Raba, uraje! Uguhona kuradutse, inkoni yo kugukubita irashuritse, ubwibone bwawe na bwo busheshe amashurwe!
Umuryano ubaye mwinshi, ubaye nk’inkoni yo guhana ikibi. Nta n’umwe wo muri aba bantu atazoshikirwa, nta n’umwe wo muri iryo sinzi, canke ubutunzi bwabo, canke ibintu vy’agaciro bitazoshikirwa.
Igihe kirashitse, wa musi uraje. Umuguzi ntanezerwe kandi n’uwugurisha ntababare, kuko uburake bwanje bubashitseko bose.

Umudandaza ntazokwongera kubona ibidandazwa yadandaje, naho we n’uwamuguriye bosigara ari bazima. Kuko ivyerekanywe vyerekeye abo bantu bose, ntibizohinduka. Kubera ivyaha vyabo, nta n’umwe muri bo azokiza ubuzima bwiwe.
Bamaze kuvuza inzamba, mbere ibintu vyose vyateguwe, ariko nta n’umwe azoja ku rugamba, kuko uburake bwanje buri kuri iryo koraniro.
Inyuma y’igisagara hari inkota, mu gisagara na ho hari akaranda n’inzara. Abari mu gihugu bazokwicwa n’inkota; abari mu gisagarara na bo bazomarwa n’inzara n’akaranda.
Abazocika kw’icumu bagahunga bazokwirukira ku misozi. Kurya kw’inuma zo mu biyaya, bazoguguza baboroga, umwe wese arizwa n’ivyaha vyiwe.
Amaboko yose azocika inkokora avemwo inkomezi, amavi na yo aregarege acike nk’amazi.
Bazokwambara amagunira, bambikwe gucika ivutu. Mu maso habo hazokwuzura ibimaramare, kandi imitwe yabo izoharangurwa.

Bazosanzaza ifeza zabo mw’ibarabara, kandi inzahabu zabo zizofatwa nk’ibintu bihumanye. Inzahabu n’ifeza vyabo ntibizoshobora kubakiza ku musi w’uburake bw’ Uhoraho . Ntibizobamara inzara, canke ngo vyuzuze inda zabo, kuko ari vyo vyatumye baja mu vyaha.
Ivyo bashazisha vy’igiciro vyabateye ubwibone, babikoramwo ibigirwamana vyankwa urunuka. Babikuyemwo amashusho ateye isoni, ni co gituma nzobihindura ibihumanye kuri bo.
Ubutunzi bwabo nzobugabira abanyamahanga babunyage, abanyakibi bo kw’isi babusahure, bongere babuhumanye.
Abantu nzobanyegeza mu nyonga hanje, abanyazi na bo baze bahumanye igihugu nakunze. Bazocinjira hanyuma bagihumanye.
Nimutegure iminyororo! Kuko igihugu cuzuye ugusesa amaraso, n’igisagara kikaba cuzuye umuryano.
Nzozana ihanga rirusha ayandi kuba ribi, ryigarurire amazu yabo. Nzomara ubwibone bw’abahambaye, mpumanye insengero zabo.
Ibirandura umutima nivyaza, bazorondera amahoro batari buyaronke.
Icago kizokurwaho n’ikindi, igihuha kibisikanye n’ikindi. Bazobaza abavugishwa b’ibinyoma ivyo beretswe, inyigisho z’ivyagezwe z’abaherezi zizobura, co kimwe n’impanuro z’abakurambere.
Umwami azogandara, umuganwa yihebure, amaboko y’abanyagihugu adendebukirwe. Nzobahana nk’uko ingeso zabo ziri, ndabacire urubanza nkurikije amategeko yabo. Ni ho bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .”
Mu mwaka ugira gatandatu, mu kwezi kwa gatandatu, ku musi wakwo wa gatanu, nari nicaye mu nzu yanje, kandi abatware b’Abayuda bari bicaye imbere yanje, maze ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho Nyeninganji kunzako.
Ngize gutya mbona ishusho isa n’iy’umuntu. Kuva ahaboneka nko mu rukenyerero rwiwe kumanuka, hasa n’umuriro, haruguru na ho hasa n’icuma gica ibibatsi.

Agorora ikintu gisa n’ukuboko, amfata umushatsi. Maze Mpwemu aca arandugana hagati y’isi n’ijuru, ndi muri ukwo kwerekwa n’Imana, anjana i Yerusalemu, mu rwinjiriro rw’irembo ryo mu buraruko mu rugo imbere, ahari hateretse ikigirwamana gituma Uhoraho apfuha.
Ubwo nyene imbere yanje, haca haza ubwiza bw’Imana ya Isirayeli, bwari bumeze nk’ubwo nabonye mu kiyaya.
Nuko arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, raba mu buraruko.” Ndavyeyo, nca mbona muri rwa rwinjiriro rw’irembo uja ku gicaniro hari ca kigirwamana gituma Uhoraho araka.

Arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, urabona ivyo bariko barakora, ibizira bihambaye Abisirayeli bakora, ibizira bizontuma nigira kure y’Ingoro yanje? Ariko bandanya wegere urabona n’ibindi bizira biruta ivyo.”
Nuko aca anjana ku rwinjiriro rw’urugo. Ngize gutya, mbona igitoboro mu ruhome.
Maze arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, niwimbe muri urwo ruhome.” Nanje ndimba, nca mbona urwinjiriro.
Aca arambwira ati: “Injira urabe amabi n’ibizira bariko barahakorera.”
Nuko ndinjira ndaraba, mbona bashushanije ku mpome zose ubwoko bwose bw’ibikwega inda hasi n’ibikoko bihumanye hamwe n’ibigirwamana vyose vy’inzu ya Isirayeli.

Imbere yavyo hari hahagaze abatware b’Abisirayeli mirongo indwi, kandi Yahazaniya mwene Shafani yari ahagararanye na bo. Umwe wese yari afise icotezo mu minwe, kandi umwotsi w’ibimota neza wariko uraduga.
Uhoraho ambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, wabonye ivyo abatware b’Abisirayeli bakorera mu mwijima, umwe wese i ruhande y’ibishushanyo vyiwe? Bibwira bati: ‘ Uhoraho ntatubona, iki gihugu yaragihevye.’ ”
Yongera ambwira ati: “Uraza kubona n’ibindi bizira bikomeye bakora.”
Hanyuma aca anjana ku rwinjiriro amaja mu buraruko bw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , nca mbona abagore bicayeho, baririra igishusho c’imana yitwa Tamuzi.
Arambwira ati: “Ivyo wabibonye ga mwana w’umuntu? Uraza kubona n’ibindi bizira biruta ivyo.”

Nuko aca anyinjiza imbere mu rugo rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho . Mu rwinjiriro rwayo, hagati y’umuryango n’igicaniro c’umwakaka, hari abagabo mirongo ibiri na batanu. Bari bateye umugongo urusengero, baraba mu buseruko, bunamira izuba.

Arambaza ati: “Ivyo wabibonye ga mwana w’umuntu? Mbega ab’inzu ya Yuda bibaza ko gukorera ibizira nk’ibi ngaha ari ibintu bisanzwe? Igihugu cabo bakacuzuzamwo umuryano, bagatuma mbandanya nuzura uburake? Ehe raba ingene bashira inengo ku zuru ngo bandatse.
Ni co gituma nanje nzobarakira; sinzobarabana ijisho ry’imbabazi, kandi nta n’umwe ntazoshikira. Naho bazontakambira mu matwi n’ijwi rirenga, sinzobumva.”
Maze numva Uhoraho ahamagara n’ijwi rirenga, avuga ati: “Nzanira hano abagabo bateguwe ngo bahane ico gisagara, bazanane n’ibigwanisho vyabo mu minwe.”

Nuko nca mbona abagabo batandatu bazananye mw’irembo ryo haruguru rirabana no mu buraruko, umwe wese afise ikigwanisho cica mu minwe. Muri bo harimwo umugabo yari yambaye impuzu zera derere, afise mu rukenyerero ibikoresho vyo kwandika. Baraza bahagarara i ruhande ya ca gicaniro c’umwakaka.

Maze ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli buraduga buvuye ku bakerubi aho bwari buri, buja mu rwinjiriro rw’Ingoro. Uhoraho ahamagara wa mugabo yari yambaye impuzu zera derere, yari afise mu rukenyerero ibikoresho vyo kwandika,
amubwira ati: “Nyuragira hagati mu gisagara ca Yerusalemu, ushire ikimenyetso mu ruhanga rw’abo bose bababara, bagacura intimba kubera ibizira bikorerwa muri iki gisagara.”
Nkiriko ndumviriza, numva abwiye abandi ati: “Nimumukurikire mu gisagara, mwice ata mbabazi n’impuhwe uwo wese musanga atariko ikimenyetso.
Mwice abatama, imisore, inkumi, abagore n’abana. Ariko ntimukore ku muntu n’umwe ariko ikimenyetso. Muhere mu Ngoro yanje.” Nuko baca bahera ku batama bari imbere y’Ingoro.
Yongera ababwira ati: “Nimuhumanye Ingoro, urugo rwayo murwuzuze imivyimba. Nimugende!” Nuko barasohoka baca mu gisagara bagenda barica nk’uko bari babwiwe.

Bariko barica, nari nsigaye ndi jenyene, nca nikubita hasi nubamye, ndatakamba n’ijwi rirenga nti: “Ewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, mbega ugira utikize amasigarira ya Isirayeli, mu gusuka uburake bwawe kuri Yerusalemu?”

Aranyishura ati: “Ivyaha vy’inzu ya Isirayeli n’ivya Yuda vyabaye umurengera; igihugu cuzuye amaraso, umugwa na wo wuzuye akarenganyo. Bibwira bati: ‘ Uhoraho yarataye kino gihugu; Uhoraho ntatubona.’
None rero sinzobarabisha ijisho ry’impuhwe, kandi nta n’umwe nzosigaza, ahubwo nzomanurira ku mitwe yabo ivyo bakoze vyose.”
Maze wa muntu yari yambaye impuzu zera derere afise mu rukenyerero ibikoresho vyo kwandika agaruka kuvuga inkuru ati: “Nakoze ivyo wantumye.”
Ngize gutya mbona ikimeze nk’intebe y’ubwami isa n’ibuye ry’agaciro ryitwa lapisi lazuli iri hejuru y’imitwe ya ba bakerubi.

Uhoraho abarira wa muntu yari yambaye impuzu zera derere ati: “Ja hagati mu mapine ari musi y’abakerubi. Wuzuze amashi yawe amakara yaka, hanyuma uyashwiragize mu gisagara.” Nuko aragenda abikora ndamuraba.
Ico gihe ba bakerubi bari bahagaze ku ruhande rwo hepfo y’Ingoro igihe uwo mugabo yinjira muri ayo mapine, hanyuma igicu c’ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho gica cuzura imbere mu Ngoro.
Maze bwa bwiza bw’ Uhoraho buraduga buva ku bakerubi buja mu rwinjiriro rw’Ingoro. Ca gicu gica cuzura Ingoro, inyubakwa yose yuzura ugukayangana kw’ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho .
Ugukubita kw’amababa ya ba bakerubi kwumvikana gushika kure hanze mu rugo, kumeze nk’ijwi ry’ Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose iyo avuze.
Uhoraho abarira wa muntu yari yambaye impuzu zera derere ati: “Fata umuriro wo musi y’amapine no hagati y’abakerubi.” Wa muntu aragenda ahagarara i ruhande ya ya mapine.
Maze umukerubi umwe agorora ukuboko azana amakara yaka ayakuye mu muriro wariko urakira hagati muri bo; aca ayashira mu biganza vya wa muntu yari yambaye impuzu zera, na we arayakira, arasohoka.
Musi y’amababa y’abakerubi hari ibimeze nk’amaboko y’umuntu.
Ngize gutya mbona amapine ane i ruhande y’abakerubi, rimwerimwe i ruhande y’umukerubi umwe; ayo mapine yarakayangana nk’akabuye k’igiciro kitwa topazi.
Kandi uyaravye, ayo mapine yose uko ari ane yarasa; rimwerimwe ryose rimeze nk’aho ryinjira mu rindi.
Abakerubi mu kugenda, bashobora kuja mu mpande zine zose bitewe n’aho baba baraba; ayo mapine ntiyarinda guhindukira abakerubi bariko baragenda. Bashobora kuja iyo baraba, batiriwe barahindukira.
Abakerubi bari buzuyeko amaso ku mubiri wose harimwo n’umugongo, amaboko n’amababa; co kimwe n’ayo mapine.
Ndahava numva ko ayo mapine yitwa: “Nyawizunguriza.”
Umukerubi umwe wese yari afise mu maso amashusho ane: ishusho ya mbere yari iy’umukerubi, iya kabiri yari iy’umuntu, iya gatatu yari iy’intare, iya kane yari iy’inkona.
Maze ba bakerubi barahaguruka. Abo ni vyo vya binyabuzima nari nabonye ku ruzi Kebari.
Iyo abo bakerubi bagiye, ya mapine yajana na bo; kandi iyo bagoroye amababa ngo bave hasi, ya mapine ntiyabavako.
Abakerubi bahagaze, amapine na yo yarahagarara; bahagurutse agahagurukana na bo, kuko impwemu y’ivyo binyabuzima yari muri ayo mapine.
Maze ubwiza bw’Uhoraho buva mu rwinjiriro rw’Ingoro, buhagarara hejuru ya ba bakerubi.

Abo bakerubi basanza amababa mbona, barahagurutse bava hasi. Bagiye, ya mapine ajana na bo. Bahagarara mu rwinjiriro rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho rutumbereye mu buseruko, kandi ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli bwari hejuru yabo.
Ivyo ni vyo binyabuzima nari nabonye biri musi y’Imana ya Isirayeli ndi ku ruzi Kebari, nca ndatahura ko bari abakerubi.
Umwe wese yari afise amababa ane, kandi musi y’amababa yabo hari ibimeze nk’amaboko y’umuntu.
Mu maso habo hasa n’ah’abo nari nabonye ndi ku ruzi Kebari. Umwe wese yagenda atumbereye imbere yiwe.

Maze Mpwemu aranterura, anjana mu rwinjiriro rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho ruraba mu buseruko. Aho mu rwinjiriro hari abagabo mirongo ibiri na batanu, kandi muri bo mbonamwo Yahazaniya mwene Azuri na Pelatiya mwene Benaya, bari abatware barongora abantu.
Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, abo bagabo ni abategura ibikorwa bibi muri iki gisagara, kandi bakagira inama mbi abandi.
Bavuga ngo: ‘Mbega amazu yacu si ho agiheza kwubakwa? Iki gisagara cacu kimeze nk’inkono kandi natwe tumeze nk’inyama ziri muri iyo nkono.’
Nuko rero genda uvugishwe ibibi bizobashikako; vugishwa, ewe mwana w’umuntu.”
Hanyuma Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho aza kuri jewe, ambwira ngo mvuge nti: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Ivyo ni vyo muriko muravuga, mwebwe abarongozi muri Isirayeli, ariko, ndazi ivyo mwiyumvira mu mitima yanyu.
Mwishe abantu benshi muri kino gisagara, amabarabara muyuzuza imivyimba.
Kubera ivyo, uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Imivyimba mwandagaje ahantu hose ni inyama; iki gisagara na co ni inkono. Ariko mwebwe muzokurwa muri iyo nkono.
Mutinya inkota, ariko ni yo nzobateza, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.
Nzobasohora ndabakure muri iki gisagara, ndabahereze abanyamahanga babampanire.
Muzomarwa n’inkota, kandi nzobacira urubanza muri ku mbibe za Isirayeli, ni ho muzomenyera ko ndi Uhoraho .
Iki gisagara ntikizobabera nk’inkono, kandi na mwebwe ntimuzoba nk’inyama muri yo; nzobacira urubanza muri ku mbibe za Isirayeli.
Namwe muzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho , kuko mwanse gukurikiza amabwirizwa yanje canke ngo mugendere mu vyagezwe vyanje, ariko mukishushanya n’imigenzo y’amahanga abakikuje.’ ”
Nkiriko ndavugishwa, Pelatiya mwene Benaya aca arapfa. Maze nca ngwa nubamye, nkoma induru n’ijwi rirenga nti: “Ewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji! Mbega ugomba uherengeteze amasigarira ya Isirayeli?”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, abantu b’i Yerusalemu baravuze kuri benewanyu bajanywe ari inyagano hamwe n’Abisirayeli bose, ngo: ‘Bari kure cane y’ Uhoraho , ni twebwe twahawe iki gihugu ngo kibe umugabane wacu.’

None rero genda ubwire abari mu kinyago uti: ‘ Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze ati: Naho nabarungitse kure mu mahanga, nkabashwiragizayo, nzobabera urusengero muri ayo mahanga igihe cose muzomara muri mu kinyago.’
Ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nzobegeranya ndabazane ndabakuye mu bihugu mwashwiragiriyemwo, ndabasubize mu gihugu ca Isirayeli.’
Bazokigarukamwo, bagikuremwo ibishushanyo vyose hamwe n’ibigirwamana vy’ibizira.
Nzobaha umutima umwe, ndabashiremwo impwemu nsha. Nzobakuramwo umutima w’ibuye ndabahe umutima w’inyama.
Bazokurikiza amabwirizwa yanje, bagendere mu vyagezwe vyanje. Bazoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yabo.
Ariko abeguriye imitima yabo ibishushanyo n’ibigirwamana vy’ibizira, nzobahanira ivyo bakoze vyose, ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze.”
Maze ba bakerubi bakurikirwa n’amapine baca basanza amababa, kandi ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli bwari hejuru yabo.
Bwa bwiza bw’ Uhoraho buca buva hejuru y’igisagara, buhagarara ku musozi uherereye mu buseruko bw’igisagara.
Maze Mpwemu aranterura anjana mu bari mu kinyago i Babiloni, ndi mw’iyerekwa mpawe na Mpwemu w’Imana. Hanyuma iryo yerekwa narimwo rirahera.
Maze nca mbwira abari mu kinyago ivyo Uhoraho yanyeretse vyose.
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, uba mu bantu b’abagarariji. Bafise amaso ariko ntibabona, bafise amatwi ariko ntibumva, kuko ari abantu b’abagarariji.
None rero, mwana w’umuntu, tekera ibintu vyawe kugira uhunge, kandi ugende ku murango, bakubona, uve aho uba wimukire ahandi. Kumbure bazotahura n’aho ari abagarariji.
Uhengere ku murango usohore utwawe, ubikore bakubona, usohore ibintu vyawe, utekere kurya kw’uwuhunga. Maze ku mugoroba, usohoke bakuraba, ugende kurya kw’abahunga.
Utobore igihome bakuraba, kibe ari co ucishamwo utwawe.
Ubishire ku rutugu bakuraba, ubijane hatabona. Witwikire mu maso kugira ngo ntugende uraraba igihugu uvuyemwo, kuko nakugize nk’ikimenyetso ku Bisirayeli.”

Nuko ndabigenza uko nabwiwe. Mpengera ari ku murango nsohora ibintu vyanje, ndatekera ngo mpunge. Maze ku mugoroba ntobora uruhome n’amaboko, nsohora ibintu vyanje hatabona, ndabishira ku rutugu, ndagenda bandaba.
Bukeye Uhoraho antumako ijambo ryiwe ati:
“Mwana w’umuntu, mbega Abisirayeli, ba bantu b’abagarariji, ntibigeze bakubaza bati: ‘Ivyo uriko ukora ni ibiki?’
Ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ubu buhanuzi ni imburi ku muganwa w’i Yerusalemu hamwe n’ab’inzu ya Isirayeli bose baba ngaho.’
Ubabwire uti: ‘Ndi ikimenyetso kuri mwebwe. Ivyo nagize ni vyo bazokorerwa. Bazojanwa mu mahanga nk’inyagano.’
Umuganwa wo muri bo azoshira utuntu twiwe ku bitugu ahunge, kandi bazomucira igitoboro mu ruhome acemwo. Azokwitwikira mu maso kugira ngo ntabone igihugu ahunze.
Nanje nzomurekurirako urusenga, kandi azofatwa mu mutego wanje awugwemwo; nzomutwara i Babiloni mu gihugu c’Abakaludaya, ariko ntazokibona, kandi ni co azogwamwo.
Nzosanzariza mu miyaga yose abamukikuje, abacungera ubuzima bwiwe hamwe n’ingabo ziwe zose, mpeze ndabirukeko n’inkota.
Bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho , ninabashwiragiza mu mahanga no mu bihugu bitandukanye.
Ariko nzokwisigariza bamwe, ndabarinde inkota, inzara n’akaranda, kugira ngo mu mahanga yose bazojamwo bazokwame bicuza ibizira bakoze. Ni ho bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, ivyokurya vyawe ubirye uhinda agashitsi, n’amazi yawe uyanywe ufise ubwoba.

Abo muri iki gihugu ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze ku baba i Yerusalemu no mu gihugu ca Isirayeli: bazorya ivyokurya vyabo bahagaritse imitima, amazi yabo bayanywe bihebuye, kuko igihugu kigiye gusangangurwa, kinyagwe ivyo cari gifise vyose, kubera umuryano w’abahaba bose.
Ibisagara abantu babamwo bizosigara ari imisaka, igihugu na co gisigare ari agahinga. Aho ni ho muzomenyera ko ndi Uhoraho .’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, mbega uwu mugani mufise mu gihugu ca Isirayeli uvuga ngo: ‘Imisi irashira, ivyavugishijwe ntibishike,’ usigura iki?

Genda ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ngiye gushira iherezo kuri uwo mwibutsa, ntuzosubira gukoreshwa mu Bisirayeli.’ Genda ubabwire uti: ‘Igihe kiregereje, aho ivyavugishijwe vyose bizoshika.
Nta ndoto z’ibinyoma canke ubupfumu bwo kuryohereza abantu bizosubira kuvugwa mu Bisirayeli.
Ariko jewe Uhoraho nzovuga, kandi ivyo nzovuga bizoshika bidatevye. Kuko mu gihe cawe, wewe wa nzu y’ubugarariji, nzoshitsa ivyo navuze vyose, ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, Abisirayeli bariko bavuga bati: ‘Ivyo yerekwa ni ibizoba mu myaka myinshi iri mbere, ivyo avugishwa ni ivya kazoza ka kure.’
None rero babwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nta jambo na rimwe navuze rigitevye gushika; ivyo navuze vyose bizoshika, ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, vugishwa ubwire abavugishwa b’ibinyoma ba Isirayeli bariko baravugishwa muri iki gihe. Bwira abo bariko baravugishwa ivyo biyumviriye uti: ‘Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho !
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Baragowe abavugishwa b’ibipfu, bakurikiza ivyo biyumviriye, ata co beretswe!
Ewe Isirayeli, abavugishwa bawe bameze nk’imfyisi ziyerera mu bihomoka vy’amazu.
Ntibigeze baduga ngo baje kuzibira ibihengeri vy’uruzitiro, ngo barusanure kubw’Abisirayeli kugira ngo ruze rube ruhagaze neza ku musi w’urugamba w’ Uhoraho .
Ivyo berekwa si ivy’ukuri kandi n’ivyo babaragurira ni ibinyoma. Mbere n’aho Uhoraho atigeze abatuma, bavuga ngo: “ Uhoraho aravuze,” kandi bakitega ko ashitsa ivyo bavuze.
Mbega inzozi mwarose si ibinyoma kandi indagu zanyu muvuga si ububeshi, igihe muvuga muti: “ Uhoraho aravuze,” kandi ata na kimwe navuze?
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Kubera amajambo yanyu y’ububeshi n’inzozi z’ibinyoma, nzobagwanya, ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze.

Ukuboko kwanje kuzogwanya abavugishwa berekwa ibitari vyo, bakaragura ibinyoma. Ntibazoba mw’ikoraniro ry’ubwoko bwanje, ntibazoharurwa mu bana ba Isirayeli, canke ngo binjire mu gihugu ca Isirayeli. Ni ho muzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho Nyeninganji.
Ko bazimiza abantu banje, bakavuga ngo: “Ni amahoro” kandi ata yariho, ni nk’aho abantu boba bubatse uruhome rudakomeye, maze abo bavugishwa bakarusiga ishwagara.
Nuko rero, bwira abo basiga uruhome ko rugiye guhenuka. Hazogwa imvura y’isegenya, kandi nzorungika n’urubura ruhunguruke, hamwe n’umuyaga w’igihuhusi birusenyure.
None uruhome nirwasenyuka, mbega abantu ntibazobabaza bati: Ya shwagara mwarusigako iri he?’
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze ati: ‘Mu burake bwanje, nzosuka umuyaga w’igihuhusi, ishavu ryanje rirungike urubura n’isegenya, bigwe bifise umukuba wo gusambura.
Nzosenyagura uruhome mwasize irangi ryera, ndaruryamike hasi, umushinge warwo usigare hejuru. Nirwahenuka, muzorutikiriramwo; kandi muzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .
Nuko nzoba nimariye ishavu kuri urwo ruzitiro no ku barusize iryo rangi. Nzobabwira nti: Uruzitiro ruragiye, kandi n’abarusize ishwagara bajanye na rwo,
ni bo bavugishwa b’ibinyoma ba Isirayeli bavugishwa ibinyoma i Yerusalemu, bakerekwa ivy’amahoro kuri ho kandi ata yariho, ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze.’
Ubu na ho, mwana w’umuntu, burira abakobwa b’ubwoko bwanyu bavugishwa ivyo biyumviriye. Vugishwa ubaburire

ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Haragowe abagore bajishira udukomo tw’ubukonikoni ku maboko yabo, bakibaririra imyitwikiro y’uburebure butandukanye ku mitwe yabo kugira ngo bikwegereko abantu. Mbega mwibaza ko muzokwikwegerako ubuzima bw’abantu banje mutikwegeye ukuranduka kwanyu?
Mwarangayishije mu bantu banje kubera urushi rw’ingano n’akamanyu k’umutsima. Mwahenze abantu banje bumvirije ibinyoma vyanyu, mwica abatopfuye, mukingira abari bakwiye gupfa.
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nzogwanya ubukomo bw’ubukonikoni bwanyu mufatisha abantu banje nk’inyoni, ndabucagagurire ku maboko yanyu; nzobohora abantu mwateze nk’inyoni.
Nzotabagura imyitwikiro iri ku mitwe yanyu, nkize abantu banje mu maboko yanyu, kandi ntibazosubira kugwa musi y’ububasha bwanyu. Ni ho muzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .

Kubera mwaciye intege imitima y’abagororotsi n’ibinyoma vyanyu, igihe jewe ubwanje ntari nabateye imibabaro, kandi kubera mutera intege abanyakibi ngo ntibave mu nzira zabo mbi ngo bakize ubuzima bwabo,
ntimuzosubira kugira izo nzozi z’ibinyoma, canke ngo musubire kuragura. Nzokiza abantu banje ndabakure mu maboko yanyu. Ni ho namwe muzomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho .’ ”
Bamwe mu batware b’Abisirayeli baza aho ndi bicara imbere yanje.
Maze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, aba bantu bateretse ibigirwamana mu mitima yabo, kandi bashize ibitsitaza bibajana mu vyaha imbere y’amaso yabo. None ni igiki cotuma ndabishura ku vyo bambaza?

Nuko rero babwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Umwisirayeli niyashira ikigirwamana mu mutima wiwe, agashira igitsitaza imbere y’amaso yiwe, hanyuma akaja ku bavugishwa, nanje nzobishura ibihwanye n’ivyaha vyabo.
Ivyo nzobikora kugira ngo nsubire kwigarurira imitima y’Abisirayeli, bantaye bagakurikira ibigirwamana vyabo.’
None rero bwira Abisirayeli, uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nimwihane! Mureke ivyo bigirwamana hamwe n’ibindi bizira vyose mukora!

Iyo Umwisirayeli canke umunyamahanga aba muri Isirayeli yitandukanije nanje agashira ibigirwamana mu mutima wiwe hamwe n’ibitsitaza imbere yiwe, hanyuma akaja ku bavugishwa b’ibinyoma ngo babavugire kuri jewe, jewe Uhoraho nzomwiyishurira.
Nzohindukiriza inyonga zanje kugwanya umuntu nk’uyo, ndamutangeko akarorero, ndamugire iciro ry’umugani. Nzomuca mu bwoko bwanje; ni ho muzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .
Kandi umuvugishwa niyahendwa ngo avuge ubuhanuzi, ni jewe Uhoraho nzoba ndamuhenze, kandi nzomuramvurirako ukuboko kwanje ndamurandure ndamukure mu bwoko bwanje bwa Isirayeli.
Bazoharurwako ibigabitanyo vyabo, kandi uwo muvugishwa azohanwa co kimwe n’uwuza kumuraguzako.
Ni ho Abisirayeli batazosubira kuzimira ngo bamveko, kandi ntibazosubira kwihumanisha ivyaha vyabo. Bazoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yabo, ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze.”
Maze Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, hagize igihugu kincumurako, kigata ubwizigirwa, nkakiramvurirako ukuboko kwanje, ngasibanganya ahava ivyokurya vyaco, nkakirungikamwo inzara ikica abantu baco n’ibitungwa vyaco,
naho abagabo batatu ari bo Nowa, Daniyeli na Yobu bobaye ari yo bari, bokijije amagara yabo gusa kubera ukugororoka kwabo, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Canke na ho ndungitse ibikoko vy’inkazi muri ico gihugu, bigahonya abantu bose bigasiga igihugu ari agahinga,
ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kwanje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, naho abo bagabo batatu bobaye ari yo bari, ntibokijije abahungu n’abakobwa babo. Bokwikijije bonyene, ariko igihugu cosigaye ari agahinga.
Canke nzanye inkota kuri ico gihugu, nkavuga nti: Reka iyi nkota ice mu gihugu cose, nkica abantu bose n’ibitungwa vyabo,
ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kwanje, Uhoraho Nyeninganji, naho abo bagabo bobaye bari muri co, ntibokijije abahungu n’abakobwa babo, bokwikijije bonyene.
Canke ndungitse icago muri ico gihugu, nkagisukako uburake bwanje mu gusesa amaraso, nkica abantu baho bose n’ibikoko vyaho vyose,
ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kwanje, Jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, naho Nowa na Daniyeli na Yobu bobaye ari yo bari, ntiboshoboye gukiza abahungu n’abakobwa babo. Bokwikijije bo ubwabo, kubera ukugororoka kwabo.

Kuko uku ari ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Ese ukuntu bizoba ari bibi birenze urugero ninarungika i Yerusalemu ibihano vyanje bine biteye ubwoba ari vyo inkota, inzara, ibikoko vy’inkazi n’akaranda, kugira ngo vyice abantu n’ibitungwa vyabo!
Ariko muri bo nzokwisigariza bamwe, abahungu n’abakobwa bakeya bazorokoka. Bazoza kuri mwebwe, kandi nimwabona ingeso zabo n’ibikorwa vyabo muzokwirurwa ku bw’ivyago vyose nateye Yerusalemu.
Muzohozwa amarira mubonye ingeso zabo n’ibikorwa vyabo, kuko muzomenya ko ata co nakoreye Isirayeli kitagira igituma, ni Jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, mbega ishami ry’igiti c’umuzabibu hari ico risumvya irindi shami iryo ari ryo ryose ryo mw’ishamba?
Mbega ico giti hari uwugikuramwo imbaho zo gukoramwo ibindi bintu, canke akakibazamwo ico kumanikako ibikoresho?
Mbega uko kingana iyo gicanywe, umutumba waco ugacika amakara, hari ico kiba kikimaze?
None ikintu ata co gishobora kumara kikiri kizima, comara iki kimaze guturirwa kigacika umunyota?
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nk’uko natanze igiti c’umuzabibu ngo kibe urukwi rwo mu bindi biti vyo mw’ishamba, ni ko nzotanga ababa i Yerusalemu.
Nzohindukiriza inyonga zanje kubagwanya. Naho bavuye mu mucanwa, ni wo nyene uzobatongora. Kandi nzohindukirira kubagwanya, bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .
Nzosiga igihugu ari agahinga, kuko batabaye abizigirwa, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.”

headings.text: Yerusalemu, igiti c’umuzabibu ata co kimaze

verses.text: Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri jewe riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, hangana n’ababa i Yerusalemu, ubamenyeshe ibizira bakora,
ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji abwiye Yerusalemu: Inkomoko yawe n’amavukiro yawe ni mu gihugu c’i Kanani; so wawe yari Umumori, nyoko wawe na we yari Umuhetikazi.
Umusi uvuka, uruzogi rwawe ntirwaciwe, kandi nta wakwogeje n’amazi ngo use neza, nta n’uwagusize umunyu canke ngo akwambike impuzu nziza.
Nta wakurabanye imbabazi, canke ngo akugirire impuhwe maze ngo agukorere na kimwe muri ivyo. Ahubwo watawe mu gahinga, kuko umusi uvuka wari ugayitse.
Maze nguciye i ruhande, ndakubona wigaragura mu maraso yawe, ukibiryamyemwo ndakubwira nti: Baho!
Naragukujije nk’igiterwa co mu murima, urakura, ugira ubwiza bw’agatangaza. Amabere yawe arasonga, umushatsi wawe urakura, naho wari ukiri gusa, ugenda amenya.

Mu nyuma naguciye i ruhande, ndakuravye nsaga urageze kuronka uwugukunda, nzingurura umutamana wanje ndagupfuka, mpisha ubwambure bwawe. Maze ndakurahira indahiro ku mugaragaro, ngirana isezerano ry’ubugeni nawe, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze, uba ubaye uwanje.
Nca ndakwoza, nguhanagura amaraso, mpejeje ndagusiga amavuta atamirana.
Hanyuma nkwambika impuzu zera derere z’agaciro kanini, zisharije neza, nkwambika n’ibirato bikozwe mu nsato z’impene ziremvye.
Nakwambitse utugenegene twiza: ibisharizo vyo ku maboko, ibirezi vyo mw’izosi,
impeta yo ku zuru, amahereni ku matwi, n’urugori rw’ubwamikazi ku mutwe.

Wari usharijwe n’inzahabu n’ifeza, imyambaro yawe yari yera derere kandi y’agaciro kanini, isharije cane. Ivyokurya vyawe vyari vyizavyiza, ubuki, amavuta ya elayo hamwe n’ifu inoze neza. Wari mwiza cane, kandi wari ubereye kuba umwamikazi.
Ubwiza bwawe bwatumye uba rurangiranwa mu mahanga, kuko icubahiro naguhaye catumye ubwiza bwawe buba agahebuza, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.
Ariko wahavuye wishimira ubwiza bwawe, ukumenyekana kwawe gutuma uba maraya. Wihaye uwurengana wese, ubwiza bwawe buba ubw’uwo wese ahita.
Wafashe umwe mu myambaro yawe, wiyubakiramwo ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ibigirwamana mu mataba y’imisozi, aho ukorera ubumaraya. Ibintu nk’ivyo ntivyari bwigere biba! Mbega ivyo vyashitse gute?
Warongeye ufata ibisharizo vyose vy’agaciro naguhaye, vyari vyakozwe mu nzahabu no mw’ifeza, wicuriramwo ibishushanyo vy’abagabo, ugirana ubumaraya na vyo.
Ufata imyambaro isharije naguhaye uravyambika, ubishikanira amavuta yanje hamwe n’ibiturirwa bikamota neza vyose naguhaye.
Ivyokurya nari naguhaye ngo abe ari vyo urya: ifu inoze neza, amavuta ya elayo hamwe n’ubuki, wabibishikaniye nk’ibiturirwa bikamota neza. Ng’ivyo ivyo wakoze, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.
Wageretseko, ufata abahungu n’abakobwa wari wamvyariye, ubashikanira ibigirwamana nk’infungurwa zavyo. Mbega ubumaraya bwawe ntibwari buhagije?
Wakereye abana banje, ubashikanako ibimazi ku bigirwamana.
Muri ivyo bizira vyose n’ubwo bumaraya, ntiwigeze wibuka imisi y’ubuto bwawe, igihe wari gusa ugenda amenya, wigaragura mu maraso yawe.
Uragowe! Uragowe, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze. Ikigeretse kuri ivyo bibi wakoze,
wiyubakiye ikibanza co gusengeramwo nk’ic’abanyamahanga, ushira igicaniro ahantu hose hakoranira abantu.
Wubatse utunyabugoro ku mayirabiri hose, uhumanya ubwiza bwawe, wegurira umubiri wawe ubusambanyi hamwe n’uwuhita wese butagira ingene bwovugwa.
Wisutse mu bumaraya n’Abanyegiputa, ari bo babanyi bawe buzuye ukwipfuza, maze utuma ubusambanyi bwawe bwinshi bundatsa.
Ni ho nakuramvurirako ukuboko kwanje, ngabanya igihugu cawe; ndakurekurira mu maboko y’abansi bawe, ari bo Bafilisitiya, bari batewe isoni n’ingeso mbi zawe.
N’Abashuri wagiranye ubumaraya na bo, kuko usanzwe utanyurwa; kandi umaze kubana na bo mu bumaraya, ntiwanyuzwe.
Wagwije ubusambanyi bwawe na Babiloni, igihugu c’abadandaza, ariko na ho nyene ntiwanyuzwe.
Ese ukuntu umutima wawe wapfuye, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze, vyatumye ukora ibisa gutyo, ukigenza nka maraya atakigira udusoni!
Iyo wubatse ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ibigirwamana mu mayirabiri, ukubaka ibicaniro ahahurira abantu hose, wari ubaye maraya, mugabo atameze nk’abandi bamaraya kuko wewe nta n’amahera waka.
Ewe wa mugore we w’umusambanyikazi! Uhitamwo abagabo b’abanyamahanga ukabarutisha umugabo wawe bwite!
Abamaraya bose bahabwa ingabire, ariko weho uha ingabire abagusambanya, kugira ngo ubikwegereko ubakuye ahatandukanye, ngo baze mu busambanyi bwawe.
Mu bumaraya bwawe utandukanye n’abandi; nta wugukurikira akurondera. Utandukanye n’abandi kuko wewe, ni wewe uhemba abagusambanya kandi nta na kimwe wewe uhabwa.
None rero ewe maraya, niwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho !

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ko wasesaguye ubutunzi bwawe, ukiyambika ubusa mu gusambana n’abo wishakiye bose, kandi kubera ubuyobe bw’ibigirwamana vyawe, hamwe n’amaraso y’abana bawe wahaye ivyo bigirwamana,
ngiye kwegeranya abo bose wikundiye, abaguha umunezero, abo wakunze n’abo wanse. Nzobegeranya bave mu mihingo yose, ndakwamburire imbere yabo bose, babone ubwambure bwawe bwose.
Nzogucira igihano c’umugore yasambanye, akongera agasesa amaraso.
Nzoheza ndaguhereze abo wikundiye, basenyagure ibibanza vyawe vyo gusengeramwo n’ibicaniro vyawe. Bazokwambura impuzu zawe, bagutware udusharizo twawe, bagusige wambaye ubusa.
Bazokwongera bazanane n’isinzi ry’abantu bagutere amabuye, bagusogote inkota.
Bazoturira inzu yawe, baguhanire imbere y’abandi bagore benshi. Ubumaraya bwawe nzobuherengeteza, kandi ntuzoba ugisubira guha impembo abakunzi bawe.
Ni ho uburake bwanje buzohwama, ishavu n’umujinya bikakuvako; maze nzotekana, sinzosubira kukurakira.

Kuko utibutse ubuto bwawe ahubwo ukandakisha ibi vyaha vyose, nzogusubiriza mu nkoko ibihwanye n’ivyaha vyawe vyose, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze. Kuko kuri ivyo vyaha wongeyeko ibikorwa bigayitse.
Abaca imigani bose bazohora bavuga bati: Umukobwa amera nka nyina.
Vy’ukuri uri umukobwa yuzuye wa nyoko, agaya umugabo n’abana; kandi uri umuvukanyi wa benewanyu koko, bagaya abagabo babo n’abana babo. Nyoko yari Umuhetikazi so na we yari Umumori.
Mukurwawe mukuru yari Samariya, yaba mu buraruko hamwe n’abakobwa biwe; kandi murumunawe mutoya na we yaba mu bumanuko, n’abakobwa biwe, yari Sodomu.
Ntiwagendeye mu ngeso zabo gusa, ahubwo wakoze ibikorwa bigayitse kurusha ivyabo, uca uba mubi kubarusha kure n’iyo.
Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kwanje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze, mwenewanyu Sodomu n’abakobwa biwe ntibigeze bakora nk’ivyo mwe n’abakobwa bawe mwakoze.
Iki ni co caha ca mwenewanyu Sodomu: we n’abakobwa biwe bari buzuye ubwibone, bakarya cane; ntibitaho aboro n’abakene.
Barishima cane, bagakorera ibizira imbere yanje. Ni co catumye ndabakuraho nk’uko wabibonye.
Samariya ntiyakoze n’ica kabiri c’ivyaha wakoze. Wakoze ibizira vyinshi kubasumvya, noneho bituma benewanyu basa nk’aho ari abagororotsi kugusumvya kubera ibibi vyose wakoze.

Wari ukwiye kumaramara, kuko watumye benewanyu baboneka nk’aho batari bakwiye gutsindwa n’urubanza. Ivyaha vyawe vyabaye vyinshi cane gusumba ivyabo, bituma umenga ni abagororotsi kugusumvya. None rero, niwuzure ibimaramare, kuko watumye baboneka nk’abagororotsi.
Ariko umusi umwe nzosubiza ibintu vyabo mu buryo, ivya Sodomu n’ivy’abakobwa biwe, hamwe n’ivya Samariya n’ivy’abakobwa biwe, kandi n’ivyawe nzobisubizanya mu buryo n’ivyabo,
kugira ngo nawe uzogire isoni, umaramazwe no kubona benewanyu bagirirwa neza kubera ivyaha vyawe.
Abo muvukana, Sodomu n’abakobwa biwe hamwe na Samariya n’abakobwa biwe, bazosubira kuba nk’uko bahora kera; kandi nawe n’abakobwa bawe muzosubira kuba nk’uko mwahoze kera.
Mu misi y’ubwibone bwawe ntiwigera ucisha mu kanwa mwenewanyu Sodomu,
imbere y’uko ububi bwawe buja ahabona. Kandi n’aho biri uko, ubu ushinyagurizwa n’abakobwa ba Edomu bari kumwe n’ababanyi biwe, hamwe n’abakobwa b’Abafilisitiya.
Ibizira n’ivyaha vyose wakoze uzobihanirwa, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nzogusubiriza mu nkoko ibikwiranye n’ivyo wakoze, kuko wakengereye indahiro yanje, ukava mw’isezerano nakugiriye.
Ariko nzokwibuka isezerano nakugiriye mu buto bwawe, nsubizeho isezerano ritazovaho.
Ni ho uzokwibuka ingeso zawe, wongere umaramazwe no kwakira benewanyu, mukurwawe na murumunawe. Nzobaguha nk’abakobwa bawe, ariko ivyo nta ho bihuriye n’isezerano nagiranye nawe.
Nuko nzokomeza isezerano ryanje nawe, maze uzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .
Ninamara kugutangira impongano y’ivyaha wakoze vyose, uzovyibuka umaramare, wifate ku munwa kubera isoni, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, sokoranya, wongere ucire umugani ab’inzu ya Isirayeli.
Ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Inkona niniya, y’amababa akomeye, ifise amoya maremare, ikagira n’amubi menshi y’amabara, yaje i Libani. Ihagarara ku gatwe k’igiti c’isederi,
ivuna agatwetwe k’ico giti igatwara mu gihugu c’abadandaji, igatera mu gisagara badandarizamwo.
Ifata akabuto kamwe mu mbuto zo mu gihugu, igatera mw’ivu rimera. Igatera hafi y’amazi menshi,
karamera, karakura, kaba umuzabibu. Amashami yawo yakura aduga yerekeza kuri ya nkona, imizi na yo igashorera mu kuzimu. Nuko kaba umuzabibu, ugira amashami, n’amababi menshi cane.
Ariko hariho n’iyindi nkona nini y’amababa n’amoya akomeye cane. Maze wa muzabibu werekeza imizi yawo kuri yo, uhereye aho wari utewe, uyihindukirizako n’amashami kugira ngo iwuvomere.
Wari watewe mw’ivu ryiza, i ruhande y’amazi menshi, kugira ngo uzogire amashami, wame ivyamwa, ube umuzabibu mwiza cane.’

Ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Mbega uwo muzabibu uzobaho? Mbega ntuzorandurwa, ukamurwako ivyamwa hanyuma ukuma? Udututuje kuri wo twose tuzokwuma, kandi ntibizosaba inguvu z’abantu benshi mu kuwurandura.
Niwasubira kubadikwa hoho uzonaga? Ntibishoboka, uzokwuma uherengetere umuyaga wo mu buseruko niwawuhuha. Uzokwumira muri iryo vu ryiza wakuriyemwo.’ ”
Maze Uhoraho ambwira ijambo ati:
“Bwira abo bantu b’abagarariji uti: ‘Ibi ntimuzi ico bisigura?’ Babwire uti: ‘Umwami w’i Babiloni yagiye i Yerusalemu, atwara umwami n’abatware baho, abajana i Babiloni.
Maze afata umwe wo mu nda y’ingoma agirana isezerano na we, aramurahiza. Arongera kandi atwara n’abatware bo muri Isirayeli,
kugira ngo ubwami bucishwe bugufi, ntibuzosubire kwivyukiranya, buze bubeshweho gusa no kuzigama iryo sezerano.

Ariko Umwami aramugarariza, arungika intumwa muri Egiputa, ngo amuhe amafarasi n’ingabo nyinshi. Mbega azomunesha? Mbega uwukora nk’ivyo azocika kw’icumu? Azorenga kw’isezerano hanyuma bikunde ko arokoka?

Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kwanje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze, azogwa i Babiloni, mu gihugu c’umwami yari yamushize ku ngoma, uwo yarenze ku ndahiro yari yamurahije, agahonyanga isezerano bagiraniye.
Farawo n’ingabo ziwe zikomeye, hamwe n’imikogote yiwe nta co azomumarira mu ntambara, igihe bazokwubaka ivyo kwuririrako bakugariza Yerusalemu kugira ngo batikize benshi.
Kuko yakengereye indahiro yarahiye, akarenga kw’isezerano. Kubera yuko yari yamanitse ukuboko arahira, hanyuma akaba yakoze ivyo vyose, ntazorokoka.
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kwanje, nzomuhanira kurenga isezerano no gukengera indahiro yarahiye ku mugaragaro mw’izina ryanje.
Nzomutega umutego wanje ndamufate, mpeze ndamujane i Babiloni, ndamucirireyo urubanza kuko yancumuyeko.
Abasoda biwe bose bazohunga bamarwe n’inkota, abazocika kw’icumu na bo bazoshwiragizwa n’umuyaga. Ni ho muzomenya ko jewe Uhoraho ari jewe nabivuze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Jewe nyene ubwanje nzofata agatwetwe k’isederi ndakabadike; mbere nzoca agatwetwe ko hejuru cane koroshe, ndagatere ku mpinga y’umusozi muremure.

Nzogatera ku musozi ukirurutse wo muri Isirayeli; na ko kazoshamika, kame ivyamwa, kabe igiti c’isederi giteye igomwe. Inyoni z’ubwoko bwose zizoza zicarikemwo, ziyubakire inzu mu gitutu c’amashami yaco.

Ibindi biti vyose vyo mw’ishamba bizomenya ko jewe Uhoraho nsubiza hasi igiti kirekire, kigufi na co nkagikuza. Ibiti biremvye ndavyumisha, ivyumye na vyo ngatuma biremba. Ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze, kandi nzobikora.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mbega muri Isirayeli iyo muciye uwu mugani muti: ‘Abavyeyi barya inzabibu z’ibitumbwe, amenyo y’abana babo akaba ari yo ajigurwa,’ muba mugomvye kuvuga iki?
Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kwanje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze, uwo mugani ntimugisubira kuwukoresha muri Isirayeli.
Kuko abafise ubugingo bose ni abanje, abavyeyi co kimwe n’abana, bose ni abanje. Uwucumura ni we azopfa.
Iyumvire umugororotsi, akora ibitunganye kandi bibereye.
Ntarira mu bibanza basengeramwo ibigirwamana vyo ku misozi, canke ngo arabe ibigirwamana vya Isirayeli. Ntahumanya umugore w’umubanyi canke ngo aryamane n’umugore ari mu miziro yiwe.
Ntagunga abandi, ahubwo asubiza ingwati y’abo yari yaguranye. Ntiyigera yiba ahubwo agaburira indya ziwe abashonje, akambika n’abagenda gusa.
Ntatanga ingurane yiteze inyungu canke akandi karusho. Amaboko yiwe ayarinda gukora ikibi, agaca izibereye hagati y’abatase.
Akurikiza amabwirizwa yanje, akagendera no mu vyagezwe vyanje. Uwo muntu ni umugororotsi, kandi nta kabuza, azobaho, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Ariko aramutse avyaye umwana akaba inkozi y’ikibi, agasesa amaraso canke agakora n’ibi bibi bindi
(naho se ata na kimwe yakoze muri ibi): arira mu bibanza vyo gusengeramwo ibigirwamana vyo ku misozi, ahumanya umugore wa mugenziwe,
acinyiza abakene n’aboro, yiba, adasubiza ingwati y’abo yaguranye, asenga ibigirwamana, akora ibizira,
agatanga ingurane ashaka inyungu. Mbega umuntu nk’uwo yobaho? Oya na mba! Kubera ko yakoze ibizira nk’ivyo vyose, azopfa, kandi amaraso yiwe azomuharurwako.
Ariko aramutse avyaye umwana, uwo na we akabona ivyaha vyose se akora, ariko naho abibona, ntakore ibisa n’ivyo:
Ntarire mu bibanza vyo gusengeramwo ibigirwamana vyo ku misozi, canke ngo asenge ibigirwamana vyo mu nzu ya Isirayeli. Ntahumanye umugore wa mugenziwe.
Ntagunge umuntu n’umwe canke ngo yake ingwati uwo aguranye. Ntiyibe, ahubwo akagaburira abashonje, akambika abagenda gusa.
Akabuza amaboko yiwe gukorera ikibi abakene, ntagurane amahera arondera inyungu, akagendera mu vyagezwe vyanje, no mu mabwirizwa yanje. Uwo ntazozira ivyaha vya se; ni ivy’ukuri azobaho.
Ariko se azokwicwa n’ivyaha vyiwe, kuko yagunze abandi, akiba benewabo, agakora ibibi mu bwoko bwiwe.
Ariko murabaza muti: ‘Ni kubera iki umwana atazira ivyaha vya se?’ Nimba umwana azoba yakoze ibiroranye, agashira umutima ku gukurikiza amabwirizwa yanje, nta kabuza azobaho.
Uwukora ivyaha ni we azopfa. Umwana ntazozira ivyaha vya se, na se ntazozira ivyaha vy’umwana wiwe. Umugororotsi azokwezwa n’ubugororotsi bwiwe, kandi umunyakibi azoharurwako ibibi vyiwe.
Ariko umunyakibi niyahindukira akava mu vyaha vyiwe vyose, agakurikiza amabwirizwa yanje yose, agakora ibitunganye n’ibigororotse, nta kabuza azobaho; ntazopfa.
Ibicumuro vyose yakoze nta na kimwe kizomuharurwako. Kubera ibikorwa vyo kugororoka azoba yakoze, azobaho.
Mbega mwibaza ko nezerezwa n’urupfu rw’umunyakibi? Ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji abaza. Mbega sinezerezwa n’uko yova mu ngeso ziwe mbi, akabaho?

Ariko noneho, umugororotsi niyava mu bugororotsi bwiwe, agakora ivy’ukugabitanya hamwe n’ibizira nk’ivyo umunyakibi akora, mbega azobaho? Ivy’ukugororoka yakoze vyose nta na kimwe kizokwibukwa, kandi azopfa azize ivyaha yakoze.
Kandi muravuga muti: ‘Inzira y’Imana ntigororotse.’ Nimunyumvirize yemwe Bisirayeli: Inzira yanje ntigororotse? Ahubwo inzira zanyu ni zo zitagororotse.
Umugororotsi niyava mu nzira ziwe agakora icaha, azokizira; azopfa azize ivyaha azoba yakoze.
Ariko umunyakibi niyava mu vyaha vyiwe, agakora ibitunganye n’ibigororotse, azokiza ubugingo bwiwe.
Kuko azoba yiyumviriye ku vyo yakoze, hanyuma agahitamwo kubiheba, nta kabuza azobaho; ntazopfa.
Ariko Abisirayeli baravuga bati: ‘Inzira y’Imana ntigororotse.’ Mbega inzira zanje ni zo zitagororotse ga mwa Bisirayeli mwe? Inzira zanyu si zo zitagororotse?

Ni co gituma, yemwe Bisirayeli, nzobacira urubanza ruhwanye n’ingeso zanyu, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze. Niwihane! Va mu vyaha vyawe vyose; ni ho ivyaha vyawe bitazoba inyanduruko yo kuranduka.
Nimute kure ibicumuro vyanyu mwakoze, muhabwe umutima musha n’impwemu nsha. Ni igiki gituma mugomba gupfa, yemwe bantu ba Isirayeli?”
Sinezerezwa n’urupfu rw’umuntu n’umwe, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze. Nimwihane, mubone kubaho!
Cura intimba uririre abaganwa ba Isirayeli,
uvuge uti: “Nyoko yari iki? Yari intare y’ingore yibera hagati mu ntare! Yiryamira hagati muri zo, ikonsa ibibuguru vyayo.
Yareze ikibuguru kimwe, kiba intare ikomeye. Imenya guhiga, ndetse irya n’abantu.
Amahanga na yo yumva ivyayo, maze igwa mu mutego wayo. Ayikwegesha igera, ayijana mu gihugu ca Egiputa.
Ya ntare y’ingore iyirindiriye ikayibura, ivyizigiro vyayo birahera. Ica ifata ikindi kibuguru cayo, irakirera ikigira intare ikomeye.
Yagendana n’izindi ntare, maze iba umukangara w’intare ikomeye. Nuko imenya guhiga, ndetse itangura no kurya abantu.
Iyo ntare isenyagura ibirimba, itikiza n’ibisagara vyaho. Imirima icika ibisanze, ibiterwa biratikira. Ababa muri ivyo bihugu bose baterwa ubwoba n’ukuroha kwayo.
Ayo mahanga aza kuyigwanya, aturutse impande zose. Bayitega urusenga, igwa mu mutego wabo.
Bayikwegesha igera bayugaranira mu kazu gatoya, bayishira umwami w’i Babiloni. Bayishira mw’ibohero, ugutontoma kwayo ntikwaba kucumvikana ku misozi ya Isirayeli.
Nyoko yari ameze nk’umuzabibu uri mw’itongo, watewe i ruhande y’amazi menshi; warama kandi wari wuzuyeko amashami, kuko waronka amazi akwiye.
Amashami yawo yari akomeye, yari abereye kuvamwo inkoni z’abarongozi. Urakura uba muremure, ushika hejuru y’ibindi biti. Waraboneka gusumba ibindi kuko wari muremure, ukagira n’amashami menshi.
Ariko waranduranywe uburake, utererwa i musozi, umuyaga wo mu buseruko urawumisha, uhungurura ivyamwa vyawo; amashami yawo aruma, umuriro na wo urayatongora.
None ubu uwo muzabibu utewe mu bugaragwa, mu gihugu kitagira amazi.
Maze umuriro uturuka muri ya mashami, utongora ivyamwa vyawo vyose. Nta mashami akomeye yovamwo inkoni z’abami yasigaye kuri wo. Ukwo ni kwo gucura intimba, gukoreshwa igihe cakwo.”

headings.text: Gucura intimba ku bw’abaganwa ba Isirayeli

verses.text: Mu mwaka ugira indwi, mu kwezi kwa gatanu, ku musi w’icumi, bamwe mu batware ba Isirayeli baza gusiguza Uhoraho , bicara imbere yanje.
Maze Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:

“Mwana w’umuntu, bwira abatware ba Isirayeli, uti: ‘ Uhoraho Nyeninganji arabaza ati: Vy’ukuri mwaje kugira ngo munsiguze? Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kwanje, sindabemerera ko mugira ico munsiguza, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.’
Nta rubanza ubacira? Nta rubanza ubacira ga mwana w’umuntu? Bagirize na birya bizira ba sekuruza bakoze,

maze ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Umusi nahitamwo Isirayeli, narahiye ab’inzu ya Yakobo manitse ukuboko, ndabihishurira bari muri Egiputa. Manitse ukuboko ndababwira nti: Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Kuri uwo musi ni ho nabarahira ko nzobakura muri Egiputa, nkabajana mu gihugu nabateguriye, igihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki, igihugu gisumvya ibindi vyose kuba ciza.
Maze ndababwira nti: Umwe wese muri mwebwe nate kure ibishushanyo yahora ahanze amaso, kandi mureke kwihumanisha ibigirwamana vyo muri Egiputa, kuko ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.

Ariko barangararije banka kunyumvira. Ntibataye ibishushanyo bari bahanze amaso, canke ngo bahebe ibigirwamana vyo muri Egiputa. Ni ho naca mvuga ko nzobasukako uburake bwanje, nkabimarirako ishavu bakiri muri Egiputa.
Ariko sinabikoze, kuko nashaka gukingira izina ryanje kugira ngo ntiritukirwe mu maso y’amahanga babamwo; kuko yari yarambonye niyerekana mu gukura Abisirayeli muri Egiputa.
Ni ho nabakura muri Egiputa, nkabatwara mu bugaragwa.
Ni ho nabahereye amategeko yanje, ndabamenyesha n’ivyagezwe vyanje, ndababwira ko uwuzoyakurikiza azobaho.
Nongera ndabaha Isabato yanje nk’ikimenyetso hagati yanje na bo, kugira ngo bamenye ko jewe Uhoraho ari jewe ndabeza.

Ariko abantu ba Isirayeli barangarariza mu bugaragwa, ntibakurikiza amategeko yanje, bava mu vyagezwe vyanje, kandi uwari kubikurikiza vyari gutuma abaho, bahumanya amasabato yanje. Maze ndavuga nti nzobasukako uburake bwanje, ndabatikirize mu bugaragwa.
Ariko, ku bw’izina ryanje, nakoze ivyatuma ridatukirwa mu maso y’amahanga, amwe yambona nkura Abisirayeli muri Egiputa.
Maze nca ndongera manika ukuboko, ndabarahirira mu bugaragwa ko ntazobashikana mu gihugu c’isezerano ngo ndakibegurire, igihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki, igihugu gisumvya ibindi kuba ciza.
Ivyo nabibabwiye kuko bari bataye ivyagezwe, bakanka gukurikiza amabwirizwa yanje, bagahumanya n’amasabato yanje. Imitima yabo bari bayeguriye ibigirwamana vyabo.
Ariko ndabagirira impuhwe, sinabarandura canke ngo ndabaherengetereze mu bugaragwa.
Nabwiriye abana babo mu bugaragwa nti: Ntimuzokurikize amabwirizwa ya ba so, canke ngo mugendere mu vyagezwe vyabo, canke ngo mwihumanishe ibigirwamana vyabo.
Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu; nimukurikize amabwirizwa yanje, mushire imitima yanyu mu vyagezwe vyanje.
Mweze Isabato yanje, kuko izoba ikimenyetso hagati yanje na mwe, kibibutsa ko ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.

Ariko abo bana na bo nyene barangarariza: Banka gukurikiza amabwirizwa yanje, ntibashira imitima yabo ku mabwirizwa yanje, n’aho uwari kuyakurikiza ari yo yari gutuma abaho, bongera bahumanya Amasabato yanje. Ni ho navuga ko nzobasukako uburake bwanje, nkabimarirako ishavu mu bugaragwa.
Ariko narisubiyeko kubera nanka ko izina ryanje ritukwa n’amahanga yambonye ndabakura muri Egiputa.
Nongera manika ukuboko ndarahira ko nzobasabagiriza mu mahanga, nkabashwiragiza mu bihugu,
kuko batakurikije amabwirizwa yanje, bakava mu vyagezwe vyanje, bagahumanya Amasabato yanje, amaso yabo bakayahanga ibigirwamana vya ba se.
Nuko ndabaha amabwirizwa atari meza, n’ivyagezwe bitobabeshaho,
ndabareka bihumanisha ingabire nabahaye, ndabareka bashikanira imana zabo ibimazi vy’abana babo b’imfura, kugira ngo ndabateze agahinda, bamenye ko ndi Uhoraho .’
None rero mwana w’umuntu, bwira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ba sogokuruza barantutse mu kunta;

kuko igihe nabashikana mu gihugu nari nararahiye ko nzobaha, bashikanye ibimazi, baturirira ibimota neza mu bibanza basengeramwo ibigirwamana vyo ku misozi yose miremire, no musi y’ibiti vyose bitotahaye. Ni ho batangiye ibimazi vyo gukabura ishavu ryanje. Ni ho bashikaniye amashikanwa y’ibiturirwa bikamota neza, n’ibinyobwa.
Maze ndababaza nti: Ivyo bibanza vyo ku misozi mwama mujamwo ni ibiki?’ ” Gushika n’ubu biracitwa ibibanza vyo mu mataba y’imisozi.

“None rero bwira inzu ya Isirayeli, uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Muzogeza ryari kwihumanisha ibishushanyo nk’uko ba sogokuruza banyu bavyihumanishije, mugasambana n’ibizira vy’ibigirwamana vyabo?

Kuko iyo mubishikaniye ingabire nabahaye, mu gutanga abana banyu b’imfura ku gicaniro, muba muriko murihumanisha ibigirwamana vyanyu gushika n’ubu. None mwumva noshobora nte kubareka ngo mugire ico munsiguje, yemwe Bisirayeli? Ndabarahiye ukubaho kwanje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze, sinzobareka ngo munsiguze ikintu na kimwe.
Muravuga muti: Tugomba kumera nk’ayandi mahanga n’ayandi moko yo kw’isi, asenga ibiti n’amabuye.’ Ariko ivyo mwiyumvira ntibizoshika.
Ndabarahiye ukubaho kwanje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze, nzobaganzisha ukuboko kw’inkomezi, ndabaramvurireko ukuboko kwanje, ndabasukeko uburake bwanje.
Nzobegeranya ndabakure mu mahanga no mu bihugu nabashwiragirijemwo, ndabazanishije ukuboko gukomeye, ukuboko kuramvuye, mu gusuka uburake bwanje.
Nzobatwara mu bugaragwa mbakuye muri ayo mahanga, abe ari ho ndabahanira imbonankubone.
Nk’uko nahaniye ba sogokuruza banyu mu bugaragwa bwo mu gihugu ca Egiputa, ni ko namwe nzobahana, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Nzobacisha musi y’inkoni yanje, maze ndabarongorere mw’isezerano ryanje.
Nzobakuramwo abangarariza bose bakancumurako. Naho nzobakura mu bihugu bajanywemwo nk’inyagano, ntibazokwinjira mu gihugu ca Isirayeli. Ni ho muzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .

Ariko mwebwe bantu ba Isirayeli, uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndababwiye: Umuntu wese muri mwebwe nagende akorere ikigirwamana ciwe! Ariko muzoteba munyumvirize, kandi izina ryanje ntimuzosubira kuritukishisha amashikanwa yanyu n’ibigirwamana vyanyu.

Kuko ku musozi wanje wera, ni wo musozi muremure wa Isirayeli, ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze, muri ico gihugu, ni ho ab’inzu ya Isirayeli bose bazonsengera, kandi nanje nzobemera. Ni ho muzonshikanira amashikanwa yanyu atoranijwe, hamwe n’ibimazi vyanyu vyejejwe.
Nzobakira nk’ibiturirwa bikamota neza, ninabakura mu yandi mahanga, nkabegeranya muvuye mu bihugu mwasanzariyemwo, kandi nzobereka ukwera kwanje imbere y’amahanga.
Ni ho muzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho , ninabashikana mu gihugu ca Isirayeli, igihugu narahiye manitse ukuboko ko nzoha ba sogokuruza.
Ni ho muzokwibuka ingeso zanyu n’ibikorwa mwihumanishije. Muzokwizinukwa ku bw’ibibi vyose mwakoze.
Muzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho ninabikora uko kubera izina ryanje, ntaravye ingeso zanyu mbi n’ibikorwa vyanyu bihumanye, yemwe Bisirayeli, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, raba mu bumanuko, vuga ubutumwa uburire abari mu bumanuko kandi uvugishwe uburire ikibira co mu bumanuko.

Ubwire ishamba ryo mu bumanuko uti: ‘Niwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho . Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ngiye kuguturira, kandi nzotongora ibiti vyawe vyose, ibitotahaye n’ivyumye. Imbeya zawo ntizizozima, kandi ikintu cose uhereye mu bumanuko ukageza mu buraruko kizobabuka.
Abantu bose bazobona ko ari jewe Uhoraho nawudometse, kuko ntuzigera uzima.’ ”
Maze ndavuga nti: “Ewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, erega bazovuga bati: ‘Mbega uwu avuga mu migani gusa?’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri jewe riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, hanga amaso yawe Yerusalemu, uvugishwe werekeza ku rusengero, hamwe n’igihugu ca Isirayeli,
uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ehe ngiye kukugwanya. Nzokura inkota yanje mu rwubati ndandure abanyakibi n’abagororotsi bose hamwe.
Ko nzokwica abanyakibi n’abagororotsi, inkota yanje izova mu rwubati, izokwica idasize n’umwe uhereye mu bumanuko ugashitsa mu buraruko.
Maze abantu bose bazomenya ko ari jewe Uhoraho nakuye inkota mu rwubati; kandi sinzoyisubizayo itarangije igikorwa.’
None rero, mwana w’umuntu, boroga! Borogera imbere yabo, wuzuye intimba n’agahinda.

Nibakubaza bati: ‘Ni kubera iki uboroga?’ Ubishure uti: ‘Ni kubera inkuru numvise z’ibigiye gushika. Umutima wose uzoshongeshwa n’ubwoba, n’amaboko yose adendebukirwe; imitima izocika ivutu, amavi yose azoregarega, acike amazi. Bigiye kuza! Nta kabuza bizoshika, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, vugishwa, uvuge uti: ‘Uku ni ko Imana ivuze: Inkota, inkota ikarishe cane kandi ikayangana,
yakarihirijwe gusogota ihanagurwa ngo ice ibibatsi nk’imiravyo! Mbega hari uwotwenga? N’ababasumvya inkomezi barahindikiranye musi y’ububasha bwayo.
Inkota yateguwe ngo ihanagurwe, ishirwe mu kuboko; iriko irakarishwa yongera ihanagurwa ngo ishirwe mu kuboko kw’uwuririka.
Mwana w’umuntu, koma induru uboroge; kuko iteguriwe abantu banje, n’abaganwa bose ba Isirayeli. Bashitsweko n’inkota bari kumwe n’abantu banje. None rero niwikubite mu gikiriza.
Ico gipimo ntikizobura kuza. Ariko bizomera gute kuri iyo nkoni y’ubwami, inkota niyayikengera, maze ikayibuza kubandanya? Ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji abaza.
None rero mwana w’umuntu, vugishwa ukubita amashi ku yandi. Reka iyo nkota ikubite kabiri, ndetse na gatatu. Ni inkota yo gusogota, kandi ni iyo kuririka cane, ibakikuje impande zose.
Imitima yabo nishongeshwe n’ubwoba, n’abahindikirana babe benshi. Nayiteguriye gutikiza, kandi iri ku marembo yabo yose. Raba! Yakozwe ngo ikubite kurya kw’umuravyo, yakiriwe ngo itikize.
Wa nkota we, rabagiza i buryo, hanyuma ubangurirwe i bubamfu, uhindukirire iyo ubugi bwawe buraba hose.
Nanje nzokubita amashi ku yandi, ishavu ryanje rigabanuke, ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze.’ ”
Uhoraho antumako ijambo ati:
Mwana w’umuntu, shiraho inzira zibiri, izo inkota y’umwami w’i Babiloni izocamwo. Ushire ikimenyetso ku nzira izanana mu gisagara c’i Babiloni, aho yigaburiramwo kabiri.
Ushire ikimenyetso ku nzira inkota izocamwo, kimwe ku nzira ija i Raba h’Abamoni, ikindi ku yija i Buyuda mu gisagara kizitiye ari co Yerusalemu.
Kuko umwami w’i Babiloni azohagarara ku mayirabiri, aho izo nzira zompi zishamikira, kugira ngo araguze. Azozungagiza imyampi, abaze ibigirwamana, asuzume ibitigu vy’ibikoko vyatanzweko ibimazi.

Maze ikigirwamana kiri i buryo kimwereke Yerusalemu, amarembo yaho azoyasenyaguze ibiti bininibinini, atange itegeko ryo gutikiza, bakome akaruru k’intambara, bubake ibigigira vyo gutera amarembo, arunde ibirundo vy’ivu vyo kwuririrako, ahakikuze kugira ngo ahatere.
Ariko ab’i Yerusalemu bazobifata nk’aho ari indagu y’ikinyoma, kuko bafise isezerano bagiranye na Babiloni. Ariko umwami w’i Babiloni we azobibutsa ivyaha vyabo, aheze abatere, abatware nk’inyagano.

None rero uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: “Kubera yuko, mwatumye ivyaha vyanyu vyibukwa mu kwerekana ubugarariji bwanyu, mukagaragaza ivyaha mu vyo mukora vyose, ni co gitumye mutwarwa nk’inyagano.
Nawe wa munyakibi we, wa muganwa wa Isirayeli, washikiwe n’umusi mubi, igihe co guhanwa kwawe kigiye cashika,
ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: ‘Ikureko umwitwikiro, wambure n’urugori rw’ubwami. Ntibizosubira kuba uko vyahoze: abaciye bugufi bazoshirwa hejuru, abashizwe hejuru na bo bazocishwa bugufi.
Umusaka! Umusaka! Nta kabuza nzohahindura umusaka! Urugori rw’ubwami ntiruzosubira kwambarwa, gushika aho nyenerwo azozira, uwo ni we nzoruha.’
Nawe mwana w’umuntu, vugishwa uvuge uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji abwiye Abamoni, ku bw’ibitutsi vyabo: Inkota, inkota, isokowe ngo isogote. Ihanaguwe ngo itikize, ikayangana nk’umuravyo!

Naho mufise indoto zibesha zivuga ibiberekeye n’indagu z’ibinyoma babaraguriye, izoshirwa ku mazosi yanyu abanyakibi bategerezwa gusogotwa, abo igihe cabo cashitse, kandi abo igihe cabo co guhanwa cabaye ntarengwa.
Ubu subiza inkota mu rwubati, kuko mu kibanza waremewemwo, mu gihugu ca ba sekuruza, ni ho nzogucira urubanza.
Nzogusukako uburake bwanje, ndakwimarireko ishavu. Nzokurekurira mu maboko y’inkozi z’ikibi bamenyereye kwica rubi.
Uzoba ibitoro vyo gucanwa, amaraso yawe aseseke mu gihugu cawe. Ntuzosubira kwibukwa; ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri jewe riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, uriteguye guca urubanza? Uriteguye gucira urubanza iki gisagara gisesa amaraso? Nuko nucagirize ibizira bakora,
ukibwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Yewe wa gisagara cikwegera guhona mu gusesa amaraso muri co, no mu kwihumanisha ibigirwamana,

amaraso washeshe atumye uba uwo gutsindwa n’urubanza, kandi uhumanijwe n’ibigirwamana wibaziye. Utumye imisi yawe yo gutikizwa ikwegereza, kandi ushitse ku mpera y’imyaka yawe. Ni co gituma nzoguhindura igitutsi ku banyamahanga, n’agatwengo ku bindi bihugu vyose.
Abari hafi n’abari kure bazogushinyaguriza, kuko wagize izina ribi, wuzuyemwo umuryano.
Raba ingene umuganwa wese ari muri Isirayeli akoresha igitugu ciwe mu gusesa amaraso.
Abakubamwo basuzugura ba se na ba nyina; bacinyiza ba kavantara, bakagirira nabi impfuvyi n’abapfakazi.
Wasuzuguye ivyera vyanje, umpumaniriza amasabato.
Muri wewe hari abadodobereza abandi bakicwa; muri wewe hari abagirira imisi mikuru mu mataba y’imisozi, bagakorerayo ibiteye isoni.
Muri wewe hari abasambanya abagore ba ba se; muri wewe hari abafata abagore ku nguvu bari mu miziro yabo.
Muri wewe, umugabo akora ibizira n’umugore w’umubanyi wiwe, uwundi agakora ibizira n’umukazana wiwe, uwundi na we agahumanya mushikiwe, uwo basangiye se.
Muri wewe, abantu bakira ibiturire kugira ngo basese amaraso, bakaka inyungu ku ngurane, kandi bakaka inyungu z’umurengera. Ikirengeye ivyo, mwarantaye, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Ehe nzokubita amashi ku yandi ku bw’inyungu z’umurengera watse no ku bw’amaraso washeshe muri wewe.
Mbega umutima wawe uzoshobora kwihangana canke amaboko yawe areme ku musi nzoguhanirako? Ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze, kandi nzobikora.
Nzobashwiragiza mu mahanga, ndabasanzaze mu bihugu vyose; kandi nzokuraho ubuhumane bwanyu.
Niwamara kuboneka uhumanye imbere y’ayandi mahanga, uzomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho .’ ”
Maze Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, ab’inzu ya Isirayeli bose bambereye nk’imyanda iva kw’ifeza. Bameze nk’imyanda iva ku butare bwitwa umujumbu, tini, icuma, irya myanda isigara iyo ubwo butare buciye mw’itanure.
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Kubera yuko mwese mwahindutse nk’imyanda iva ku butare, nzobegeraniriza i Yerusalemu.

Nk’uko umuntu yegeraniriza ifeza, umujumbu, icuma, umuringa na tini, mw’itanure ngo bishongeshwe n’umuriro, ni ko nzobegeranya mu burake n’ubushangashirwe bwanje, ndabashire mu gisagara hagati mushongereyo.
Nzobegeranirizayo ndabahuhishe uburake bwanje, mushongereyo.
Nk’uko ifeza ishongera mw’itanure, ni ko namwe muzoshongera muri Yerusalemu, ni ho muzomenya ko ari jewe Uhoraho nabasutseko uburake bwanje.”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, barira Isirayeli uti: ‘Uri igihugu gihumanye, kitazoronka imvura canke urume ku musi w’uburake bwanje.’
Abaganwa baco bakigiriyemwo inama z’ubugarariji, nk’intare itontoma itabagura ico yafashe; bica abantu ata co bazira, bakanyaga ubutunzi bwabo, bagapfakaza benshi bo muri co.

Abaherezi baho barenze ku vyagezwe vyanje, bahumanya ivyera vyanje; ntibatandukanya ivyejejwe n’ibitejejwe; bigisha ko ata tandukaniro hagati y’ibihumanye n’ivyejejwe; birengagije amasabato yanje, maze izina ryanje risuzugurirwa muri bo.
Abatware baho bameze nk’amabingira atabagura ico yafashe; barasheshe amaraso, bica abantu kugira ngo bashike ku nyungu mbi.
Abavugishwa baho ivyo bikorwa bibi babisiga irangi ryera mu kuvugishwa ibinyoma n’indagu z’ububeshi. Bavuga bati: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze,’ kandi Uhoraho ata na kimwe yababwiye.
Abo muri ico gihugu bahahaza abandi, bakabambura utwabo; bahahaza aboro n’abakene, bakarenganya ba kavantara, bakanka kubacira imanza ziroranye.
Kandi nararondeye muri bo umuntu n’umwe yosanasana uruzitiro rw’ubugororotsi, agahagarara imbere yanje ngo azibire igihengeri, agasengera igihugu ngo sindagitikize, ariko nta n’umwe naronse.
Ni co gituma nzogisukako ishavu, ndagitongoze umuriro w’uburake bwanje, ndabashitseko igihano c’ivyaha vyabo, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, habaye abagore babiri bavukana.
Bompi baba ba maraya muri Egiputa, batangura ubwo bumaraya bakiri bato. Aho ni ho amabere yabo batanguriye kuyakorakora, amabere y’ubusugi bwabo agakandakandwa.
Mukuru yitwa Ohola, murumunawe yitwa Oholiba. Bose bari abanje, kandi baravyaye abahungu n’abakobwa. Ohola ni Samariya, Oholiba na we ni Yerusalemu.
Ohola yagiye kuba maraya yari uwanje; ariko araheza agira abo yikundiye, ari bo banyentambara b’Abashuri.
Bari bambaye imyambaro isa n’ubururu, bari abatware n’abakuru b’ingabo, imisore iteye igomwe, bagendera ku mafarasi.
Nuko ahurumbira kuba maraya w’abahizi bo muri Ashuri, yihumanisha ibigirwamana vy’uwo wese yipfuje.
Ntiyigeze aheba ubumaraya bwiwe yatanguriye muri Egiputa, aho yahereye mu buto bwiwe asambana n’abagabo, bagakorakora ubusugi bwiwe, bakamwimarirako inyota yabo yose y’ubusambanyi.
Ni co catumye ndamurekurira mu maboko y’abo yikundiye ari bo Bashuri, bari baramutwaye umutima.
Baramwambuye bamusiga amenya, bamutwara abana, maze bamwicisha inkota. Maze ahinduka agatwengo mu bandi bagore bose kubera igihano yahawe.
Ivyo murumunawe Oholiba yarabibona, ariko we arushiriza kuba umusambanyi, ingeso ziwe zirononekara gusumba iza mukuruwe.
Na we nyene yakunze Abashuri: abatware, abakuru b’ingabo, abasoda bambaye neza, bagendera ku mafarasi, ndetse n’iyindi misore myiza yose.
Maze mbona ko na we yihumanije, ko yatwawe n’ingeso za mukuruwe.
Ariko Oholiba wewe yararengeje urugero muri ubwo bumaraya bwiwe, kuko yabonye ku mpome ibishushanyo vy’abagabo b’Abakaludaya, basize ibara ritukura,
bakenyeje imikanda mu rukenyerero, n’ibitambara ku mitwe yabo; bose basa n’abakuru b’ingabo z’i Babiloni mu Bukaludaya bagendera ku mafarasi, imvukira z’i Babiloni.
Akibakubise ijisho, arabipfuza, aca abatumako intumwa mu Bukaludaya.
Maze Abanyababiloni baza aho ari, basambana na we, bamuhumanisha ubusambanyi bwabo. Ariko amaze guhumanywa na bo, arabazinukwa.
Igihe yakora ubwo bumaraya bwiwe ku mugaragaro, akagaragaza ubwambure bwiwe, naramuzinutswe nk’uko nari nazinutswe mukuruwe.
Ariko akomeza kugwiza ubusambanyi bwiwe, yibuka imyaka y’ubuto bwiwe, igihe yari maraya muri Egiputa.
Hariya yikurikiriye abamusambanya, bari bafise ibitsina nk’ivy’indogoba, bagashuha nk’ifarasi.
Ewe Oholiba, uko ni ko wiyibukije ubusambanyi bwo mu buto bwawe ukiri muri Egiputa, igihe igikiriza cawe bagikorakora, amabere yawe agakandakandwa.
