None rero ewe Oholiba, uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: ‘Ehe ngiye kukurekurirako barya wikundiye, hanyuma ukabazinukwa, bagutere baturutse impande zose.

Abanyababiloni hamwe n’Abakaludaya bose bazozanana, abagabo b’i Pekodi, i Showa n’i Kowa hamwe n’Abashuri bose bazozanana na bo, imisore myizamyiza, irimwo abatware, abakuru b’ingabo, abagendera ku mafarasi, hamwe n’abashizwe hejuru, bose baze ku mafarasi.

Bazogutera bitwaje ibigwanisho, imikogote, hamwe n’abasoda benshi. Bazogukikuza impande zose, bitwaje inkinzo nininini na ntonto, bambaye n’inkofero z’ivyuma. Nzokurekurira mu maboko yabo baguhane, kandi baguhane bakurikije amategeko yabo.

Nzokurekurirako ishari ryanje, maze na bo bazoguhanana uburake. Bazoguca izuru n’amatwi, kandi amasigarira azomarwa n’inkota. Abahungu n’abakobwa bawe bazotwarwa nk’inyagano, abazosigara na bo bazotongorwa n’umuriro.
Bazokwambura ivyambarwa vyawe, bagutware udusharizo twose.
Ukwo ni ko nzoshira iherezo ku bumaraya bwawe buteye isoni watanguriye muri Egiputa. Ivyo ntuzosubira kubiraba, canke ngo umutima wawe wipfuze kwibuka ivyo muri Egiputa.
Kuko uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ngira ndakurekurire mu minwe y’abo wanka, abo wazinutswe.
Bazoguhanana urwanko rwinshi, bagutware ivyo wabiriye akuya. Bazokwambura bagusige uri gusa, n’isoni z’ubumaraya bwawe zizoshirwa ahabona. Ubusambanyi bwawe buteye isoni
ni bwo bugukwegeye ivyo, kuko wasambanye n’ayandi mahanga, wihumanisha ibigirwamana vyayo.
Wagendeye mu ngeso za mukurwawe, none nzoguhanisha ivyago vyamuranduye.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Uzonywera ku gikombe ca mukurwawe, igikombe cagutse kandi kinini; nzotuma bagucokora kandi bagutwenga, kuko igikombe cawe cuzuye.
Uzokwuzura akaborerwe n’imibabaro, igikombe c’ukurandurwa n’ukuba akahebwe, ni co gikombe ca mukurwawe Samariya.
Uzokinywa uciranguze; uzokimenagura ugihekenya, hanyuma witabagure igikiriza kubera umubabaro. Ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Ni co gituma Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuga ati: Ko wanyibagiye ukampa umugongo, utegerezwa kwemera ingaruka z’ubusambanyi bwawe buteye isoni.’ ”
Uhoraho yongera arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, cira urubanza Ohola na Oholiba. Bamenyeshe ibizira bakora,
kuko babaye abasambanyi, kandi bakaba bafise amaraso ku maboko yabo. Basambanye n’ibigirwamana vyabo; babishikanira ibimazi vy’abana babo, abo bari bamvyariye, babahindura ivyokurya vyabo.
Ikindi bankoreye ni iki: bahumanije Ingoro yanje, amasabato yanje ntibayaziririza.
Umusi batanga ibimazi vy’abana babo ni ho binjira mu Ngoro yanje gusenga. Ng’uko uko bahumanije Ingoro yanje.
Batumyeko n’abagabo ba kure cane, na bo baraza. Bababonye baca bariyuhagira, barituganya mu maso, barashaza.
Baca bicara ku buriri bwiza cane, batunganya n’imeza imbere yabo, babatega ibiturirwa bikamota neza n’amavuta ya elayo, kandi vyari ivyanje.
Inzu zabo zamamwo urwamo rw’abagabo benshi, imborerwa, abo batumyeko bakava mu bice bitandukanye vy’ubugaragwa, bambitse ibikomo abo bagore ku maboko babambika n’ingori nziza cane ku mitwe.
Maze ndavuga ivy’uwo yabaye akaheze kubera ubusambanyi nti: ‘Nibamukoreshe ubumaraya kuko asanzwe ari we.
Nuko basambana na we. Nk’uko abagabo basambana na ba maraya, ni ko basambanye n’abo bagore babiri, Ohola na Oholiba.
Ariko abagabo b’abagororotsi bazobacira urubanza, bahane abo bagore basambana bagasesa amaraso, kuko ni abasambanyi, kandi ibiganza vyabo vyuzuyeko amaraso.
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nimuhagurutse igitero kuri bo, bacike ivutu, kandi mubasahure ivyabo.
Ico gitero kibatere amabuye, congere kibatemaguze inkota; baze bice abahungu n’abakobwa babo, baturire n’amazu yabo.
Uko ni ko nzoherengeteza ibiterasoni vyo muri iki gihugu, kugira ngo mburire abandi bagore bose ntihagire uwuzokwigana ingeso zanyu.
Muzosubirizwa mu nkoko ibikwiranye n’ivyaha vy’ugusenga ibigirwamana mwakoze. Ni ho muzomenyera ko ndi Uhoraho Nyeninganji.’ ”
Mu mwaka ugira icenda, mu kwezi kw’icumi, ku musi w’icumi, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri jewe riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, wandike iyi tariki ahantu, kuko umwami wa Babiloni ateye Yerusalemu uwu musi nyene.
Cira umugani ab’iyi nzu y’abagarariji, uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Shira inkono ku ziko, uyishiremwo n’amazi.
Shiramwo imisoso y’inyama, ushiremwo nzizanziza; ukuguru n’ukuboko. Uheze uyuzuze n’amagufa mezameza,
ufate intama ya mbere nziza; maze wegenyeze inkwi nyinshi musi y’iyo nkono, kugira ngo ibire cane amagufa ariyo ashane n’inyama.

Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: ‘Uzobona ibara, yewe wa gisagara gisesa amaraso, umeze nk’inkono itigera yozwa, yuzuye umwanda utavako. Bayikuramwo inyama imwimwe, uko zivayo kwose kuko nta yiruta iyindi.
Kuko amaraso casheshe akiboneka hagati muri co. Cayasheshe ku rutare; nticayasheshe hasi ngo umukungugu uyapfuke.
Mu kugwiza uburake no kwihora, nanje nasutse amaraso yiwe ku rutare, kugira ngo ntaze yigere azimangana.
Kandi kubera ivyo, uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Uzobona ibara wa gisagara gisesa amaraso! Nanje nzokwegenyezamwo inkwi nyinshi.
Komanya inkwi nyinshi, ucane umuriro. Canira neza inyama, uzongeremwo ibirungo, gushika n’amagufa ashe neza.
Maze utereke inkono igaragara ku makara, kugira ngo ivyo ikozwemwo bishuhe cane, mbere n’umwanda wose uri muri yo ushonge, n’ibibi vyose biri muri yo bishe bihere.
Ariko ico umuntu yokora cose ni impfagusa; imyanda iyuzuyemwo ntizoyivamwo, naho hokoreshwa umuriro mwinshi.
Ariko imyanda yawe yabaye akaburarugero. Ko nagerageje kukwoza imyanda yawe ukanka, ntuzohumanuka, kiretse ndaguherejeko uburake bwanje.

Ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze! Igihe canje co gukora kirashitse. Sinzokwisubirako, kandi sinzogira imbabazi, kandi sinzonavyicuza. Nzogusubiriza mu nkoko ibikwiranye n’ivyo wakoze, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, ehe ngiye kugutwara icahora ari igihimbaro c’amaso yawe, kandi ntiwidoge canke ngo ukorore n’iryosozi.
Uzonihe unumye, kandi ntuzogandarire uwupfuye. Uzobohere igitambara cawe ku mutwe, wambare n’ibirato vyawe; ntuzokwipfuke ku munwa, kandi ntuzorye indya z’abagandaye.”
Nuko bukeye ndabibwira abantu, hanyuma ku mugoroba umugore wanje arapfa. Bukeye bwaho ndabigenza uko Uhoraho yabintegetse.
Maze abantu barambaza bati: “Tubwire ico ivyo uriko uragira bisigura kuri twebwe.”
Maze ndababwira nti: “Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rinzako riti:

‘Bwira ab’inzu ya Isirayeli uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ngiye guhumanya Ingoro yanje, iyo mwahora mwibaza ko ari yo nkomezi zanyu, umunezero w’amaso yanyu, ivyizigiro vy’ubuzima bwanyu. Abahungu n’abakobwa banyu mwasize inyuma i Yerusalemu bazomarwa n’inkota.
Namwe muzobigenze nk’uko nabigenjeje. Ntimuzokwipfuke ku munwa, canke ngo murye ivyokurya vy’abagandaye.
Muzogumize ibitambara vyanyu ku mitwe, kandi muzogume mwambaye ibirato vyanyu. Ntimuzogandare canke ngo murire; ariko muzokwicwe n’akabonge k’ivyaha mwakoze, maze umwe wese aborogane na mugenziwe.
Ezekiyeli azobabere akarorero. Muzobigenze nk’uko yabigenjenje. Ivyo nivyashika, muzomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho Nyeninganji.’ ”
Maze Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Nawe ga mwana w’umuntu, uwo musi nzokuraho inkomezi zabo, umunezero n’ubwiza bwabo, ibihimbaro vy’amaso yabo n’ivyipfuzo vy’imitima yabo, ntware abahungu n’abakobwa babo.
Kuri uwo musi nyene uwuhunze azoza aho uri aje kukubwira ivyabaye.
Uwo musi akanwa kawe kazokwuguruka, uganire na we, kandi ntuzosubira kunuma. Uzobabera ikimenyetso, na bo bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, hindukira utumbere igihugu c’Abamoni, maze uvugishwe kuri bo.

Ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho Nyeninganji. Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ko mwanezerewe igihe Ingoro yanje yahumanywa, igihugu ca Isirayeli kigasigara ari agahinga, Abayuda na bo bajanywe ari inyagano,
nzobarekurirako abantu bo mu buseruko babigarurire. Bazokwubaka amakambi yabo babike amahema mu gihugu canyu; bazorya ivyamwa vyanyu, banywe n’amata yanyu.
I Raba nzohahindura uburagiro bw’ingamiya, Amoni na ho ndahahindure aho intama zivyagira. Ni ho muzomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho .
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ko wakomye amashi ukiterera hejuru, umutima wawe w’ubugunge ukanezerezwa n’ugutikizwa kwa Isirayeli,
nzokuramvurirako ukuboko kwanje, ngutange ube iminyago y’amahanga. Nzoguca mu mahanga ngukure mu bihugu, nkurandure nguherengeteze. Ni ho uzomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho .’ ”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: “Ko Mowabu na Seyiri bavuze bati: ‘Ehe i Buyuda habaye nk’ayandi mahanga yose,’
ngiye guca icanzo i Mowabu mpereye ku bisagara, ibiri ku mbibe zaho, harimwo n’ibihesheje icubahiro igihugu, ari vyo Beti-Yeshimoti, Bayali-Meyoni na Kiriyatayimu.
Nzorekurira Mowabu n’Abamoni mu maboko y’abo mu buseruko, mube inyegu yabo, kugira ngo Abamoni ntibazosubire kwibukwa mu yandi mahanga,
kandi nzohana Mowabu. Ni ho bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: “Ko Abanyedomu bihoye Abayuda, vyababereye icaha gikomeye,

nuko rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nzoramvurira ukuboko kwanje kuri Edomu, nice abantu baho n’ibitungwa vyabo. Nzohasiga ari agahinga, kandi kuva i Temani gushika i Dedani, abaho bose bazomarwa n’inkota.

Nzokwihora Edomu nkoresheje ukuboko kw’abantu banje b’Abisirayeli, maze bazosubiriza mu nkoko Abanyedomu ibihwanye n’uburake bwanje; ni ho bazobona ukwihora kwanje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: “Ko Abafilisitiya bihoye Abayuda bafise umutima w’ubugunge, ngo babaranduze urwanko rwabo rwa kera,
nuko rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: ‘Ngira ndamvurire ukuboko ku Bafilisitiya, mperengeteze Abakereti, ndandure n’abasigaye ku nkengera z’ikiyaga.
Nzobashitsako ukwihora gukomeye, ndabahanishe uburake bwanje. Ni ho bazomenyera ko jewe Uhoraho ari jewe nabihoye.’ ”
Mu kwezi kw’icumi na rimwe, kw’umwaka w’icumi na kabiri, ku musi wakwo wa mbere, umwami Yehoyakini atwawe nk’inyagano, Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri jewe riti:

“Mwana w’umuntu, kubera ko Tiro banezerewe babonye Yerusalemu hasenyutse, bakavuga bati: ‘Ha! Amarembo y’amahanga arasenyutse, imiryango yaho iranyugurukiye. Hacitse agahinga, ariko jewe ngiye kuronka ubutunzi,’
Ni co gituma Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze ati: Ngiye kukugwanya, yewe Tiro, nzozana ihanga ryanje rigutere nk’uko ikiyaga gisuka imipfunda ku nkengera.
Bazosenyura inzitiro za Tiro, bahenagure iminara yaho; nzokubura ivu ryaho hasigare hameze nk’igitandara.
Hazosigara hameze nk’igitandara co mu kiyaga banikirako insenga z’abarovyi, ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze. Hazoba aho amahanga aza gutora iminyago,
kandi abahaba bose bazomarwa n’inkota. Ni ho bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .
Kuko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze nti: Mu Buraruko nzozana Nebukadineza, umwami w’i Babiloni, umwami aganza abandi bami, azanane n’amafarasi n’imikogote hamwe n’ingabo nyinshi, atere Tiro.
Azoranduza inkota ibisagara vyo mu gihugu hagati; ategure uburyo agutera, yubake ivyo kwuririrako inzitiro zawe, agutere yitwaje inkinzo.
Inzitiro zawe azozisenyuza ibiti bininibinini, iminara yawe ayihenuze ibigwanisho vyiwe.

Amafarasi yiwe azoba ari menshi ku buryo igihugu cose kizokwuzuramwo umukungugu. Inzitiro zawe zizotigitishwa n’urwamo rw’amafarasi y’intambara hamwe n’imikogote n’ivyo ikwega, mu gihe azoba ariko arinjira mu marembo, abasoda na bo binjira mu gisagara baca mu birengero.
Ibinono vy’amafarasi yiwe bizoca mu mabarabara yawe yose; bamarishe inkota abantu bawe, kandi inkingi zawe zikomakomeye zizosenyurirwa hasi.
Bazosahura ubutunzi bwawe, bibe ibidandazwa vyawe; bazosenyura inzitiro zawe, basenyure amazu yawe mezameza, amabuye bayaterere mu kiyaga, co kimwe n’imbaho zawe, ndetse n’umukungungu wawe.
Nzohoza urwamo rw’indirimbo zawe, kandi nta mirya y’inanga izosubira kwumvikana.
Nzoguhindura igitandara kigaragara, ube imbuga yo kwanikirako insenga z’abarovyi. Ntuzosubira kwubakwa, kuko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji abwiye Tiro: “Mbega ababa ku nkengera z’ikiyaga ntibazojugumira nibumva isenyerana ryawe, bakumva amaborogo y’abakomeretse hamwe n’ukwicwa kuzoba kuriko kurabera iwawe?
Abami bose bo ku nkengera z’ikiyaga bazova ku ntebe zabo z’ubwami, bambure amakanzu yabo n’inyambarabami zabo. Bazicara hasi buzuye ubwoba, bajugumira, kuko bazoba babonye ivyakubayeko.

Maze bazocura intimba ku bwawe, bati: ‘Ese ayo ubonye, yewe wa gisagara wahora uri rurangiranwa, abakibamwo bari abagabo ku kiyaga! Wari umunyabushobozi ku biyaga, wewe hamwe n’abantu bawe! Mwahoze muteye ubwoba ku bari babakikuje bose.
None ubu ababa ku nkengera z’ikiyaga bose barajugumiye kubera ugusenyuka kwawe; amazinga yose ahinze agashitsi abonye isenyerana ryawe.’
Jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze nti: ‘Ninakugira nk’agahinga, ukaba nk’igisagara catawe kera, nkagucokeza i bwina ikiyaga kikakurengako, amazi yaco akagupfuka,

ico gihe nzokumanura hamwe n’abaja mu rwobo, ahari ababayeho kera. Nzotuma uba i kuzimu, ahameze nk’ibihomoka vya kera, ujane n’abaja mu rwobo, kandi ntuzogaruka canke ngo usubire kuba kw’isi y’abazima.
Nzogushitsa kw’iherezo riteye ubwoba, kandi ntuzosubira kubaho. Uzoronderwa ariko ntuzosubira kubonwa, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, cura intimba uririre Tiro.
Bwira Tiro, igisagara cubatse ku nkengera z’ikiyaga, ihuriro ry’abadandaza bava mu mihingo myinshi, uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Yewe Tiro, uvuga uti: “Ubwiza bwanje ni akaroruhore.”
Imbibe zawe zishika mu kiyaga hagati, kandi abakwubatse bakugize mwiza cane.
Umeze nk’ubwato bunini wubakishijwe imbaho z’akajwari z’i Seniri, bakwongerako imbaho z’amasederi y’i Libani bakwubakira ibikenewe vyose kuri wewe.
Imirinzi y’i Bashani ni yo bakubaziyemwo intebe zawe na zo bazibaza mu mbaho z’akajwari ziva i Kupuro, bazishazisha amahembe y’inzovu.

Ibitambara vy’ubwato bwawe vyari bikozwe mu mpuzu zera derere ziva muri Egiputa, vyakubera nk’ibendera hejuru yawe; ibitambara vy’ubururu n’ibitukura biva ku nkengera za Elishahu ni vyo vyakubera ubwugamo.
Abagabo b’i Sidoni n’i Haruvadi ni bo basoza ubwato bwawe, kandi abanyabwenge bawe, yewe Tiro, ni bo bagendesha amato.
Abakurambere baciye ubwenge bava i Gebali bama mu bwato, kugira ngo basanure akantu kose gatiriganye. Amato yose yo mu kiyaga hamwe n’abayagendesha bama iwawe, baje kurondera ibidandazwa.
Abagabo bava i Buperesi, i Ludi n’i Puti ni bo bari bagize ingabo zawe. Bamanitse inkinzo n’inkofero vyabo ku nzitiro zawe, vyagaragaza ubwiza bwawe.
Abagabo b’i Haruvadi n’i Heleki ni bo bacungera umutekano w’inzitiro zawe ku mpande zose; abagabo b’i Gamadi bari mu minara yawe. Bamanitse inkinzo zabo ku nzitiro zawe, ubwiza bwawe baraburyohora.
Tarushishi mwahanahana ibidandazwa, kuko wari ufise ubutunzi bwinshi; bakaguha ifeza, n’ubundi butare, nawe ukabaha ibidandazwa.
Ubugiriki, Tubali na Mesheki mwasangira urudandazwa; bakaguha abagurano n’ibindi bintu bikozwe mu mwakaka, nawe ukabaha ibidandazwa vyawe.
Abagabo bava i Beti h’i Togaruma baguha imikogote ikwegwa n’amafarasi, hamwe n’amafarasi y’intambara, n’inyumbu, nawe ukabaha ibidandazwa.
Abagabo b’i Dedani mwahana ibidandazwa, kandi abo ku nkengera z’ikiyaga basumira iwawe; bakuriha amahembe y’inzovu n’ibiti vyitwa ebene.
Siriya mwahanahana ibidandazwa, kuko wari ufise vyinshi; bakakuzanira amabuye y’agaciro, ibitambara bitukura, ivyera, n’impuzu z’amabara.
Ubuyuda na Isirayeli mwarahanahana ibidandazwa; bakuzanira ingano z’i Miniti hamwe n’ifu, insukoni nziza, ubuki, amavuta ya elayo, hamwe n’ibirungo.
Damasiko mwahanahana ibidandazwa kuko wari ufise vyinshi, bakakuzanira imivinyu y’i Heluboni hamwe n’ubwoya bw’intama z’i Zahari.
Abagiriki bavuye mu gisagara Uzali, baje kudandaza bakuzanira ibicuzwe mu vyuma, imbaho z’ikasiya, ibimota neza n’imisigati.
Ab’i Dedani bagushorako uburengeti basasa ku mafarasi.
Arabiya n’abaganwa bose b’i Kedari bashorera iwawe; intama n’amapfizi yazo, hamwe n’impene.
Abadandaza b’i Sheba n’i Rama mwahanahana ibidandazwa; bagashora ibirungo vy’ubwoko bwose, utubuye tw’agaciro turimwo n’inzahabu.
Harani, Kanehe na Edeni, hamwe n’abadandaza b’i Sheba, Ashuri na Kilimadi mwahanahana ibidandazwa.
Ku masoko yawe bahashora imyambaro myizamyiza, ibitambara vy’ubururu, impuzu zijererenze z’amabara menshi, ziteweko utugozi duhinze turiko amapfundo akomeye.
Amato y’i Tarushishi ni yo yagutwarira ibidandazwa. Amato maninimanini ni ho yuzurizwa imizigo minini uriko urarungika mu kiyaga.
Abasoza bawe baragutwaye bagushikanye kure mu kiyaga. Ariko umuyaga wo mu buseruko uzogusamburira hagati mu kiyaga.

Ubutunzi bwawe, ibidandazwa vyawe, abasoza bawe n’abagendesha ubwato, abadandaza bawe hamwe n’abasoda bawe bose, n’uwundi wese bazoba bari kumwe, bazodobezwa i bwina mu kiyaga, ku musi ubwato buzomeneka.
Ibisagara vyo ku nkengera z’ikiyaga bizojugumira nivyumva amarira y’abagendesha ubwato bawe.
Abasoza bazota amato yabo, abajejwe gutunganya ubwato bazokwururuka baje ku nkengera z’ikiyaga.
Bazoduza ijwi buzuye urwamo bakuririra; bazokwisurirako imikungugu ku mitwe, bikumbagaze mu minyota.
Bazokwimosha inkomvorera kubera wewe, bambare amagunira. Bazokuririra buzuye intimba mu mutima, bakugandarire buzuye umubabaro.
Mu kukuririra no mu kukuborogera bazocura intimba ku bwawe, bavuga bati: Mbega hari igisagara cari kimeze nka Tiro, ubu kidobejwe mu gacerere i bwina mu kiyaga?’
Igihe ibidandazwa vyawe vyasohoka ku kiyaga, wahaza amahanga; ubutunzi bwawe n’ibidandazwa vyawe vyatungishije abami bo mw’isi.
None ubu umenaguwe n’ikiyaga wibiye i bwina muri co; ibidandazwa vyawe n’abakozi bawe bitwariwe rimwe i bwina hamwe nawe.
Ababa ku nkengera z’ikiyaga bose barumiwe; abami babo bafashwe n’ubwoba, mu maso habo harijiriwe.
Abadandaza bo mu mahanga bavugije agahwa kubera wewe. Iherezo ryawe rihindisha agashitsi, kandi ntuzosubira kubaho.”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:

“Mwana w’umuntu, bwira abatware b’i Tiro uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Mu bwibone bwo mu mutima wawe uvuga uti: “Erega ndi imana; nicaye ku ntebe y’imana hagati mu biyaga.” Ariko uri umuntu nturi imana, naho wibaza ko unganya ubwenge n’imana.
Mbega usumvya ubwenge Daniyeli? Nta banga na rimwe udashobora kumenya?
Ubwenge bwawe n’ugutahura kwawe vyaguhesheje ubutunzi bwinshi, biguha ifeza n’inzahabu biba amatungo yawe.
Kubera ubumenyi ufise mu rudandazwa wagwije ubutunzi bwawe, kandi kubera ubwo butunzi bwawe, wagwije ubwibone mu mutima.
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ko wibaza ko uri umunyabwenge, ko ufise ubwenge nk’ubw’imana,
nzozana abanyamahanga bagutere, bavuye mu mahanga ateye ubwoba; bazosokora inkota bakumare ubwiza bw’ubwenge bwawe, ugukayangana kwawe bagusogote.
Bazokumanura mu cobo, kandi uzopfa rubi, ugwe i bwina mu kiyaga.
Mbega uzosubira kwirata uvuga uti: Ndi imana uri imbere y’abakwica? Uzoba uri umuntu buntu, ata bumana ufise uri mu maboko y’abagusogota.
Uzopfa urupfu rw’abatakebwe ugwe mu minwe y’abanyamahanga, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.’ ”
Maze Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ritumwa kuri jewe riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, cura intimba, uririre umwami w’i Tiro, uvuge uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Wari akaroruhore, wuzuye ubwenge, utunganye mu bwiza.

Wari muri Edeni, itongo ry’Imana; wari usharijwe n’amabuye yose y’agaciro: karuneliyani, krizoliti na emerodi, topazi, onigisi na yasipi, lapisi lazuli, turikwaze na berile. Vyose biteguwe neza hamwe n’inzahabu nziza; vyari vyaguteguriwe utararemwa.
Wari wasizwe amavuta ngo ube umukerubi murinzi, ni co nari narakurobanuriye. Wari ku musozi wera w’Imana ukagendagendera ku mabuye yakaka.
Wari inyankamugayo mu nzira zawe zose kuva umusi waremwa, gushitsa aho nagusangamwo ikibi.
Mu rudandazwa rwawe ruhambaye wari wuzuyemwo umuryano, bigutera gukora ivyaha. Ni co gituma nagutituye nkagukura ku musozi w’Imana, nkakwomora, yewe mukerubi murinzi, nkagukura mu mabuye yakaka.
Umutima wawe wawujujemwo ubwibone kubera ubwiza bwawe, wonona ubwenge bwawe kubera ubwiza bwawe. Ni co catumye ndaguta kw’isi, ugacika akabarore imbere y’abami.

Ubwinshi bw’ivyaha vyawe n’ubugunge mu rudandazwa rwawe, vyatumye uhumanya ingoro zawe. Ni co gituma nakuzanyeko umuriro uvuye muri wewe uragutikiza. Nakugize umunyota wo hasi mu maso y’abariko bararorera bose.
Amahanga yose yari akuzi arajorerwa; ingene iherezo ryawe rihindisha agashitsi, kandi ukaba utazosubira kubaho.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, hindukira urabe i Sidoni, uhavugishwako,
uvuge uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nzokugwanya, yewe Sidoni, kandi nzokwihesha icubahiro muri wewe. Uzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho ninamara kuguhana, nkakwiyerekanirako ko ndi uwera.
Nzoguteza icago, amaraso yawe azotemba mu mabarabara. Ubwicanyi buzoza muri wewe, inkota igutere izananye ku mpande zose. Maze abantu bose bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .
Abisirayeli ntibazoba bagifise ababanyi b’indyarya, bababaza nk’umukere, bagahanda nk’amahwa. Ni ho bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho Nyeninganji.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ninamara kwegeranya ubwoko bwa Isirayeli nkabukura mu mahanga bwasanzariyemwo, nzobigaragazako nk’uwera mu maso y’amahanga. Maze bazoba mu gihugu cabo, ico nahaye umusavyi wanje Yakobo.
Bazoba amahoro, biyubakire amazu, batere imizabibu; bazoba mu mahoro ninahana amahanga abakikuje yabahindutse. Ni ho bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho Imana yabo.’ ”
Mu mwaka ugira icumi, mu kwezi kw’icumi, ku musi w’icumi na kabiri, umwami Yehoyakini ari mu kinyago, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri jewe riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, hindukira uhange amaso Farawo, umwami wa Egiputa, umuvugishweko hamwe n’abantu bose ba Egiputa.

Umubwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nzokugwanya yewe Farawo, mwami wa Egiputa, wa gisizimwe kiryamye hagati y’inzuzi zawe. Kuko wibwira uti: Uruzi Nili ni urwanje; ni jewe narwiremeye.
Ariko nzoshira igera mu mibangabanga yawe, amafi yo mu nzuzi zawe ndayomeke mu bigaragamba vyawe. Nzogukwega ndagukure hagati y’izo nzuzi, uko wakabaye amafi yose yometse mu bigaragamba vyawe.
Nzoguterera mu bugaragwa, mwe n’amafi yo mu nzuzi zawe. Uzogwa mu gahinga, kandi nta wuzoguhamba, nta n’uwuzokwegeranya ibisigarira vyawe. Nzokugaburira ibikoko vyo kw’isi n’inyoni zo mu kirere.
Maze abo muri Egiputa bose bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho , mwabereye inzu ya Isirayeli icishimikizo kimeze nk’inkoni y’irenga.
Igihe bagufata ngo bakwishimikize wavunikiye mu maboko yabo, maze ubakomeretsa igitugu; igihe bakwegamira, waravunitse baca bagwira umugongo, bavunika amafyigo.
None rero uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Nzoguteza inkota, mponye abantu bawe n’ibitungwa vyabo.
Egiputa hazocika agahinga, habe amashamba. Ni ho bazomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho . Kuko wavuze uti: Uruzi Nili ni urwanje, ni urwo niremeye,
ni co gituma nzokugwanya, nkagwanya n’inzuzi zawe, igihugu ca Egiputa nkakigira agahinga, kuva i Migidoli gushika muri Asuwani no ku mbibe za Etiyopiya.
Nta maguru y’abantu canke y’ibikoko azosubira kugicamwo; kizomara imyaka mirongo ine atabakibamwo.

Egiputa nzokigira umusaka, kibe agahinga hagati mu bindi bihugu vyabaye agahinga, umugwa waho ube umusaka hagati mu yindi migwa yabaye imisaka. Abanyegiputa na bo nzobashwiragiza mu mahanga, basabagire mu bindi bihugu.
Ariko uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Inyuma y’imyaka mirongo ine nzokwegeranya Abanyegiputa ndabakure iyo bashwiragiriye.
Nzobakura mu buja, ndabasubize ruguru muri Egiputa, igihugu ca ba sekuruza babo. Ariko bazoguma ari ubwami butoya.
Buzokwama ari ubwami butoya mu bundi bwami, ntibuzokwigera busubira kwishira hejuru y’ayandi mahanga. Nzobugira ubwami buto cane, butazigera busubira kuganza ayandi mahanga.
Egiputa ntikizosubira kuba ivyizigiro vy’Abisirayeli, ariko kizoba icibutso c’icaha bakoze mu kugihindukirira ngo kibatabare. Maze Abisirayeli bazomenya ko ari jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji jenyene.’ ”
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri n’indwi, mu kwezi kwa mbere, ku musi wa mbere, umwami Yehoyakini ari mu kinyago, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri jewe, riti:

“Mwana w’umuntu, Umwami Nebukadineza, umwami w’i Babiloni, yakoresheje igikorwa kigoye ingabo ziwe mu kugwanya Tiro. Ingabo ziwe zahatobokeye ubuhanza, ibitugu vyabo vyuzurako inguma. Ariko yaba umwami, yaba ingabo ziwe, nta wagize ico akura muri Tiro ku bw’ibitero bagize kuri ico gisagara.
None rero uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Ngiye guha Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni Egiputa, atware ubutunzi bwaho. Azonyaga ivyo muri ico gihugu bibe impembo y’ingabo ziwe.
Nzomuha Egiputa nk’impera ku bw’igikorwa we n’ingabo ziwe bankoreye, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Ico gihe nzokwongera inkomezi Abisirayeli, kandi nawe Ezekiyeli, nzoguha ububasha kugira ngo ushobore kuvugana na bo. Ni ho bazomenyera ko jewe ndi Uhoraho .”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, vugishwa maze uvuge uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: ‘Koma induru uvuga uti: Ese umusi mubi!
Kuko uwo musi uri hafi, umusi w’ Uhoraho uri hafi, umusi wuzuye ibicu n’igipfungu, umusi wo gucira imanza amahanga.
Inkota izotera Egiputa, Etiyopiya hazokwuzura imibabaro. Abasogoswe bazogwa muri Egiputa, ubutunzi bwaho buzonyagwa, imfatiro zaho zisenyurwe.
Etiyopiya, Libiya, Ludi na Arabiya hose hamwe n’ayandi mahanga yari yifatanije na yo, azomarwa n’inkota hamwe na Egiputa.

Kuko ibi ari vyo jewe Uhoraho mvuze: Amahanga yifatanije na Egiputa azotemba, n’inkomezi bishimiye zizohinduka ubusa. Kuva i Migidoli gushika muri Asuwani bazomarwa n’inkota, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Hazohinduka agahinga, nk’ibindi bihugu vyahindutse agahinga, ibisagara vyaho bizotemba bibe nk’ibindi bisagara vyabaye imisaka.
Maze bazomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho , ninamara guturira Egiputa, ngatikiza abifatanije na co.
Uwo musi intumwa zizova imbere yanje, zifate amato zije gutera ubwoba Etiyopiya bibaza ko bari mu mahoro. Bazogira agahinda kuri uwo musi w’ivyago vya Egiputa, kandi uwo musi nta nkeka urashitse.
Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Nzozimanganya ingabo za Egiputa nkoresheje ukuboko kwa Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni.
We n’ingabo ziwe ziteye ubwoba, bazozanwa gutikiza igihugu. Bazosokora inkota zabo bagwanye Egiputa, igihugu cose bacuzuze imivyimba.
Nzokamya imigende y’uruzi Nili, igihugu na co ndakidandaze ku nkozi z’ikibi; Nkoresheje ukuboko kw’abanyamahanga, igihugu cose n’ibikirimwo nzobihindura ruhebwa, ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze.

Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Nzotikiza ibigirwamana vyabo, nkureho ibishushanyo vy’i Memfisi. Nta muganwa azosubira kurangwa muri Egiputa, kandi nzokwiragiza ugucika ivutu mu gihugu cose.
Amajaruguru ya Egiputa nzoyagira agahinga, ncane umucanwa i Zowani, ntange igihano kuri Tebesi.
Nzosuka uburake bwanje kuri Pelusiyumu, no ku nzitiro za Egiputa, n’abantu b’i Tebesi ndabakureho.
Nzoturira Egiputa, Pelusiyumu yicwe n’iminiho. Tebesi hazofatwa n’igihuhusi, Memfisi na ho hagume mu kabonge.
Imisore y’i Heliyopolisi n’i Bubasitisi izokwicwa n’inkota, kandi abanyagisagara na bo batwarwe nk’inyagano.
Umusi w’umwijima uzoshika i Tafanihesi igihe nzovuna ingogo ya Egiputa; aho ni ho inkomezi zaco zizoherera. Hazotwikirwa n’ibipfungu, imihana yaho yose itwarwe nk’inyagano.
Uko ni ko nzoshitsa igihano kuri Egiputa, kandi bazomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho .’ ”
Mu mwaka ugira icumi na kabiri, mu kwezi kwa mbere, ku musi w’indwi umwami Yehoyakini ari mu kinyago, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri jewe riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, navunye ukuboko kwa Farawo umwami wa Egiputa. Kandi ukuboko kwiwe ntikwunzwe ngo gukire gushobore gufata inkota.

Ni co gituma, ibi ari vyo jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Nzogwanya Farawo Umwami wa Egiputa. Nzomuvunagura amaboko yompi, ugukomeye n’ugusanzwe kuvunitse, maze inkota yiwe ive mu kuboko kwiwe ikorokere hasi.
Nzoshwiragiriza Abanyegiputa mu mahanga, ndabasanzarize mu bindi bihugu.
Nzokomeza ukuboko kw’umwami w’i Babiloni, ndamufatishe inkota yanje mu kuboko kwiwe, ariko nzovunagura amaboko ya Farawo, maze azonihira imbere yiwe nk’uwugira yicwe n’inguma.

Nzokomeza amaboko y’umwami w’i Babiloni, ariko amaboko ya Farawo nzotuma adendebukirwa. Maze bazomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho , ninashira inkota yanje mu kuboko kw’umwami w’i Babiloni, maze akayibangurira kugwanya Egiputa.
Nzoshwiragiriza Abanyegiputa mu mahanga, ndabasanzaze mu bihugu. Ni ho bazomenyera ko jewe ndi Uhoraho .”
Mu mwaka ugira icumi na rimwe, mu kwezi kwa gatatu, ku musi wakwo wa mbere umwami Yehoyakini ari mu kinyago, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri jewe riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, barira Farawo umwami wa Egiputa n’isinzi ry’abantu biwe uti: ‘Ni nde yogereranywa nawe mu bukuru bwawe?
Umeze nk’uko Ashuri hahora hameze hari nk’isederi ry’i Libani, amashami yaryo meza yapfuka ishamba, ryagera mu kirere, agasunwa karyo kagakora kw’ijuru.
Ryavomererwa amazi ava mu mariba agera i bwina, bigatuma rikura rikaba rirerire; inzuzi zarica hirya no hino y’imizi, imigende yazo ikavomera ibindi biti vyo muri iryo shamba.
Ni co catumye uburebure bwaryo buruta ubw’ibindi biti vyo mw’ishamba. Amashami yaryo yabaye menshi kandi aba maremare, riratagarara, kubera amazi menshi.
Ibisiga vyo mu kirere vyose vyaritse mu mashami yaryo, ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba na vyo bivyarira musi y’amashami yaryo. Amahanga akomakomeye yose yibera mu gitutu caryo.
Uko ni ko ryabaye irihambaye mu bwiza, hamwe no mu gusagarara kw’amashami yaryo, kuko imizi yaryo yashoreye mu mazi menshi.

Amasederi yo mw’itongo ry’Imana ntiyashobora kwigereranya na ryo, canke ngo amapinusi agereranye amashami yayo n’ayaryo, canke ibiti vyo mu kiyaya ngo bigereranye amashami yavyo n’ayaryo. Nta giti co mw’itongo ry’Imana canganya ubwiza na ryo.
Narigize ryiza cane ndariha amashami menshi, rikipfuzwa n’ibiti vyose vyo muri Edeni, itongo ry’Imana.
None rero uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Ko ryaduze hejuru cane, rigashitsa agasunwa hejuru y’ibicu, rikishimira uburebure bwaryo,
narirekuriye mu maboko y’uwuganza amahanga ngo aryishure ibihwanye n’ivyaha vyaryo. Jewe ubwanje nararyirukanye.

Ingabo ziteye ubwoba z’abanyamahanga ziraryiciye, zisiga riryamye hasi. Amashami yaryo agwa ku misozi no mu biyaya, ayandi avunagurikira ku migende y’amazi yose yo mu gihugu. Amahanga yose yari mu gitutu caryo avayo aragenda.
Ibisiga vyo mu kirere biraza biba ku mutumba waryo uryamye hasi, n’inyamaswa zo mw’ishamba ziraza zibera mu mashami yaco.

Ni co gituma ata giti co hafi y’amazi kizokwirata uburebure bwaco, canke ngo kiduze agasunwa kaco gushika hejuru y’ibicu. Nta n’ibikomeye vyo muri vyo bivomerewe neza bizoshikira ubwo burebure, kuko vyose bigenewe gupfa bikaja i kuzimu, co kimwe n’abamanuka baja mu rwobo.

Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Ku musi Ashuri yamanuwe ajanwa mu mva, iwabo w’abapfuye, amariba nayapfukishije ukumugandarira; nahagaritse imigende yaho, n’amazi menshi ndayagomera. Kubera we, nambitse Libani umwijima, n’ibiti vyo mw’ishamba vyose birakabirana.

Natumye amahanga ahinda agashitsi yumvise ukugwa kwiwe, igihe namumanura mu mva, iwabo w’abapfuye ngo aje kubana n’abamanutse bakaja mu rwobo. Maze ibiti vyose vyo muri Edeni, ivyiza kurusha ibindi vyose vyo muri Libani, ibiti imizi yavyo ishorera mu mazi, vyarahumurijwe no kumusanga i bwina mu kuzimu.
Na vyo nyene, co kimwe n’amasederi, vyaragiye iwabo w’abapfuye, aho abishwe n’inkota bari, aho bari kumwe n’abagabo bari bafise ibigwanisho, bakibera mu gitutu ciwe mu mahanga.

Mu biti vyo muri Edeni ni ikihe munganya ubwiza no gukomera? Ariko na wewe uzocishwa bugufi co kimwe n’ibiti vyo muri Edeni, mujanwe i kuzimu. Uzorambarara hagati y’abatakebwe, hamwe n’abicishijwe inkota. Abo ni Farawo hamwe n’amasinzi y’ingabo ziwe, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.’ ”
Mu mwaka ugira icumi na kabiri, mu kwezi kw’icumi na kabiri, ku musi wakwo wa mbere umwami Yehoyakini ari mu kinyago, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri jewe riti:

“Mwana w’umuntu, cura intimba uririre Farawo umwami wa Egiputa, umubwire uti: ‘Umeze nk’intare mu yandi mahanga, umeze nk’igisizimwe co mu biyaga. Wasimbagurika mu nzuzi, ukavurungisha amazi yazo ibirenge vyawe, ugatoba inzuzi.
Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Ndi kumwe n’ikoraniro ry’abantu benshi, nzogutera urusenga, na bo bazogukwegesha urwo rusenga rwanje.
Nzogushiburira i musozi, ngute mu gahinga. Nzoreka ibisiga vyo mu kirere bikugweko, inyamaswa zo mw’ishamba na zo zikurye zihage.
Nzosanzaza inyama zawe ku misozi ibisigarira vyawe ndavyuzuze mu biyaya.
Amaraso yawe atemba nzoyavomeresha igihugu gushika ku misozi, kandi ibiyaya bizokwuzura inyama zawe.
Ninakuzimya, nzotwikira ijuru, inyenyeri zaho ntizizokwaka; izuba nzoritwikiriza igicu, kandi ukwezi ntikuzobonesha.
Ibimurika vyo kw’ijuru vyose nzobizimya hejuru yawe; nzane umwijima hejuru y’igihugu cawe, ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze.
Nzohagarika imitima y’abantu benshi ninakurandurira mu mahanga, no mu bihugu utigeze umenya.

Nzotuma amahanga menshi ajorerwa kubera wewe, kandi abami bayo bazokwicwa n’ubwoba kubera wewe, ninakubangurirako inkota imbere yabo. Ku musi wo gutemba kwawe, umuntu wese azohinda agashitsi umwanya wose atinyirira ubuzima bwiwe.
Kuko uku ari ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Inkota y’umwami w’i Babiloni izokuzako.

Nzotuma ingabo zawe amasinzi zitemba, zimarwe n’inkota z’abagabo bakomeye, bamwe ba ruburakigongwe kurusha abo mu mahanga yose. Bazohindura ubusa ubwibone bwa Egiputa, kandi amasinzi y’ingabo zaho azotikira.
Nzotikiza ibitungwa vyose biri i ruhande y’amazi menshi, nta kirenge c’umuntu canke ibinono vy’ibikoko bizosubira gutoba ayo mazi.
Maze nzoheza ntume amazi ya Egiputa atekana, inzuzi zaho zitembe nk’amavuta ya Elayo, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Ninamara guhindura Egiputa agahinga, ngakuraho ivyari muri co vyose, ngatikiza abakibamwo bose, ni ho bazomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho .
Iyi ni yo ntimba bazocura. Abakobwa bo mu mahanga ni yo ntimba bazocura; ni yo bazocurira Egiputa n’amasinzi y’ingabo zayo, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.’ ”
Mu mwaka ugira icumi na kabiri, ku musi w’icumi na gatanu w’ukwezi kw’icumi na kabiri, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri jewe riti:
“Mwana w’Umuntu, borogera amasinzi y’ingabo za Egiputa, n’ayandi mahanga akomeye. Kuko nzobarungika i kuzimu mw’isi y’abapfuye hamwe n’abamanuka baja muri rwa rwobo.
Ubabwire uti: ‘Mbega hari ico musumbije abandi? Manuka murambararane n’abatakebwe.’
Abanyegiputa bazogwa hagati mu bishwe n’inkota. Inkota irasokowe, reka Abanyegiputa bakweganwe n’amasinzi y’ingabo zabo.
Hariya i kuzimu, iwabo w’abapfuye, abandi batware bakomeye bazovugira i kuzimu ivya Egiputa n’abifatanije na ho bavuge bati: ‘Baraje i kuzimu kurambararana n’abatakebwe, ari bo batikijwe n’inkota.’
Ashuri arambarayeyo ari kumwe n’ingabo ziwe zose; akikujwe n’imva z’abo yishe bose, abo yaririkishije inkota.
Imva zabo ziri i bwina mu rwobo, kandi ingabo ziwe zandagaye i ruhande y’imva yiwe. Abari bakwije iterabwoba kw’isi y’abazima bose, barishwe, barigitwa n’inkota.

Elamu ni yo ari, akikujwe n’imva z’ingabo ziwe. Bose barishwe, barigiswe n’inkota. Abari bakwije iterabwoba kw’isi y’abazima bamanutse i kuzimu badakebwe. Bajanyeyo ibimaramare vyabo bari kumwe n’abaja mu rwobo i kuzimu.

Yateguriwe uburiri hagati y’abandi bishwe, imva yiwe ikikujwe n’isinzi ry’ingabo ziwe. Bose ntibari barakebwe, kandi bishwe n’inkota. Kubera ko iterabwoba ryabo ryakwiye kw’isi y’abazima, bajanyeyo ibimaramare vyabo, bajana n’abaja mu rwobo i kuzimu; barambaraye hamwe n’abishwe.
Mesheki na Tubali ni yo bari, imva zabo zikikujwe n’amasinzi y’ingabo zabo. Bose ntibari barakebwe, kandi barigiswe n’inkota, kuko bakwije iterabwoba ryabo kw’isi yose y’abazima.

Ariko ntibahambanywe iteka nk’abandi bahizi ba kera bamanutse i kuzimu batwaye ibigwanisho vyabo, bagaseguzwa inkota zabo, bakagerekwako n’inkinzo zabo; naho abo bahizi na bo nyene bari barateye ubwoba isi yose y’abazima.
None, na wewe nyene Farawo, uzovunagurwa, urambikwe mu batakebwe, hamwe n’abarigiswe n’inkota.
Edomu ni yo ari, ari kumwe n’abami biwe, n’abaganwa biwe; naho bari abahambaye, barambaraye hamwe n’abishwe n’inkota. Barambararanye n’abatakebwe, abamanutse baja muri rwa rwobo i kuzimu.

Abaganwa bo mu buraruko hamwe n’ab’i Sidoni bose ni yo bari; bamanukanyeyo n’abishwe urw’agashinyaguro, naho inkomezi zabo zari ziteye ubwoba. Barambaraye batakebwe, bari kumwe n’abishwe n’inkota, buzuye ibimaramare hamwe n’abaja muri rwa rwobo i kuzimu.
Farawo, hamwe n’ingabo ziwe zose, azobabona ahumurizwe ku bw’amasinzi y’ingabo ziwe zishwe n’inkota, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.
Ariko naho natumye atera ubwoba abari mw’isi y’abazima, Farawo n’ingabo ziwe zose bazogwa hamwe n’intakebwa, hamwe n’abo barigiswe n’inkota, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.”

headings.text: Ukumanuka kwa Egiputa mu rwobo rw’abapfuye

verses.text: Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, barira abo bantu bo mu bwoko bwawe uti: ‘Ninazana inkota ku gihugu, hanyuma abantu bo muri co bagatoranya umwe muri bo ngo ababere umuteramyi,
hanyuma uwo muntu akabona iyo nkota ije akavuza inzamba aburira abantu,
maze hakagira abamwumva ariko bakirengagiza iyo mburi, ya nkota ikaza igatwara ubuzima bwabo, amaraso yabo azobaharurwako.
Kubera yuko bumvise ijwi ry’inzamba ariko bakirengagiza iyo mburi, amaraso yabo azobaharurwako, kuko iyo baza kwumvira iyo mburi bari kwikingira bagakira.

Ariko uwo muteramyi niyabona inkota ije hanyuma ntavuze inzamba ngo aburire abantu, maze ya nkota ikaza igatwara ubuzima bw’umwe muri bo, uwo muntu azopfira mu vyaha vyiwe, ariko uwo muteramyi nzomuharurako amaraso y’uwo muntu.’
Nawe mwana w’umuntu, nakugize umuteramyi w’inzu ya Isirayeli; none rero niwumve amajambo nkubwira, uheze ubaburire.
Ninabwira umunyakibi nti: ‘Ewe wa munyakibi, nta kabuza uzopfa,’ hanyuma nawe ntumuburire ngo ahindukire ave mu bibi vyiwe; uwo munyakibi azopfira mu vyaha vyiwe, ariko amaraso yiwe nzoyaguharurako.
Ariko niwaburira umunyakibi ngo ave mu nzira ziwe mbi hanyuma akanka, azopfira mu vyaha vyiwe, ariko weho uzoba ukijije ubugingo bwawe.
Mwana w’umuntu, barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Muvuga muti: Ibibi n’ivyaha vyacu biraturemereye, kandi biratwishe. Mbega tuzokira dute?’

Babwire uti: ‘Indahiro ni jewe nyene, ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze, sinezerezwa n’urupfu rw’umunyakibi, ariko ico ngomba ni uko yohindukira akava mu vyaha vyiwe akabaho. Nimuhindukire! Nimuhindukire muve mu nzira zanyu mbi! Ni igiki cotuma mwemera gupfa ga yemwe bwoko bwa Isirayeli?’

Ku bw’ivyo, mwana w’umuntu, bwira abantu bo mu bwoko bwawe uti: ‘Nimba umuntu asanzwe agororotse hanyuma agacumura, ubugororotsi bwiwe bwa mbere ntibuzomukiza niyasubira mu vyaha vyiwe. Kandi umuntu w’umunyakibi niyihana, ububi bwiwe bwa mbere yagendeyemwo ntibuzomutsindisha. Umugororotsi niyacumura, ntazokwemererwa kubaho naho yoba yahora ari umugororotsi.
Ninabwira umugororotsi ko azobaho, ariko akishimira ukugororoka kwiwe, agakora ivyaha, nta gikorwa na kimwe c’ubugororotsi yakoze kizokwibukwa; azopfa azize ivyaha yakoze.
Kandi ninabwira umunyakibi nti: Nta kabuza uzopfa, maze agahindukira akava mu vyaha vyiwe, agakora ibitunganye n’ibigororotse,
agasubiza ivyo yatse kw’ingwati ku ngurane, agasubiza ivyo yivye, agakurikiza ivyo nihanikiririje bitanga ubugingo, akirinda gukora ikibi; nta kabuza azobaho, ntazopfa.
Ivyaha vyose yakoze nta na kimwe kizomuharurwako; niyakora ibitunganye n’ibigororotse, azobaho.’
Yamara, ubwoko bwawe buravuga buti: ‘Inzira y’Imana ntigororotse.’ Ariko inzira zabo ni zo zitagororotse.
Umugororotsi niyava mu nzira ziwe agakora icaha, azokizira.
Kandi umunyakibi niyava mu vyaha vyiwe, agakora ibitunganye n’ibigororotse, bizomubeshaho.
Ariko mwebwe Abisirayeli muravuga muti: ‘Inzira y’Imana ntigororotse.’ Ariko nzobacira urubanza yemwe Bisirayeli, umwe wese agererwe ibihwanye n’ivyo yakoze.”
Mu mwaka ugira icumi na kabiri turi mu kinyago, mu kwezi kw’icumi, ku musi ugira gatanu, hariho umuntu yahunze avuye i Yerusalemu, aza aho ndi, ambwira ati: “Igisagara carasenyutse!”
Ariko uwo muntu buca ashika, ukuboko kw’Uhoraho kwari kuri jewe, yugurura akanwa kanje imbere y’uko uwo muntu anshikira mu gitondo. Akanwa kanje karuguruka, sinaba ngisubira kuguma mu gacerere.
Maze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:

“Mwana w’umuntu, ababa mu bihomoke vyo muri ico gihugu ca Isirayeli bavuga bati: ‘Aburahamu yari umugabo umwe wenyene akaganza iki gihugu cose. Ariko twebwe turi benshi, kandi igihugu twaragihawe ngo tucegukire kibe icacu.’
None rero genda ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ko murya inyama zikirimwo amaraso, mukarangamiza ibishushanyo, mugasesa amaraso, ico gihugu mwocegukira gute?
Mwishimira inkota zanyu, mugakora ibizira, umuntu wese agahumanya umugore wa mugenziwe. None mwokwegukira ico gihugu gute?’

Babwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kwanje, abasigaye mu bihomoke bazomarwa n’inkota, abari mu gihugu nzobaterera inyamaswa zibatabagure, abari mu mazu azitiriwe cane n’abari mu mazu yo mu kuzimu bazokwicwa n’icago.
Nzosiga igihugu ari agahinga, nkureho ivyizigiro vy’inkomezi zabo, kandi imisozi y’i Yerusalemu izosigara igaragara, nta n’uwuzosubira kuyicako.
Ni ho bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho , ninamara gusiga igihugu kigaragara kubera ibizira bakoze.’
Na we mwana w’umuntu, abantu bo mu bwoko bwawe bariko barakuvuganako bari ku nzitiro no ku miryango y’amazu, umwe wese abwira mugenziwe ati: ‘Nimuze tuje kwumviriza ico Uhoraho avuga.’

Abantu banje nk’uko bama, baza bafise ishusho yo kwicisha bugufi, bakicara imbere yawe ngo bumvirize amajambo yawe, ariko ntibayakurikiza. Batuza akanwa kabo ukwiyegurira Imana, ariko imitima yabo yuzuyemwo urukundo rw’amahera.
Kuri bo, nta ho utaniye n’umuririmvyi aririmba indirimbo z’urukundo, afise akajwi karongorotse, azi no gucuraranga neza, kuko barumva amajambo yawe ariko ntibayakurikiza.
Igihe ivyo vyose n’ayo makuba bizobashikako, bazomenya ko higeze kuba umuvugishwa hagati muri bo.”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:

“Mwana w’umuntu, burira abungere ba Isirayeli, ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Muragowe mwa bungere ba Isirayeli, mwebwe mwitaho ubuzima bwanyu gusa! Mbega umwungere ntiyari akwiye kwitwararika ibitungwa vyiwe?
Murya ibinure vyavyo, mukambara ubwoya bwavyo, mukabaga vyizavyiza gusumba ibindi, ariko mutavyitaho.
Ntimwafashije izifise intege nke gukomera, ngo muvure izigwaye canke ngo mwunge izavunitse. Ntimwagaruye izashwiragiye, canke ngo murondere izazimiye.
Zarashwiragiye kuko zabuze umwungere, hanyuma zicika ivyokurya vy’ibikoko.
Intama zanje zayerereye ku misozi no ku mitumba miremire. Zashwiragiriye kw’isi hose, kandi nta wagiye kuzirondera.
None rero, yemwe bungere, nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho :

Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kwanje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze, ko intama zanje zabuze umwungere, zikaba iminyago n’ivyokurya vy’ibikoko, kandi ko abungere batazirondeye ariko bakitaho ubuzima bwabo aho kwitwararika intama zanje,
nimwumve yemwe bungere ijambo ryanje jewe Uhoraho :

Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Nzogwanya abo bungere kandi nzobaharurako intama zanje. Nzobakura mw’ibango ryo kuragira intama zanje babure ico barya. Nzokiza intama zanje akanwa kabo, ntizizoba zikiba ivyokurya vyabo.
Kuko uku ari ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Nzokwironderera intama zanje ndaziragirire.
Nzozirondera nk’uko umwungere arondera intama zamuzimiranye. Nzozikiza ndazikuye ahantu hose zashwiragiriye ku musi w’ibipfungu n’umwijima.
Nzozizana ndazikuye mu mahanga, ndazegeranye ndazikuye mu bindi bihugu, ndazizane mu gihugu cazo. Nzoziragira ku misozi ya Isirayeli, ku nzuzi no mu mihana yose yo mu gihugu.
Nzoziragira mu bwatsi bwiza, n’imitumba miremire ya Isirayeli izoba uburagiro bwazo. Zizovyagira mu gihugu gitotahaye, zirishe ubwatsi bwiza bwo mu mitumba ya Isirayeli.
Jewe ubwanje ni jewe nzokwiragirira intama zanje, nongere ndazivyagize, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Nzorondera izatakaye, ngarure izazimiye.
Namwe busho bwanje, Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: nzoca urubanza hagati y’igitungwa n’ikindi, hagati y’impfizi y’intama n’impfizi y’impene.
Mbega ntimuhagijwe no kurisha mu buragiro bwiza? None muca muhonyanga n’ubwatsi busigaye? Mbega kunywa amazi meza ntibihagije? None ni ngombwa ngo mutobe ayasigaye?
None ubusho bwanje buzorya ubwatsi mwahonyanze, bunywe amazi mwatovye n’ibirenge vyanyu?’ ”
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji azibwiye: “Nzoca urubanza hagati y’izinamvye n’izivyibushe.
Kuko izivyubushe zasunuje ibitugu izinamvye, zikazisekesha amahembe yazo gushika zizisohoye hanze.
Nzorokora intama zanje, kandi ntizizosubira kunyagwa. Kandi nzocira urubanza intama n’iyindi.
Nzoziha umumwungere umwe, umusavyi wanje Dawidi, na we azoziragira; azoziragira abe umwungere wazo.
Jewe Uhoraho nzoba Imana yazo, umusavyi wanje Dawidi na we azoba umuganwa muri zo. Ni jewe ndabivuze.
Nzogirana isezerano ry’amahoro na zo, nirukane ibikoko mu gihugu, kugira ngo zishobore kuba mu bugaragwa kandi ziryame mu mashamba zitekanye.
Nzozihezagira, mpezagire n’imitumba izikikuje. Nzozirungikira imvura mu gihe kibereye, imvura y’umugisha.

Ibiti vyo mu mirima bizokwama ivyamwa, isi na yo yeze ibiterwa; abantu bazoba amahoro mu gihugu cabo. Kandi bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho , ninamara kuvunagura ivyuma vy’ingogo zabo, nkabakiza mu maboko y’ababagize abagurano.
Ntibazosubira kunyagwa n’amahanga, kandi n’ibikoko ntibizosubira kubarya. Bazoba amahoro, kandi nta n’umwe azosubira kubatera ubwoba.
Nzobaha igihugu kizwi ko cimbuka cane, ntibazosubira kwicwa n’ikigoyi muri ico gihugu kandi nta gitutsi c’ayandi mahanga kizongera kubabako.
Ni ho bazomenyera ko jewe ndi Uhoraho Imana yabo, ko ndi kumwe na bo, kandi ko Abisirayeli ari abantu banje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Yemwe busho bwanje, ntama zo mu buragiro bwanje, muri abantu banje, nanje ndi Imana yanyu, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, hindukira urabishe amaso ku musozi Seyiri, uvugishwe ibibi biherekeye,
uvuga uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nzokugwanya yewe wa musozi Seyiri, kandi nzokuramvurirako ukuboko kwanje, ndakurandure ndaguherengeteze.
Ibisagara vyawe nzobisiga ari imisaka, nawe usigare uri agahinga. Ni ho uzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .
Ko mwagiriye urwanko rudashira Abisirayeli mu kabatanga ngo bamarwe n’inkota igihe bari bageze kugesezwa, uguhanwa kwabo kwuzuye,
ndabarahiye ukuri nk’ukubaho kwanje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze, amaraso yawe azoseseka, kandi uguseseka kwayo kuzokwomako. Ko utagwanije ugusesa amaraso, uguseseka kw’ayawe kuzokwomako.
Umusozi Seyiri nzowusiga ugaragara, nice abagerageza guhunga hamwe n’abagaruka.
Imitumba yaho nzoyuzuza imivyimba; abishwe n’inkota bazogwa ku dusozi, mu biyaya no mu nzuzi.
Nzohagira umusaka ibihe vyose; ibisagara vyaho ntibizosubira kwubakwa. Ni ho bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .
Ko muvuga muti: Ibihugu vya Isirayeli na Yuda bizoba ivyacu kandi tuzovyegukira, naho Uhoraho ari ho ari,

none rero ndahiye ukubaho kwanje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze, nzobasubiriza mu nkoko ibihwanye n’ishavu n’akazikira mwerekanye mu rwanko mubanka, kandi nzokwimenyekanisha muri bo ninaguhana.
Ni ho muzomenyera ko jewe Uhoraho numvise ibitutsi mwatutse imisozi ya Isirayeli. Kuko mwibwiye muti: Yahindutse agahinga none twayihawe nk’indya ngo tuyishihagure.
Mwarampagurukiye mu majambo yanyu muntuka ubudahumeka, maze nanje ndavyumva.
Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Isi yose izonezerwa ninakurandura nkaguherengeteza.
Ko wahimbawe igihe amatongo ya Isirayeli yacika agahinga, uko ni ko nawe nzokugira. Uzosigara uri agahinga, yewe wa musozi Seyiri, hamwe na Edomu hose. Maze muzomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho .’
Mwana w’umuntu, vugishwa, ubwire imisozi ya Isirayeli uti: ‘Yemwe mwa misozi ya Isirayeli, nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Abansi banyu bavuze bati: Awa! Imitumba miremire yanyu ya kera yahindutse iyacu.

None rero vugishwa, ubabwire uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Kubera yuko babasanganguye bakabasya, bavuye impande zose, kugira ngo mube inyegu z’ayandi mahanga, kandi mube akabarore, muvugwe nabi,

nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho Nyeninganji, yemwe misozi ya Isirayeli: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji abariye imisozi n’udutumba, inzuzi n’ibiyaya, ahabaye imisaka n’ibisagara bitakibamwo abantu vyanyazwe bikicwa n’isoni kandi bigateterezwa n’ayandi mahanga abikikuje;

uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Mu burake bwanje bururumba nk’umuriro naravuze ngwanya ayandi mahanga, hamwe na Edomu, kubera mu gakengerwe kenshi karimwo umunezero w’intsinzi, bigaruriye igihugu canje bongera baragisahura ahari uburagiro hose.

None rero nuvugishwe ku gihugu ca Isirayeli, ubarire imisozi n’udutumba, inzuzi n’ibiyaya, uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Mvuganye uburake kuko mwateterejwe bikwiye imbere y’amahanga abakikuje.
Ni co gituma jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze nti: Ndahiye manitse ukuboko, ko ayo mahanga na yo azoremerwa n’ibiteterwe.
Ariko mwebwe, misozi ya Isirayeli, muzogira amashami, mwamire ivyamwa ubwoko bwa Isirayeli, kuko mu gihe gito bazotahuka i muhira.
Ehe ndabitwararitse kandi nzokwama ndabafasha. Muzorimwa mwongere mubibweko.
Nzogwiza abazobabako, ari bo Bisirayeli. Ibisagara bizosubira kugira ababibamwo, kandi amazu yasenyutse azosubira yubakwe.
Nzogwiza igitigiri c’abantu bazokubako n’ibitungwa bizokubako, bigwire bibe vyinshi cane. Nzozana abantu bababeko nka mbere. Ni ho muzomenyera ko ndi Uhoraho .
Nzotuma abantu banje, abantu banje b’Abisirayeli bababako. Muzobegukira, mube iragi ryabo; ntimuzosubira kumiragura abana babo.
Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Ko ayandi mahanga yagutwenze avuga ati: “Wamiraguye abantu bawe, igihugu cawe ukimarirako abana baco,”
ntuzosubira kumiragura abantu b’igihugu cawe canke ngo ukimarireko abana baco, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Sinzosubira kwemera ko ayandi mahanga agucokora, kandi nta mahanga azosubira kugutuka, kandi ihanga ryawe sinzosubira kurigwisha, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, igihe Abisirayeli bari bakiba mu gihugu cabo, bihumanishije ibikorwa vyabo bibi. Ingeso zabo zari zimereye nk’uguhumana kw’umugore ari mu mihango.
Vyatumye ndabasukako uburake bwanje kuko bari basheshe amaraso mu gihugu, bongera bagihumanisha ibigirwamana vyabo.
Nabashwiragirije mu mahanga, basabagirira mu bihugu vyose; nabahanye ibihwanye n’ingeso zabo n’ibikorwa vyabo.
Kandi mu bihugu vyose bagiyemwo, batukishije izina ryanje, kuko abababona bavuga bati: ‘Aba bantu bitirirwa Uhoraho , ariko bataye igihugu ciwe.’
Ariko nitwararitse izina ryanje ryera, iryo Abisirayeli bononye mu mahanga bagiyemwo.

None rero bwira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Si ku bwanyu ngiye gukora ivyo, yemwe Bisirayeli, ahubwo ni ku bw’izina ryanje ryera, iryo mwahumanirije mu mahanga mwashwiragiriyemwo.

Nzokwerekana ukwera kw’izina ryanje rihambaye, iryo mwahumanirije mu yandi mahanga. Kandi ninagaragaza ukwera kwanje imbere yabo ndabicishije kuri mwebwe, bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho , ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Kuko nzobakura muri ayo mahanga, ndabegeranye ndabakuye mu bihugu vyose, ndabagarukane mu gihugu canyu.
Nzobamijako amazi meza, namwe muzokwezwa; nzobakurako imyanda yose, ndabakuremwo n’ibigirwamana vyanyu vyose.
Nzobaha umutima mushasha, ndabashiremwo n’impwemu nshasha; nzobakuramwo umutima w’ibuye, ndabahe umutima w’inyama.
Nzobashiramwo impwemu nshasha, ntume mukurikiza ivyo nashinze, mwitondere n’ivyagezwe vyanje.
Muzoba mu gihugu nahaye ba sogokuruza banyu; muzoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yanyu.
Nzobakiza uguhumana kwose. Nzobaha umwimbu mwinshi, nzobarinda inzara mu gihugu.
Nzogwiza ivyamwa ku biti, n’ivyimburwa mu matongo, kugira ngo ntimuzosubire kumaramara mu yandi mahanga kubera inzara.
Maze muzokwibuka ingeso zanyu mbi n’ivyaha mwakoze, mumaramazwe n’ibizira mwakoze.
Ariko mumenye neza ko ntagiye gukora ivyo ku bwanyu, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze. Nimumaramazwe n’ingeso zanyu, yemwe Bisirayeli!
Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Ku musi nzoberezako ivyaha vyanyu vyose, nzobasubiza mu bisagara vyanyu, n’amazu yasenyutse azosubira yubakwe.
Ahari harabaye agahinga hazorimwa kugira ngo hoye kuguma gutyo mu maso y’abahita.

Bazovuga bati: “Iki gihugu cahora ari agahinga none cahindutse itongo rya Edeni; ibisagara vyahora ari imisaka, ata wubibamwo, vyarasambutse, ubu vyarubakiwe inzitiro zikomeye, kandi abantu barabibamwo.”
Maze amahanga azoba asigaye abakikuje azomenya ko Uhoraho yubatse ivyari vyarasambuwe, agasibura ahari harasivye. Ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze, kandi nzobikora.’
Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Nzosubira nemerere Abisirayeli bansabe, nanje nzobakorera ivyo bazonsaba. Nzobagwiza bangane n’ubusho bw’intama,
bangane n’imikuku yashikanwa i Yerusalemu mu gihe c’imisi mikuru. Ibisagara vyabaye imisaka bizosubira vyuzuremwo ubusho bw’abantu. Ni ho bazomenyera ko ndi Uhoraho .”
Ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kuramfata, kunsohokana hanze ndi muri Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho , anshira hagati mu kiyaya cari cuzuye amagufa.
Antembereza muri ayo magufa, mbona ari menshi cane yandagaye muri ico kiyaya, kandi yari yumye cane.
Arambaza ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, mbega aya magufa yosubira akavamwo abantu bazima?” Ndamwishura nti: “ Uhoraho Nyeninganji, ni wewe wenyene wobimenya.”
Maze arambarira ati: “Vugishwa kuri ayo magufa uyabwire uti: ‘Mwa magufa yumye mwe, nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho !
Uhoraho Nyeninganji abwiye mwebwe amagufa yumye ati: Ngiye kubahumekeramwo impwemu, maze nsubire ndabagire bazima.
Ngiye kubashirako imitsi n’inyama hanyuma ndabarenzeko umubiri; ndabahumekeremwo, maze namwe mube bazima. Ni ho muzomenyera ko ndi Uhoraho .’ ”
Maze ndavugishwa nk’uko mbwiwe kubikora. Nkiriko ndavuga ayo majambo, numva urwamo, hamwe n’ijwi ry’ugusekana, ya magufa ariko aregerana, rimwerimwe ryegerana na rigenzi raryo.
Ngize gutya mbona imitsi n’inyama biyajeko, umubiri na wo uraza urayapfuka, ariko nta mpwemu zari bwayajemwo.

Maze arambwira ati: “Vugishwa, ubwire impwemu, vugishwa, mwana w’umuntu uzibwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Yemwe mwa mpwemu mwe, nimuze, muzanane impande zine, muhuhe muri bano bishwe kugira ngo babe bazima.’ ”
Nuko mvugishwa nk’uko mbwiwe, impwemu zinjira muri bo; baca baba bazima, bahagarara ku maguru yabo: baba isinzi ry’ingabo.
Maze arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, ayo magufa yumye ni Abisirayeli bose. Bavuga bati: ‘Amagufa yacu yarumye, twarataye ivyizigiro; ihanga ryacu ryarazimanganye.’
None rero babwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Yemwe bwoko bwanje, ngiye kwugurura imva zanyu ndabakureyo, ndabagarukane mu gihugu ca Isirayeli.
Maze, mwebwe abantu banje, muzomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho , igihe nzoba nuguruye imva zanyu nkabazura ndabakuye muri zo.
Nzobashiramwo Mpwemu wanje kugira ngo mubeho, nanje nzobashira mu gihugu canyu. Maze muzomenya ko ari jewe Uhoraho nabivuze, nkongera nkabishitsa, ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:

“Mwana w’umuntu, fata inkoni uyandikeko uti: ‘Ni iya Yuda n’Abisirayeli bifatanije na we.’ Uce ufata iyindi, uyandikeko uti: ‘Ni iya Yosefu, inkoni ya Efurayimu, hamwe n’Abisirayeli bose bifatanije na we.’
Hanyuma uzifatanye zibe inkoni imwe mu kiganza cawe.
Maze abantu bo mu bwoko bwawe nibakubwira bati: ‘Tubwire ivyo ugize ico bisigura,’

uze ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ngiye gufata inkoni ya Yosefu iri mu kuboko kwa Efurayimu n’imiryango ya Isirayeli yifatanije na we, ndayifatanye n’inkoni ya Yuda, zihinduke imwe mu kiganza canje.’
Izo nkoni wanditseko uzifatire mu biganza vyawe babona,
uheze uvuge uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nzokura Abisirayeli mu mahanga basabagiriyemwo. Nzobegeraniriza hamwe ndabagarukane mu gihugu cabo.
Nzobagira ihanga rimwe mu gihugu cabo, ku mitumba ya Isirayeli. Bazoganzwa n’umwami umwe, kandi ntibazokwongera kuba amahanga abiri, canke ngo bagaburwemwo ubwami bubiri.
Ntibazosubira kwihumanisha ibigirwamana n’ibishushanyo, canke ibindi vyaha vyabo, kuko nzobakiza ivyaha vyabo vyose, nongere ndabeze. Bazoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yabo.
Umusavyi wanje Dawidi azoba umwami wabo, kandi bazogira umwungere umwe. Bazokurikiza ivyagezwe vyanje, bagendere mu mabwirizwa yanje.
Bazoba mu gihugu nahaye umusavyi wanje Yakobo, igihugu ba sogokuruza babayemwo. Bo n’abuzukuruza babo bazokibamwo ibihe vyose, kandi umusavyi wanje Dawidi azoba umuganwa wabo ibihe bidashira.
Nzogirana na bo isezerano ry’amahoro; rizoba isezerano ry’intahava. Nzobashira mu gihugu, ndabagwize, nongere ndabubakemwo Ingoro yanje y’ibihe vyose.
Ingoro yanje izoba muri bo; nzoba Imana yabo, na bo bazoba abantu banje.
Maze ninamara kububa Ingoro yanje y’ibihe vyose hagati muri bo, amahanga azomenya ko ari jewe Uhoraho natoranije Isirayeli ngo babe abera.”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kumbwira riti:
“Mwana w’umuntu, hanga amaso yawe i Gogi, ho mu gihugu ca Magogi, umutware mukuru wa Mesheki na Tubali.
Uvuge uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nzokugwanya yewe Gogi, umuganwa mukuru wa Mesheki na Tubali.

Nzogucuranguza, ndagutere igera mu mibangabanga ndagusohore uri kumwe n’ingabo zawe zose; amafarasi yawe, abayagenderako bafise ibigwanisho, biteguriye intambara, hamwe n’amasinzi y’ingabo zitwaje inkinzo nininini na ntonto, bose babanguye inkota.
Ubuperesi, Etiyopiya na Puti vyose bizokwifatanya na we, bose baze bafise inkinzo n’inkofero z’ivyuma ku mitwe,
nayo Gomeri hamwe n’ingabo ziwe bazokwifatanya nawe, hamwe na Beti h’i Togaruma bavuye kure mu buraruko n’ingabo zabo zose, eka amahanga menshi azokwifatanya nawe.
Nuko rero ikazanure; witegure, mwe n’ingabo zose zifatanije nawe, kandi uzibere umukuru.

Inyuma y’igihe kirekire uzohamagarirwa kuja ku rugamba. Mu myaka izoza uzotera igihugu cigeze guca mu ntambara, abantu baco begeranijwe bava mu mahanga menshi, bazanwa mu misozi ya Isirayeli, yari imaze igihe kinini igaragara. Baje bakuwe mu mahanga, ubu bose bakaba bahabaye impore.
Nawe uzodugana n’ingabo zawe muri kumwe n’amahanga menshi, ugende kurya kw’igihuhusi; muzoba mumeze nk’igipfungu gipfutse isi.
Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Kuri uwo musi ivyiyumviro bizokuza mu mutwe, maze utegure imigambi y’ikibi.
Uzokwibwira uti: “Reka ngire igitero kuri ico gihugu kitazitiye; nzotera ubu bwoko butekanye ata co bwinona, bose biberaho batagira inzitiro, ata marembo n’ivyugazo.

Nzohakura iminyago, ndabasahure. Nzoramvurira ukuboko kwanje ahahoze ari umusaka, no ku bantu begeranijwe bavuye mu mahanga menshi, bafise ibitungwa n’ubundi butunzi, baba hagati na hagati mu gihugu.”

Sheba na Dedani n’abadandaza b’i Tarushishi hamwe n’imihana ihakikuje, bazokubaza bati: Mbega wazanywe no gusahura? Wakoranije amasinzi y’ingabo zawe ngo muze gusahura no kunyaga ifeza n’inzahabu, kwiba ibitungwa hamwe n’ayandi matungo, musahure n’iyindi minyago myinshi?’
None rero, mwana w’umuntu, vugishwa kuri Gogi uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Kuri uwo musi, igihe ubwoko bwanje bwa Isirayeli buzoba butekanye, mbega ntuzobimenya?
Maze uzoca uza uvuye mu gihugu cawe ca kure mu buraruko, uzananye n’ayandi mahanga menshi, bose baze bagendera ku mafarasi, ari igitero c’ingabo isinzi kandi zikomeye.

Muzotera abantu banje ba Isirayeli, mumeze ng’igipfungu gipfutse isi. Yewe Gogi, mu gihe kigiye kuza nzokuzana utere igihugu canje, kugira ngo amahanga yose azobone ingene ndakwerekanirako ko ndi uwera mu maso yabo.
Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Mbega si wewe nari naravuzeko mu misi ya kera nciye ku bavugishwa ba Isirayeli? Bavugishijwe imyaka myinshi ko nzokuzana kubatera.
Ng’ibi ibizoba kuri uwo musi: Gogi niyatera igihugu ca Isirayeli, uburake bwanje bw’inkazi buzoziriringa, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Mu burake no mu bushangashirwe, ndabamenyesheje ko hazoba ugutigita kw’isi gukomeye mu gihugu ca Isirayeli.
Amafi yo mu biyaga, ibisiga vyo mu kirere, ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba, ivyikwega hasi vyose, hamwe n’abantu bo kw’isi bose bizohinda agashitsi imbere yanje.
Nzohamagaza inkota kuri Gogi ku misozi yanje yose, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze. Umuntu wese azohindukiririza inkota kuri mugenziwe.

Nzobashitsako igihano canje mu kubatera icago c’akaranda n’ico gusesa amaraso; nzobacuncuburirako imvura y’isegenya, ivanze n’urubura n’amazuku, wewe n’ingabo zawe hamwe n’amahanga yose azoba yifatanije nawe.
Uko ni ko nzokwerekana ubukuru bwanje n’ukwera kwanje, kandi nzokwimenyekanisha imbere y’amahanga menshi. Ni ho bazomenyera ko ndi Uhoraho .’ ”
“Mwana w’umuntu, vugishwa kuri Gogi uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ngiye kukugwanya yewe Gogi, umutware mukuru w’i Mesheki n’i Tubali.
Nzoguhindukiza ndagukwege, ndakuzane ngukuye kure mu buraruko, nkurungike ku misozi ya Isirayeli.
Nzovunagura umuheto wawe uri mu kuboko kw’ukubamfu, imyampi ikoragurike iva mu kuboko kw’i buryo.
Muzogwa ku misozi ya Isirayeli, mwe n’ingabo zawe n’amahanga yose. Nzobagaburira ibisiga n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba bibarye.
Muzogwa mu gahinga, kuko ari ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Nzokororera umuriro kuri Magogi hamwe no ku bantu bibereye impore mu mazinga, ni ho bazomenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho .
Izina ryanje nzorigira Rurangiranwa mu Bisirayeli. Sinzokwemera ko izina ryanje risubira gutukwa, kandi amahanga azomenya ko jewe Uhoraho ndi Uwera wa Isirayeli.
Ivyo birashitse! Nta kabuza bizoba, ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze. Uwo ni wo musi nari naravuze.
Maze ababa mu bisagara vya Isirayeli bazosohoka begeranye ibigwanisho vyabo babikoreshe nk’inkwi: uri inkinzo ntonto na nininini, imiheto n’imyampi, inkoni n’amacumu. Bazobicana imyaka indwi.

Ntibazosubira kuja gusenya canke ngo bicire ibiti mw’ishamba, kuko bazokoresha ivyo bigwanisho nk’inkwi. Bazonyaga abari barigeze kubanyaga, basahure abigeze kubasahura, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.

Uwo musi Gogi nzomwimbira imva muri Isirayeli, mu kiyaya kirimwo inzira y’abava mu Buseruko baja ku Kiyaga. Iyo mva izozibira inzira y’abarengana, kuko Gogi n’amasinzi y’ingabo ziwe bazohambwa aho. Hazokwitwa Ikiyaya ca Hamoni Gogi.
Abisirayeli bazomara amezi indwi babahamba, kugira ngo basukure igihugu cabo.
Abantu bose muri Isirayeli bazokoranira kubahamba, kandi uwo musi nzokwerekanirako icubahiro canje uzoba umusi w’intibagirwa, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Abantu bazohabwa igikorwa co kuguma basukura igihugu. Bazoguma banyuragirana mu gihugu, hanyuma bari kumwe n’abandi, bazohamba imivyimba yandagaye hasi.
Abo bantu bazonyuragira mu gihugu, aho bazobona ibisigarira vy’umuntu hose bahashire ikimeyetso kugira ngo abahamba bazobahambe mu kiyaya ca Hamoni Gogi.
Hazobaho n’igisagara citwa Hamona, bisigura “amasinzi”. Uko ni ko bazohumanura ico gihugu.

Mwana w’umuntu, uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Hamagara ibisiga vyose vyo mu kirere n’ibikoko vyose vyo mw’ishamba, ubibwire uti: Nimukorane muvuye mu mihingo yose, muze ku kimazi nabateguriye, ikimazi gihambaye kiri ku misozi ya Isirayeli. Muzoriraho inyama munywereho n’amaraso.
Muzorya inyama z’abagabo bahambaye, munywe n’amaraso y’abatware b’isi nk’aho ari amapfizi y’intama canke imyagazi y’intama, impene canke amapfizi y’inka vyororewe i Bashani.
Kuri ico kimazi ndiko ndabategurira, muzorya inyama zibaduhire, mwongere munywe amaraso gushika muborerwe.
Kuri ayo mazimano nzobaha, muzohaga inyama z’amafarasi n’abayagenderako, abahizi hamwe n’ingabo z’ubwoko bwose, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Nzokwerekana icubahiro canje ku mahanga, kandi abantu bose bazobona uguhana kwanje, babone n’ububasha naberekanyeko.
Uhereye uwo musi, Abisirayeli bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Kandi amahanga azomenya ko ubwoko bwa Isirayeli bwigeze gutwarwa mu kinyago kuko bancumuyeko. Vyatumye ndabanyegeza mu nyonga hanje, ndabarekurira mu maboko y’abansi babo, babamarisha inkota.
Nabishuye ibihwanye n’ukwononekara kwabo hamwe n’ivyaha vyabo, maze ndabanyegeza mu nyonga hanje.
None rero uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Ngiye gukura Yakobo mu kinyago, ngirire impuhwe ubwoko bwose bwa Isirayeli, kandi nzogirira ipfuhe izina ryanje ryera.
Bazokwibagira ibimaramare n’isoni, no kubura ubwizigirwa mu vyo bankoreye, igihe baba ata nkomanzi mu gihugu cabo ata wubatera ubwoba.
Ninamara kubagarukana ndabakuye mu mahanga, nkabegeranya ndabakuye mu bihugu vy’abansi babo, nzokwerekana ukwera kwanje nciye kuri bo imbere y’amahanga menshi.
Ni ho bazomenyera ko ndi Uhoraho Imana yabo, kuko n’aho nabarungitse mu kinyago mu yandi mahanga, nzobegeraniriza mu gihugu cabo, ata n’umwe nsize inyuma.
Sinzoba nkibanyegeza mu nyonga hanje, kuko nzosuka Mpwemu wanje ku Bisirayeli, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.’ ”

Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri na gatanu turi mu kinyago, mu ntango z’umwaka, ku musi w’icumi w’ukwezi, hari mu mwaka ugira icumi na kane igisagara ca Yerusalemu gisenyutse, uwo musi ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kuza kuri jewe, anjana muri ico gisagara.
Ndiko nderekwa, Imana injana mu gihugu ca Isirayeli, impagarika ku musozi muremure, ku ruhande rwo hepfo yawo hari amazu yubatse nk’igisagara.
Anjanayo, maze mbona umuntu yari afise ishusho ikayangana imeze nk’umwakaka; yari ahagaze mw’irembo ry’igisagara, afise umukanda wera, afise n’inkoni yo gupima mu kuboko kwiwe.
Wa muntu arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, raba neza, wongere utege amatwi cane, ushire umutima ku vyo ngira nkwereke, kuko ni co catumye uzanwa hano. Maze uzobwire Abisirayeli ivyo uja kubona vyose.”

Ngize gutya mbona uruhome rukikuje ahari Ingoro hose. Wa muntu afata ya nkoni yiwe yo gupima, yari ifise uburebure bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitandatu, apima rwa ruhome, rwari rufise ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe y’uburebure bw’igihagararo n’imetero zitatu z’ubwaguke.
Hanyuma aja kw’irembo riraba mu buseruko. Yurira ku ngazi apima igishimaryango caco,
icumba c’abateramyi bo kuri iryo rembo cari gifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’uburebure bw’amakika, imetero zitatu z’uburebure bw’igihagararo, n’imetero zitatu z’ubwaguke.
Yongera apima icumba co kw’irembo.

Cari gifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko umunani z’uburebure uhereye ku rwinjiriro, kandi kuva ku rwinjiriro gushika ku ruhome cari gifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zibiri. Icumba cari cegeranye n’irembo carabana n’Ingoro.
Imbere winjiye mw’irembo ryo mu buseruko, hari utwumba dutatudutatu ku mpande zose. Twose twarangana, kandi inkingi zatwo zose zarangana.
Agera ubwaguke bw’urwinjiriro, zari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi, ariko imiryango y’urwinjiriro yari ifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi na zitatu z’ubwaguke.
Imbere y’akumba kamwekamwe kose hari uruhome rufise ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe y’uburebure, kandi icumba cose cagira ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitandatu ku ruhande rwose, impande zarangana.
Maze apima irembo ahereye ku gisenge c’akumba kamwe, ahereza ku gisenge c’akandi, uburebure bwaho bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri na zitanu hagati y’amarembo arabana.
Apima n’icumba kiri ahakikujwe n’impome z’urugo rwo hanze y’Ingoro. Cari gifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu.
Kuva ku rwinjiriro rwo kw’irembo gushika ku rwinjiriro rw’inzu hari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu.

Hari amadirisha ariko ivyuma yari ku mpande zo ku nyubakwa zose, no kuri twa twumba two ku rwinjiriro, no ku mpome zidutandukanya. Ayo madirisha yari no ku mpome z’ivyumba vyo mu nzu. Izo mpome zari zisharijwe n’amashami y’ibigazi akorogoshowe ku nkingi yose.
Wa muntu anjana mu rugo rw’inyuma y’Ingoro, ndahasanga utwumba n’imbuga ishashemwo amabuye, utwo twumba twari mirongo itatu, twubakiye ku ruhome rw’inyuma, dukikuje ku rugo impande zose.
Ku mpande z’amarembo ni ho iyo mbuga ishashemwo amabuye yari iri, ihuye n’uburebure bw’amarembo. Iyo ni imbuga yo hepfo.
Maze apima ubwaguke kuva imbere y’irembo rija hanze n’iry’imbere, hari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana, uko ari habiri, ku ruhande rwo mu buseruko no ku rwo mu buraruko.
Apima n’uburebure bw’irembo riraba mu buraruko, rija ku mbuga yo hanze, apima n’ubwaguke bwaryo.

Utwumba two kuri ryo twari dutatudutatu ku ruhande rumwerumwe. Ibikingi vyaryo n’amabaraza yaryo vyarareha n’ivya rya rembo rya mbere. Irembo ryo mu buraruko ryari rifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu z’uburebure n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri na zitanu z’ubwaguke.

Amadirisha yo kuri ryo, n’amabaraza hamwe n’ibigazi vyari bihasharije vyanganya uburebure n’ivyo kuri rya rembo ry’aharabana no mu buseruko. Bajayo baciye aho buririra hari hafise amatambwe indwi, baja no ku mabaraza arabana na ryo.
Irembo ry’aharabana no mu buraruko n’iry’aharabana no mu buseruko yarabana n’amarembo y’urugo rw’imbere. Apima ahaherereye kw’irembo rimwe gushika ku rindi, hari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana.
Maze anjana ahaherereye mu bumanuko, mbona irembo rija mu bumanuko. Apima ibikingi vyaryo n’amabaraza yaryo. Vyari bifise uburinganire nk’ivya mbere.

Ryari rifise amadirisha co kimwe n’amabaraza yo kuri ryo, ahakikije ameze nk’amwe ya mbere. Uburebure bwaryo bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu, n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri na zitanu z’ubwaguke.
Mu kuhashika umuntu yaca ku ngazi y’amatambwe indwi, kandi amabaraza yo kuri ryo, yararabana na ryo; ryari risharijwe n’ibigazi ku mpome zo ku mpande zose.
Urugo rw’imbere na rwo nyene rwari rufise irembo riraba mu bumanuko, apima kuva kuri iryo rembo gushika ku rindi ry’urugo rw’inyuma, hari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana.
Hanyuma anjana mu rugo rw’imbere, ancishije mw’irembo riraba mu bumanuko, apima iryo rembo; ryangana n’ayandi marembo.

Utwumba, impome hamwe n’ibaraza vyaryo vyari bifise uburinganire bungana n’ubw’ivya mbere. Irembo hamwe n’ibaraza vyaho vyari bifise amadirisha impande zose. Irembo ryari rifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu z’uburebure na mirongo ibiri na zitanu z’ubwaguke.
Amabaraza yari ahakikuje yari afise uburebure bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri na zitanu z’uburebure bw’amakika na zitanu z’ubwaguke.
Ayo mabaraza yaraba ku rugo rw’inyuma; impome zayo zari zisharijwe n’ibigazi, mu kuhashika umuntu yaca ku ngazi y’amatambwe indwi.
Maze antwara mu rugo rw’imbere ahaherereye mu buseruko, apima irembo ryaho. Ryari rifise uburinganire nk’ayandi marembo.

Utwumba, impome hamwe n’ibaraza vyaryo vyari bifise uburinganire bungana n’ubw’ivya mbere. Irembo hamwe n’ibaraza vyaho vyari bifise amadirisha impande zose. Irembo ryari rifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu z’uburebure na mirongo ibiri na zitanu z’ubwaguke.
Amabaraza yaryo yarabana n’ikigo c’inyuma; impome zose zari zisharijwe n’ibigazi, kandi mu kuhashika umuntu yurira ku ngazi y’amatambwe umunani.
Maze anjana kw’irembo rya ruguru, araripima. Ryari rifise uburinganire bungana n’ubw’ayandi marembo.

Utwumba, impome hamwe n’amabaraza na vyo nyene vyari bifise uburinganire bungana n’ubw’ahandi, kandi ryari rifise amadirisha impande zose. Iryo rembo ryari rifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu z’uburebure na mirongo ibiri na zitanu z’ubwaguke.
Amabaraza yaryo yarabana n’ikigo c’inyuma; impome zose zari zisharijwe n’ibigazi kandi mu kuhashika umuntu yurira ku ngazi y’amatambwe umunani.
Hariho akumba kari gafise umuryango uri hagati y’inkingi z’irembo, aho bogereza ibimazi vyo guturirwa.
Mw’ibaraza ryo kuri iryo rembo hari hateretse imeza zibiri ku mpade zose, aho bacumitira ibimazi vyo guturirwa, ivy’ivyaha hamwe n’ivyo gukuraho urubanza.
Mu ruhande rumwerumwe ruherereye hanze, aho umuntu adugana mu guca mw’irembo riraba amaja mu buraruko, hari imeza zibirizibiri.
Zose hamwe zari imeza umunani, zine ku ruhande rumwe, zindi zine ku rundi. Ni ho ibimazi vyabagirwa, bigategurwa neza.

Hariho n’izindi meza zine zabajwe mu mabuye, zafasha mu gushikana ibimazi vyo guturira. Imwe yose yaba ifise ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe n’igice y’uburebure, n’ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe n’igice y’ubwaguke, hamwe n’ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe y’igihagararo. Ni zo bashirako ivyo bakoresha mu gucumita ibimazi vyo guturirwa hamwe n’ibindi bimazi.
Imeza yose yaba ifise urubiga rungana n’ikiganza c’umuntu mu burebure ruyizungurutse. Kuri izo meza ni ho bashira inyama z’ibimazi.
Inyuma y’irembo ry’imbere, mu rugo rw’imbere, hari utwumba tubiri, kamwe ku ruhande rwo haruguru karaba epfo, akandi ku ruhande rwo hepfo karaba ruguru.
Arambarira ati: “Akumba karaba epfo ni ak’abaherezi bajejwe Ingoro,
akaraba ruguru na ko ni ak’abaherezi bajejwe igicaniro. Abo ni abahungu ba Sadoki, akaba ari na bo Balewi bonyene bemerewe kwegera Uhoraho no kumukorera.”
Maze apima urugo; rwari rufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana ku ruhande rwose kandi impande zose zarangana. Nongera mbona igicaniro cari imbere y’Ingoro.

Aca anjana mw’ibaraza ry’Ingoro, apima uburebure bw’inkingi. Zari zifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’ubwaguke ku ruhande rumwerumwe. Ubwaguke bw’urwinjiriro bwari nk’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi na zine kandi impome na zo zari zifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitatu.

Uburebure bw’amakika bw’ibaraza bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri, n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi na zibiri z’ubwaguke. Umuntu yarishikako aciye ku ngazi, kandi irembo ryari rishigikiwe n’inkingi, imwe ku ruhande rumwe, iyindi ku rundi.

headings.text: Irembo ryo mu Buseruko amaja mu rugo

verses.text: Hanyuma wa muntu anjana mu cumba gikuru c’Ingoro, apima impome zari ku mpande zompi z’inzira yaja muri ico cumba: zapima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitandatu z’ubwaguke,

n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi z’uburebure bw’amakika, hamwe n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu kuva ku ruhome rumwe gushika ku rundi. Iyo Ngoro yari ifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ine z’uburebure bw’amakika, n’ubwaguke bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri.

Maze yinjira mu cumba co haruguru, apima inkingi z’umuryango; imwimwe yose yari ifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zibiri z’ubwaguke, n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitandatu z’uburebure bw’amakika, kandi uburebure bwo kuva ku muryango gushika ku zindi mpome bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko indwi.
Apima ubwaguke bw’ico cumba c’imbere, asanga kingana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri ku ruhande rwose kandi impande zose zarangana. Maze aca ambarira ati: “Aha ni Ahera Cane.”

Yongera apima uruhome rw’Ingoro, asanga rupima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitandatu z’ubwaguke, utwumba tw’ububiko twari dufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zine z’ubwaguke, dukikuje urusengero impande zose.

Kandi utwo twumba two ku ruhande twari tugerekeranye ku buryo tuba amagorofa atatu, umurongo wose uriko utwumba mirongo itatu. Impome zatwo zari zegeranye n’uruhome rw’inyuma rw’Ingoro ariko zikikuje impande zose z’Ingoro, kugira ngo ntitwegamire kuri rwo.

Utwo twumba twari dukikuje Ingoro, uko twari tugerekeranye ni ko twarutana. Inyubako ikikuje urusengero yari yubatswe mu buryo igenda iraduga, ku buryo utwo twumba twagenda twaguka uko umuntu aduga. Hariho ingazi iyo uriko uraduga ujana igenda iduga kandi izunguruka ikikuje urusengero, mu kuja mu twumba two hejuru ugaca mu two hagati.

Hanyuma mbona ko iyo ngoro ifise urufatiro rurenze gatoya ku ruhome, rukaba n’urufatiro rwo ku ruhande rw’utwo twumba. Uburebure bw’igihagararo bw’urwo rufatiro rwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitandatu.
Ubwaguke bw’urwo ruhome rw’inyuma rwariko utwo twumba bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’ubwaguke. Umwanya wasigara hagati y’utwo twumba two ku ruhande
n’utwumba tw’abaherezi wari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’ubwaguke uzungurutse urusengero.
Imiryango y’utwo twumba yari iraba ku mbuga, umuryango umwe uraba mu buraruko, uwundi uraba mu bumanuko. Ahari hatubatse hagati y’amazu hari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’ubwaguke.

Inzu yari imbere y’ahatubatse haherereye mu burengero bw’urusengero, yari ifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko indwi z’ubwaguke. Impome zayo zari zifise intimba ingana y’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu, uburebure bw’iyo nzu na bwo bwangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo icenda.

Maze apima urusengero; rwari rufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana z’uburebure bw’amakika, kandi kuva kuri rwo ugaca ku mbuga yari irukikuje harimwo n’impome z’uruzitiro, hari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana z’uburebure.
Imbuga yo ku ruhande rwo mu buseruko bw’urusengero ifatanye n’imbere y’urusengero hari hafise ubwaguke bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana.

Maze apima uburebure bw’inyubakwa irabana n’imbuga y’imbere y’urusengero, harimwo n’amabaraza yarwo ku mpande zose; yari ifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana. Mu rusengero, ahanini habera amakoraniro, n’ibaraza vyose vyaraba kuri iyo mbuga,

hamwe rero n’urugi n’amadirisha vyari imbere mu rusengero, no mu mabaraza akikuje ku mazu agerekeranye atatu atatu, no mu muryango hose, igisenge caho cari gikozwe mu mbaho, kandi uhereye hasi, ukaduga ku mpome gushika ku madirisha no hejuru yayo hari hapfukishije imbaho.
Inyuma n’imbere mu Ngoro, kuva mu rwinjiriro gushika ku cumba c’inyuma, impome zari zishushanijweko ibisharizo.
Vyari bishushanijweko abakerubi, n’ibigazi. Ikigazi cose cakurikirana n’umukerubi, kandi umukerubi wese yari afise mu maso habiri.

Mu maso hamwe hari hameze nk’ah’umuntu, hakaraba ku kigazi co ku ruhande rumwe, ahandi hari hameze nk’ah’intare hakaraba ku kindi kigazi co ku rundi ruhande. Vyari bishushanije ku mpande zose z’Ingoro.
Kuva hasi gushika hejuru y’umuryango hari hashushanije abakerubi n’ibigazi. Uko ni ko impome zose z’Ingoro zari zishushanijweko.
Ibishimaryango vy’umuryango w’Ingoro vyari bifise impande zingana, kandi n’ivy’urugi ruja Ahera Cane vyangana n’ivyo.

Hariho igicaniro cabajwe mu giti, cari gifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitatu z’uburebure, n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zibiri z’ubwaguke, kandi impande zose zarangana: imfuruka zaco, aho giterekwa hamwe n’impande zaco vyari bikozwe mu mbaho. Uwo muntu arambarira ati: “Iyi ni imeza iri imbere y’ Uhoraho .”
Kandi Ingoro hamwe n’Ahera Cane vyari bifise inzugi zibiri.
Urugi rumwerumwe rwose rwari rugabuwemwo zibiri zugururwa zija ku mpande zose.
Inzugi zo ku Ngoro zari zishushanijeko abakerubi n’ibigazi nka bimwe bishushanije ku mpome, kandi imbere y’umuryango hari ubwicaro bukozwe mu mbaho.
Kandi ku mpande zose z’umuryango hari amadirisha matomato akingiwe n’ivyuma, hamwe n’ibigazi bishushanije.
Maze ankura aho, anjana inyuma ahaherereye mu buraruko, anshikana ku twumba turabana n’imbuga y’Ingoro iri imbere y’uruhome rw’inyuma rwo mu buraruko.
Inzu yari ifise umuryango waraba mu buraruko yari ifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana z’uburebure na mirongo itanu z’ubwaguke.
Hari ku ngero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri uvuye ku rugo rw’imbere, hakaba ku mbuga ishasheko amabuye y’urugo rw’inyuma, n’aho amabaraza y’utwumba twari tugerekeranye dutatudutatu yari ari.
Imbere y’utwo twumba hari inzira ipima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi z’ubwaguke n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana z’uburebure, kandi imiryango yatwo yaraba mu buraruko.
Utwumba two hejuru twari dutoduto ku two musi n’utwo hagati, kuko twagabanywa n’amabaraza yatwo.
Utwumba two hejuru nta nkingi twari dufise, ni co gituma twari dutoduto amaja hasi kurusha utwo hagati n’utwo musi.
Uruhome rwo hanze rubangabanganye n’utwumba hamwe n’intangaro rwari rufise uburebure bw’amakika bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu.
Mu gihe uburebure bw’amakika bw’utwumba tw’aharaba mu rugo rw’inyuma bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu, utwegereye Ingoro two twari dufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ijana.
Utwumba two hasi twari dufise umuryango uraba mu buseruko, abawucamwo ni ababa bavuye mu rugo rw’inyuma.
Ku ruhande rwo hepfo ahabangabanganywe n’urugo rw’inyuma, ahahurira imbuga y’imbere y’Ingoro n’uruhome rw’inyuma hari utwumba tubiri.

Inzira yari imbere yarwo yasa n’inzira y’imbere y’utwumba tw’ahaherereye mu buraruko. Twose twarangana mu burebure no mu bwaguke. Imiryango yatwo yarangana, n’inzugi zatwo zarangana n’iy’amaja mu buraruko.

Inzugi z’utw’ahaherereye mu bumanuko na zo ni ko zari zimeze. Aho inzira iherera hari urugi, kandi iyo nzira yari ibangabanganywe n’uruhome rw’ahaherereye mu buseruko, iyo abantu bacamwo bagiye mu twumba.

Maze arambwira ati: “Utu twumba na two tw’ahaherereye mu buraruko n’utw’ahaherereye mu bumanuko turaba ku mbuga y’Ingoro, ni utwo abaherezi begera Uhoraho bazoriramwo ibimazi vyejejwe cane.
