Ni ho bazotereka amashikanwa, ari ay’ifu, ari amashikanwa yo guhonga ivyaha, ari ayo gukurako urubanza, kuko ari ikibanza cejejwe.

Abaherezi bavuye Ahera, ntibazoca basohoka ngo baje mu rugo rwo hanze. Bazobanza kwambura imyambaro bari bambaye bariko barakora igikorwa c’ubuherezi, kuko ico kibanza barimwo ari icera. Bazokwambara izindi mpuzu imbere yo kwegera ibindi bibanza abandi bantu bose bazoba barimwo.”
Ahejeje gupima ivy’imbere mu Ngoro, aransohokana duciye mw’irembo ry’aharaba mu buseruko, apima urugo impande zose.
Apima uruhande rw’ahaherereye mu buseruko, akoresheje ya nkoni. Rwari rufise uburebure bw’amakika bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko amajana atanu.
Apima uruhande rw’amaja mu buraruko. Rwari rufise uburebure bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko amajana atanu.
Apima n’uruhande rw’amaja mu bumanuko. Rwari rufise uburebure bw’amakika bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko amajana atanu.
Hanyuma arahindukira apima urw’amaja mu buseruko. Rwari rufise uburebure bw’amakika bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko amajana atanu.
Yongera apima n’imbuga ikikuje izo mpande zine, na yo ikaba yari ikikujwe n’uruhome. Hari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko amajana atanu ku ruhande rumwerumwe, kandi hatandukanya ahera n’ahasanzwe.
Maze wa muntu antwara ku muryango uraba mu buseruko,
nca mbona ubwiza bw’Imana ya Isirayeli, buje buva mu buseruko. Ijwi ryayo ryari rimeze nk’iry’amazi asuma, kandi isi yakayangana ubwiza bwayo.
Ivyo nabonye vyari bimeze nk’ivyo neretswe igihe yaza gutikiza igisagara, canke ivyo nerekewe ku ruzi Kebari, maze nikubita hasi nubamye.
Ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bwinjira mu Ngoro, buzananye mw’irembo ry’amaja mu buseruko.
Maze Mpwemu andugana mu cumba co haruguru, ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho na bwo bwuzura Ingoro.
Wa muntu agihagaze i ruhande yanje, numva uwundi muntu amvugishije ari mu rusengero.

Avuga ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, iki ni co kibanza c’intebe yanje y’ubwami, hamwe n’ikibanza c’indava y’ibirenge vyanje. Ni ho nzoba ibihe vyose, mbane n’Abisirayeli. Abisirayeli ntibazigera basubira guhumanya izina ryanje; baba bo canke abami babo; mu busambanyi bwabo no mu mashikanwa y’imivyimba y’abami babo batangira ku mpinga z’imisozi.

Igihe bashinga ibicaniro vy’ibigirwamana vyabo hafi y’igicaniro canje, bigatandukanywa n’uruhome rumwe gusa, bahumanije izina ryanje ryera mu bizira bakora. Ni co gituma nabaranduranye uburake bwanje.
Noneho rero nibate kure yanje ubusambanyi bwabo hamwe n’ibigirwamana bitagira ubuzima vy’abami babo, nanje nzoba muri bo ibihe vyose.
Mwana w’umuntu, ereka ubwoko bwa Isirayeli iyo Ngoro, kugira ngo baterwe isoni n’ivyaha vyabo. Baze barupime bakurikije ishusho yarwo.

Nibamaramazwa n’ivyaha vyose bakoze, ubereke uko iyo Ngoro imeze n’uko itunganijwe, ubereke imiryango isohoka n’iyinjira, ishusho yayo yose hamwe n’ivyagezwe n’amabwirizwa bijanye na yo. Uvyandikire imbere yabo, kugira ngo bazokurikize iyi nteguro yayo bakurikize n’amabwirizwa ajanye na yo.
Ng’iki icagezwe kigenga Ingoro: ahakikuje impinga y’umusozi hose, hazoba ahera cane. Ico ni co cagezwe kigenga Ingoro.

Ibi ni vyo bipimo vy’igicaniro hakurikijwe ibipimo bisanzwe bikoreshwa: intebe y’igicaniro izokikuzwa n’umuvo ufise ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe y’ubwaguke, n’imwe umanuka, hamwe n’ingero imwe y’intoke kuva kuri uwo muvo gushika ku ntebe y’igicaniro.

Kuva hasi ku ntebe yaco gushika ku nkikuro y’ahahera hepfo hari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zibiri z’amaduga n’ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe y’ubwaguke. Kuva kuri iyo nkikuro gushika hejuru hari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zine, ubwaguke na bwo bukaguma bungana n’ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe.
Igicaniro ubwaco, uburebure bw’igihagararo bwaco ni ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zine, kikagira amahembe ane araba hejuru ari mu mfuruka zose uko ari zine.
Hejuru ku gicaniro harangana mu burebure no mu bwaguke; hafise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko icumi na zibiri ku ruhande rwose.

Iyindi nkikuro yo hejuru na yo nyene impande zayo zose zarangana zifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko icumi na zine ku ruhande rwose kandi urubiga rw’iyo nkikuro rwari igice c’ingero y’igice c’ukuboko. Ingazi zari imbere y’igicaniro zari zitumbereye mu buseruko.”
Maze arambwira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ibi ni vyo bizoba ivyashinzwe vyo gushikana ibimazi bituriwe hamwe no kumijagira amaraso ku gicaniro nibamara kucubaka:

Ico gihe, abaherezi bo mu bakomoka kuri Lewi, bo mu muryango wa Sadoki, bakorera imbere yanje, bazohabwa impfizi y’inka kugira ngo bayitange ibe ikimazi c’ivyaha, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Uzokwakire ku maraso yayo, uyasige ku mahembe ane y’ico gicaniro, no ku mfuruka zine zaco hejuru, uzoba ucejeje ugitangiye impongano.
Uzoheze ufate iyo mpfizi, uyituririre mu kibanza cabigenewe co mu Ngoro, inyuma y’Ahera.
Ku musi ugira kabiri uzoshikane impfizi y’impene, itagira agasembwa, ibe ikimazi c’ivyaha, kandi igicaniro kize cezwe nk’uko cejejwe na ya mpfizi y’inka.
Niwaheza kuceza, uzotange ikimazi c’ishuri y’inka ikiri ntoya hamwe n’impfizi y’intama, vyompi bizobe bitagira agasembwa.
Uzobitangire imbere y’ Uhoraho , kandi abaherezi bazobishireko umunyu, bazobitange nk’amashikanwa y’ Uhoraho .
Uzomare imisi indwi ushikana impfizi y’impene ku musi nk’ikimazi c’ivyaha; kandi uze wame ushikana n’impfizi y’inka y’umukangara hamwe n’impfizi y’intama, vyompi bitagira agasembwa.
Uzomare imisi indwi utanga impongano y’igicaniro, uceze; uko ni ko uzokigira icera.

Inyuma y’iyo misi indwi, kuva ku musi ugira umunani kubandanya, abaherezi bazobe ari bo bashikana ibimazi vyanyu vyo guturirwa, hamwe n’ivy’amashimwe, babizane ku gicaniro. Nanje nzoheza ndavyakire, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.”
Maze uwo muntu angarukana mw’irembo ryo hanze y’Ingoro, riraba mu buseruko, ryari ryugaye.
Uhoraho aca ambarira ati: “Iri rembo rizokwame ryugaye; ntihazogire uwuryinjiriramwo. Rizokwame ryugaye kuko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli ari ryo yinjiriyemwo.
Umuganwa wenyene ubwiwe, ni we ashobora kuryicaramwo, akarira imbere y’ Uhoraho . Aze yinjire aciye mu nzira y’ibaraza y’iryo rembo, kandi aho nyene azobe ari ho asohokera.”
Maze anjana mu nzira y’irembo riraba mu buraruko, anshikana imbere y’Ingoro. Ngize gutya mbona ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bwuzuye Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , maze nikubita hasi nubamye.

Uhoraho aca arambarira ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, ihweze neza, kandi wumvirize neza, ushire umutima ku vyo ndakubwira bijanye n’ivyashinzwe ko bitegerezwa gukorwa mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Wumvirize neza ingene amarembo y’Ingoro azokoreshwa haba mu kwinjira canke mu gusohoka.
Ubwire abagarariji ari bo Bisirayeli, uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Geza aho gukora ibizira, yemwe Bisirayeli!

Ku bindi bizira mwakoze mwongeyeko kuzana abanyamahanga batakebwe haba ku mutima canke ku mubiri mu Ngoro yanje, muhumanya urusengero rwanje, mukiriko muranshikanira ivyokurya, ibinure n’amaraso, maze muva mw’isezerano ryanje.
Aho gukora ibikorwa nabajeje bijanye n’ivyejejwe vyanje, mwabihaye abanyamahanga ngo abe ari bo bitaho Ingoro yanje.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Nta munyamahanga atakebwe ku mutima no ku mubiri yemerewe kwinjira mu Ngoro yanje, naho yoba uwuba mu Bisirayeli.
Abalewi bagiye kure yanje igihe Abisirayeli bashwiragira, bakanta bagakurikira ibigirwamana vyabo bategerezwa gushikwako n’ingaruka z’ivyaha vyabo.
Boshobora gukora ku Ngoro nk’abarinzi b’amarembo yayo bakongera bagakora ibikorwa vyo gucumita ibimazi vyo guturira, no guhagarara imbere y’abantu babakorera.

Ariko, kubera bafashije abantu banje gukorera ibigirwamana, bagatuma Abisirayeli bagwa mu caha, ni co catumye ndahira manitse ukuboko, ko bategerezwa gushikwako n’ingaruka z’icaha cabo, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Ntibaze banyegere ngo bankorere nk’abaherezi, canke ngo begere ivyejejwe vyanje canke amashikanwa yanje yejejwe; bazokwamane isoni z’ibizira bakoze.
Ariko nzobagira abarinzi b’urusengero, mbahe no gukora ibikorwa bindi vyose birukorerwamwo.

Ariko abaherezi, ari bo Balewi bamuka kuri Sadoki, bagumye mu bikorwa vy’Ingoro igihe Abisirayeli bamvako, baze begere, bankorere; bazohagarare imbere yanje banshikanire ibimazi vy’ibinure n’amaraso, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Ni bo bonyene bazokwinjira mu Ngoro yanje; ni bo bonyene bazokwegera imeza yanje bankorere, bashitse ivyo nategetse.
Nibinjira mw’irembo ryo mu rugo rw’imbere, baze bambare imyambaro yera; ntihaze hagire ico bambara kirimwo ubwoya mu gihe bazoba bariko barankorera ku marembo y’urugo rw’imbere canke imbere mu Ngoro.
Bazohore bambara ibitambara vyera ku mitwe, bambare n’amabutura yera. Ntihazogire ico bambara cobatera kubira ivyuya.

Nibasohoka baja aho abantu bari mu rugo rwo hanze, bazokwambure iyo myambaro bankoreye bambaye, bayisige mu vyumba vyabigenewe, baheze bambare iyindi myambaro, kugira ngo ntihagire uwo bakwegera kuba inyegu bitewe no gukorwako n’iyo myambaro.
Ntibazokwimoshe umushatsi wose canke ngo batereke umushatsi wabo ube muremire, bazokwame bawugabanya gusa.
Ntihazogire umuherezi yinjira mu rugo rw’imbere yanyoye umuvinyu.
Ntibazorongore abapfakazi canke ngo bahukane; bazorongore inkumi zo mu Bisirayeli gusa, canke abapfakazi b’abandi baherezi.
Bazokwigishe ubwoko bwanje itandukaniro ry’ahera n’ahasanzwe, babigishe gutandukanya ibihumanye n’ivyejejwe.

Nihagira abagira ico bapfa, abaherezi bazobe ari bo bababera abacamanza, babatunganiririze bakurikije amategeko yanje. Bazokurikize ivyagezwe vyanje n’ivyo nihanikirije ku misi mikuru nategetse, kandi baze beze Isabato yanje.
Umuherezi ntaze yihumanishe kwegera ikiziga. Ariko nimba uwapfuye ari se, nyina canke uwo bavukana, aho arashobora kumwegera.
Inyuma yo kwiyeza, azorindire imisi indwi.
Umusi azokwinjira mu rugo rwo haruguru gukora ibikorwa vy’ahera ho mu rusengero, aze yitangire ikimazi, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Ni jewe nzoba umugabane wabo. Ntimuzobahe amatongo muri Isirayeli; ni jewe nzoba umugabane wabo.
Bazorya ku mashikanwa y’ifu, ibimazi vy’ivyaha n’ivy’indishi; kandi ivyeguriwe Uhoraho vyose muri Isirayeli bizoba ivyabo.
Ivyeze imbere y’ibindi vyose n’amashikanwa mushikanira Uhoraho , bizoba ivy’abaherezi. Muzobahe umugabane wa mbere w’ivyo mwimbuye, kugira ngo umugisha ube ku ngo zanyu.
Umuherezi ntihazogire ikintu na kimwe arya yaba inyoni canke ikindi asanze capfuye canke cishwe n’inyamaswa.

Nimwagabura amatongo nk’ishamvu zanyu, muzokureko aho mwegurira Uhoraho . Hazobe ari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu vy’uburebure n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi mirongo ibiri vy’ubwaguke. Aho hose hazobe ahejejwe.

Kuri aho hantu, muzopime ahangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko amajana atanu kuri izo nyene, impande zose zize zingane, hazobe ah’urusengero. Ingoro izokikuzwe n’ahatubatse hafise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu z’ubwaguke.
Ico kibanza cejejwe, muzopime ahangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu vy’uburebure, ku ngero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi icumi vy’ubwaguke ahazoba ikibanza cejejwe cane.

Ni ho hazoba umugabane wera w’abaherezi, bakorera mu Ngoro yanje, kandi begera ngo bakorere imbere yanje. Ni ahantu bashobora kwubakamwo amazu yabo, hakongera kandi hakaba ikibanza cejejwe c’Ingoro yanje.
Ikindi gice kingana ukwo nyene kizohabwe Abalewi bakora mu Ngoro, habe inyegu yabo, abe ari ho bubaka ibisagara vyabo.
I ruhande y’umugabane wanje wera, hazobe ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bitanu vy’uburebure n’ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu vy’ubwaguke. Aho hazoba ari ah’uwo ari we wese w’Umwisirayeli.

Umuganwa azohabwe umugabane ku mpande zose z’aho hantu hanje hera, no ku mpande z’igisagara, mu ruhande rwo mu burengero baja mu burengero, no ku ruhande rwo mu buseruko uja mu buseruko, uburebure bwaho burehe n’ubw’umugabane umwe, uhereye mu ruhande rwo mu burengero uja mu buseruko.
Uwo mugabane uzobe umugabane wiwe muri Isirayeli. Gutyo abami banje ntibazosubira kurenganya ubwoko bwanje, bazogaburira igihugu Abisirayeli, bakurikije uko imiryango yabo iri.

Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Birahagije, yemwe bami ba Isirayeli! Nimureke akarenganyo n’agacinyizo, mukore ibitunganye n’ibigororotse. Nimureke kwambura abantu banje, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Mukoreshe iminzane itunganye n’ingero efa na batu zitunganye.
Ingero yitwa homeru izobe ari yo ngero mufatirako mu gupima. Ingero efa na batu zizobe zingana. Efa ibe ic’icumi c’ingero homeru, na batu nyene ibe ic’icumi ca homeru.
Ingero shekeli izobe ingana n’ingero gera mirongo ibiri. Shekeli mirongo ibiri ushizeko shekeli mirongo ibiri na zitanu, ugashirako shekeli cumi na zitanu bingana ingero mina imwe.
Iri ni ryo shikanwa muzoshikana: ku ngero homeru imwe y’ingano, muzokureko ica gatandatu c’ingero efa imwe, no kuri homeru imwe ya sayiri na ho nyene muzokureko ica gatandatu ca efa imwe.

Icashinzwe cerekeye amavuta ya Elayo apimishijwe ingero batu, ni ic’icumi ca batu mukuye ku ngero koru imwe yose. Iyo na yo ingana n’ic’icumi c’ingero batu canke homeru imwe, kuko ingero batu icumi zingana na homeru imwe.

Kandi intama imwe ni yo ikwiye gutoranywa mu zindi amajana abiri zo mu buragiro butotahaye bwa Isirayeli. Ivyo ni vyo bizokoreshwa mu gushikana ibimazi vy’ifu n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa, ivy’amashimwe hamwe n’ivy’impongano, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Abanyagihugu bose bazotange ayo mashikanwa adasanzwe, ashikanirwe umwami wa Isirayeli.

Umwami ni we azotanga ibikenewe vyose bijanye n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa, ivy’ifu, n’ivy’ibinyobwa, mu misi mikuru y’imboneko z’ukwezi no kw’Isabato, no mu misi mikuru yose yategekanijwe mu nzu ya Isirayeli. Azotanga amashikanwa atangirwa ivyaha, amashikanwa y’ifu, amashikanwa yo guturirwa, hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ishimwe, vyo gutangira Abisirayeli.
Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: Ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere, muzofate ishuri y’inka ikiri ntoya, itagira agasembwa, yo kweza Ingoro.
Umuherezi aze yakire ku maraso y’ikimazi catangiwe ivyaha ayasige ku bishimaryango vy’Ingoro, no ku mfuruka zine z’igicaniro, no ku bikingi vy’irembo ry’urugo rw’imbere.
Muzobigenze mutyo no ku musi ugira indwi w’ukwezi bikorerwe uwacumuye atabishaka canke atabizi. Uko ni ko muzoba mutangiye impongano urusengero.
Ku musi ugira cumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa mbere, muzogire umusi mukuru wa Pasika, bizomara imisi indwi, iyo muzomara murya imikate itarimwo umwambiro.
Kuri uwo musi umwami azotange impfizi ibe ikimazi gitangiwe ivyaha, acitangire we ubwiwe, hamwe n’abo mu gihugu ciwe bose.

Ku musi wose muri iyo misi indwi y’imisi mikuru, azotange amashuri indwi n’amapfizi y’intama indwi atagira agasembwa, ashikanirwe Uhoraho nk’ibimazi bituriwe, hamwe n’impfizi y’impene y’ikimazi gitangiwe ivyaha.
Azotange ingero efa y’ishikanwa ry’ifu rijana n’ishuri yose, hamwe n’iyindi imwe ijana n’impfizi y’intama, kandi efa imwe izojane n’ingero yitwa hini y’amavuta ya elayo.

Muri iyo ndwi y’imisi mikuru, itangura ku musi w’icumi na kane w’ukwezi kw’indwi, azotange ibingana bityo ku mashikanwa atangirwa ivyaha, ku mashikanwa yo guturirwa, ku mashikanwa y’ifu, no ku mavuta ya elayo.”

“Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: ‘Irembo ry’urugo rw’imbere riraba mu buseruko rizokwugarwe mu misi itandatu y’akazi, ariko ku musi w’Isabato canke ku musi w’imboneko z’ukwezi rize ryugururwe.

Umwami aze yinjire aciye mw’ibaraza y’iryo rembo, ahagarare ku bikingi vy’irembo. Abaherezi bazoshikane amashikanwa yiwe yo guturirwa, hamwe n’ay’ishimwe. Azokubite amavi hasi mu rwinjiriro asenge, aheze asohoke, ariko umuryango ntuzokwugarwe gushika ku mugoroba.
Ku musi w’Isabato no ku mboneko z’ukwezi, abanyagihugu bose bazosengere imbere y’ Uhoraho ku rwinjiro rw’iryo rembo.
Amashikanwa yo guturirwa kw’Isabato azozanwa n’umwami azobe amasuguru y’imyagazi y’intama atandatu hamwe n’impfizi y’intama, vyose bizobe bitagira agasembwa.
Ishikanwa ry’ifu ryo gutangana n’impfizi y’intama rizobe ingero efa imwe, na yo iy’ifu ijana n’umwagazi, azotange iyingana uko ashatse, iri kumwe n’ingero hini imwe ihwana n’ingero efa imwe.
Ku musi mukuru w’imboneko z’ukwezi na ho azotange impfizi y’inka y’umukangara, imyagazi itandatu, impfizi imwe y’intama, kandi vyose bizobe ibitagira agasembwa.

Iyo mpfizi y’inka azoyitangane n’ingero efa imwe y’ishikanwa ry’ifu, umwagazi w’intama azowutangane n’ingero efa imwe y’ishikanwa ry’ifu, impfizi y’intama na yo azoyitangane n’ingero ashaka y’ishikanwa ry’ifu, kandi ingero efa yose azoyitangane n’ingero hini imwe y’amavuta ya elayo.
Umwami niyinjira azoce mw’ibaraza ryo kw’irembo, kandi abe ari ho azoca mu gusohoka.

Abantu bo muri iki gihugu nibaza imbere y’ Uhoraho ku misi mikuru itegekanijwe, uwuzokwinjirana umuryango wa ruguru aje gusenga azosohokane uwo hepfo, uwuzokwinjirira mu wo hepfo na we azosohokane mu wo haruguru. Ntihazogire uwusohoka aciye mu wo yinjiriyemwo, ahubwo azoce mu wo ku rundi ruhande birabana.
Umwami azobe ari hagati muri bo, aze yinjirane n’abandi yongere asohokane na bo.

Ku misi mikuru itegekanijwe, ishikanwa ry’ifu rizobe ingero efa imwe ijana n’impfizi y’inka, ingero efa imwe ijana n’impfizi y’intama, ariko ku yijana n’umwagazi azobikore uko ashatse, n’ingero hini imwe y’amavuta ya elayo ize ijane n’ingero efa imwe.

Umwami niyashaka gushikanira Uhoraho ishikanwa rivuye ku gushaka kwiwe, ryaba ari ishikanwa ryo guturirwa canke iry’ishimwe, aze yugururirwe irembo ry’amaja mu buseruko. Azotange ishikanwa ryiwe ryo guturirwa canke ry’ishimwe, nk’uko ahora abigenza ku musi w’Isabato. Ahejeje asohoke, hanyuma umuryango usubire wugarwe.
Ku musi muzotange umwagazi w’intama umaze umwaka umwe, utagira agasembwa nk’ikimazi co guturirwa gishikaniwe Uhoraho ; muzogitange mu gitondo.

Muzowutangane n’ishikanwa ry’ifu igitondo cose, na ryo rizoba rigizwe n’ica gatandatu c’ingero efa n’ica gatatu c’ingero hini y’amavuta ya elayo yo gutosa iyo fu. Iki ni icagezwe c’intahava ibihe vyose.
Nuko rero umwagazi, ishikanwa ry’ifu hamwe n’amavuta bizotangwe igitondo cose nk’ikimazi co guturirwa co ku musi.’
Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: ‘Umwami niyaha ingabire umuhungu wiwe mu vyo yarazwe, izobe n’iy’uruvyaro rw’uwo muhungu; izobe inyegu y’umuryango.

Ariko umwami niyaha ingabire umushumba wiwe mw’iragi ryiwe, ize yegukire uwo mushumba mu myaka azoba agikorera uwo mwami, ageze ku mwaka wo kwidegemvya, iyo ngabire izosubire ibe iy’umwami. Iragi ryiwe ni iry’abana biwe; ni iry’abaragwa biwe.
Umwami ntiyemerewe gutwara iragi ry’umuntu n’umwe, mu kubakura mw’itongo ryabo. Azohe abahungu biwe iragi kw’itongo yatoranye, kugira ngo abantu banje ntibasanzarire kure y’amatongo yabo.’ ”
Maze wa muntu arantwara ancisha mu rwinjiriro rwo ku ruhande rw’umuryango uja ku vyumba vyatoranijwe biraba mu buraruko, ari vyo vy’abaherezi, anyereka ikibanza cari mu mfuruka y’amaja mu burengero.

Arambwira ati: “Aha ni ho abaherezi bazotekera ibimazi vyo gukuraho urubanza, n’ibimazi bitangirwa ivyaha, no gukaranga amashikanwa y’ifu, mu kwanka ko bobizana mu kigo c’inyuma bikagira abantu inyegu.”
Maze aca anjana mu kigo c’inyuma, anzungurukana mu mfuruka zaco zose, maze mu mfuruka zaco zose mbonayo ikindi kigo.
Mu mfuruka zine zose hari ibindi bigo bizitiye, bifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ine z’uburebure na mirongo itatu z’ubwaguke, ivyo bigo vyose vyo mu mfuruka zine vyarangana.
Imbere mu kigo cose hari hakikujwe n’ahantu batekera ivyokurya.
Arambwira ati: “Aha ni aho bazohora batekera ibimazi vyashikanywe.”

Wa muntu ansubiza inyuma ku rwinjiriro rw’Ingoro, mbona amazi ava musi y’umuryango w’Ingoro, atemba aja mu buseruko, kuko iyo nzu yaraba mu buseruko. Ayo mazi yatemba aca musi y’uruhande rwo mu bumanuko, musi y’igicaniro.
Aca aransohokana ancishije mw’irembo ryo mu buraruko, antwara kw’irembo riraba mu buseruko. Ni ho nabona ko ayo mazi atemba aca musi y’uruhande rwo mu bumanuko.
Maze uwo muntu agenda aja mu buseruko, apimisha umugozi yari afise mu ntoke. Apima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko igihumbi z’umugende wa ya mazi amanuka. Ayancishijemwo, yagera ku jisho ry’ikirenge.
Yongera apima izindi ngero z’igice c’ukuboko igihumbi, yongera ayancishamwo, angera mu mavi. Yongera apima izindi ngero z’igice c’ukuboko igihumbi, ayancishijemwo angera mu rukenyerero.
Arasubira apima izindi ngero z’igice c’ukuboko igihumbi, amazi aca angera aho ntashobora kujabuka, kuko yari yabaye menshi, vyasaba ko noga, rwari rwabaye uruzi runini aho ata worucamwo atambuka.
Arambaza ati: “Mwana w’umuntu, mbega urabona ivyo?” Araheza ansubiza ku nkombe y’uruzi.
Ndahashitse mbona ibiti vyinshi cane ku mpande zose z’uruzi.
Arambwira ati: “Uru ruzi rutemba ruja mu ntara yo mu buseruko, rukamanuka rugashika muri Araba, aho rwisesera mu kiyaga. Nirwashika mu kiyaga, amazi yaco azoca aba meza.
Aho urwo ruzi ruzotembera hose, ibinyabuzima vyo mu mazi bizobaho. Hazoba amafi menshi, kuko aya mazi aratemba agatuma amazi arimwo umunyu acika meza; aho ruzoshika hose, ruzohazana ubuzima.

Abarovyi bazohagarara ku nkengera z’ikiyaga c’Umunyu, kandi kuva muri Eni-Gedi gushika muri Eni-Egulayimu hazobaho ibibanza vyo kwanikira insenga. Hazoba amafi y’ubwoko bwinshi nk’ayo mu kiyaga Mediterane.
Ariko imyonga n’inkengera zayo ntibizokira bizogumana umunyu.

Ibiti vy’ubwoko bwose bitanga ivyamwa bizomera ku mpande zose z’uruzi. Amababi yavyo ntazigera yuma, kandi ntibizigera bireka kwama. Amezi yose bizokwama vyamye, kuko amazi azova mu Ngoro ibihe vyose abitemberamwo. Ivyamwa vyavyo bizoba ivyokurya, amababi yavyo na yo avure ingwara.”
“Uku ni ko jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji mvuze: ‘Izi ni zo zizoba imbibe zerekana igihugu uzogaburira imiryango cumi n’ibiri ya Isirayeli nk’iragi ryabo harimwo n’imigabane ibiri ya Yosefu ingene kingana.
Uzokibagaburira ku rugezo rungana. Kuko narahiye manitse ukuboko ko nzogiha ba sekuruza, kikazoba iragi ryabo.
Imbibe z’ico gihugu zizobe izi: Mu buraruko urubibe ruzove ku kiyaga Kinini kw’ibarabara rya Hetiloni rurengane Lebo-Hamati gushika i Sedadi,
ruce i Berota n’i Sibirayimu, biri hagati y’urubibe rwa Damasiko na Hamati, rushike i Hezeri-Hatikoni, hari ku rubibe rwa Hawurani.
Urwo rubibe ruzova ku kiyaga rugende gushika i Hazari-Enoni, ruce ruguru y’urubibe rwa Damasiko, hamwe n’urubibe rwa Hamati mu buraruko. Urwo ni rwo ruzoba urubibe rwo mu buraruko.

Mu buseruko urubibe ruzoca hagati ya Hawurani na Damasiko rujane Yorodani hagati ya Gileyadi na Isirayeli, gushika ku kiyaga co mu buseruko, no gushika i Tamari. Uru ni rwo ruzoba urubibe rwo mu buseruko.
Mu bumanuko ruzova i Tamari, rushike ku mazi y’i Meriba Kadeshi, ruheze ruce ku kagezi ka Egiputa, rushike ku Kiyaga Kinini. Urwo ni rwo rubibe rwo mu bumanuko.
Mu burengero, ikiyaga kinini ni co kizoba urubibe aharabana n’i Lebo-Hamati. Urwo ni rwo rubibe rwo mu burengero.
Uzogabure iki gihugu uko imiryango ya Isirayeli ingana.
Muzokigabure nk’iragi ryanyu mwe n’abanyamahanga baba muri mwebwe, bahavyariye abana, na bo nyene muzobafate nk’Abisirayeli ba kavukire. Bazohabwe iragi mu miryango y’Abisirayeli.
Mu miryango abanyamahanga bazoba babamwo azobe ari yo batoranamwo iragi, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.’ ”

“Iyi ni yo miryango ya Isirayeli, uko amazina yabo ari: Dani azohabwa intara imwe, izoba mu buraruko. Urubibe rwayo ruzoba ibarabara rya Hetiloni, rugenda rugashika i Hamati, rukabandanya gushika i Hazari-Enani no ku rubibe rwa Damasiko rwo mu buraruko, hafi ya Hamati. Intara ya Dani izova ku ruhande rwo mu buseruko ishike mu burengero bw’igihugu ca Isirayeli.
Asheri azoronka intara imwe, ihana urubibe n’iya Dani, ive mu buseruko ishike mu burengero.
Nafutali azohabwa intara imwe, ihana urubibe n’iya Asheri, ive mu buseruko igere mu burengero.
Manase azohabwa intara imwe, ihana urubibe n’iya Nafutali, ive mu buseruko igere mu burengero.
Efurayimu azoronka intara imwe, ihana urubibe n’iya Manase, ive mu buseruko igere mu burengero.
Reyubeni azohabwa intara imwe, ihana urubibe n’iya Efurayimu, ive mu buseruko igere mu burengero.
Yuda azoronka intara imwe, ihana urubibe n’iya Reyubeni, ive mu buseruko igere mu burengero.

Ahahana urubibe n’intara ya Yuda, hazoba ari ahantu hateguriwe igikorwa kidasanzwe. Hazoba hangana ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu vy’uburebure, ubwaguke bwaho na bwo buzova ku rubibe rwa Isirayeli mu buseruko, rushike mu burengero nk’uko intara z’imiryango zimeze. Ingoro yanje izoba hagati muri ico kibanza.
Umugabane wera muzoha Uhoraho uzoba ufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu z’uburebure hamwe n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko igihumbi z’ubwaguke.

Umugabane wera muzoha abaherezi uzogira uburebure bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu z’uburebure n’ibihumbi icumi vy’ubwaguke ku ruhande rwo mu burengero. Ingoro y’ Uhoraho izoba hagati na hagati muri wo.
Uwo uzoba uw’abaherezi bejejwe, bakomoka kuri Sadoki, bankoreye mu bwizigirwa, batantaye nk’Abalewi igihe Abisirayeli banta.
Uzobe umugabane wabo udasanzwe, ukuwe ku mugabane wejejwe wo muri ico gihugu, umugabane wera cane, uhana urubibe n’intara y’Abalewi.
Abalewi bazohabwa intara ihana urubibe n’umugabane w’abaherezi, hazoba hangana ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu z’uburebure n’ibihumbi icumi vy’ubwaguke.
Ntibazohagurishe canke ngo bagire ico bahakaba. Ntihazohabwe abandi kuko ari isi nziza cane, kandi hakaba herejwe Uhoraho .

Ahasigaye hangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bitanu z’uburebure, n’ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu vy’ubwaguke hazohabwa Abisirayeli, bahubake amazu hongere habe uburagiro, igisagara kibe hagati.
Ico gisagara kizoba gipima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bine n’amajana atanu ku ruhande rwose.
Uburagiro buzogire ingero z’igice c’ukuboko amajana abiri na mirongo itanu ku mpande zine zabwo.

Ahasigaye, hahana urubibe n’umugabane wera, hazoba hafise uburebure bungana n’ubw’uwo mugabane wera, hazoba hafise uburebure bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi icumi n’ubwaguke bw’ibihumbi icumi nyene. Indimiro zaho zizovamwo ivyokurya vy’abakora mu gisagara.
Abazoba bakora mu gisagara barima izo ndimiro, bazoba bava mu miryango yose ya Isirayeli.
Uwo mugabane wera wose uzoba ufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu uruhande rwose. Muzowutoranye nk’ingabire idasanzwe, hamwe n’ahubatse igisagara.

Ahasigaye ku mpande zompi z’umugabane wera n’igisagara, hazobe ah’umwami. Hazongana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na zitanu kuva ku mugabane wera uja mu buseruko, n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na zitanu kuva ku mugabane wera uja mu burengero. Iyo migabane yose uko ari ibiri, izoba ihana urubibe rurerure n’imigabane yahawe imiryango, izoba iy’umwami; kandi umugabane wera hamwe n’urusengero bizoba hagati na hagati y’aho.
Nuko rero umugabane w’Abalewi uzoba ugizwe n’ahantu hose hari hagati y’intara ya Yuda n’intara ya Benyamini, ukuyemwo ahatoranirijwe kuba umugabane wera n’igisagara.
Ku miryango isigaye: Benyamini azohabwa intara imwe, izova mu buseruko ishike mu burengero.
Simeyoni azohabwa intara imwe, izoba ihana urubibe n’iya Benyamini, ikava mu buseruko igashika mu burengero.
Isakari azohabwa intara imwe, izoba ihana urubibe n’iya Simeyoni, izova mu buseruko ishike mu burengero.
Zebuloni azohabwa intara imwe, izoba ihana urubibe n’iya Isakari, kandi izova mu buseruko ishike mu burengero.
Gadi azohabwa intara imwe, izoba ihana urubibe n’iya Zebuloni, izova mu buseruko ishike mu burengero.
Urubibe rwo mu bumanuko bw’intara ya Gadi ruzova i Tamari rushike mu mazi y’i Meriba Kadeshi, rugere no ku kagezi ka Egiputa, rushike no ku Kiyaga Mediterane.
Ng’uko uko muzogabura igihugu, kikaba ishamvu ry’Abisirayeli, izo zikaba intara zabo, ni jewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji ndabivuze.
Aya azobe ari yo marembo asohoka ava mu gisagara: Uhereye ku ruhande rwo mu buraruko, rufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bine n’amajana atanu z’uburebure,
hazoba amarembo atatu rimwe ryose rigire izina ry’umuryango umwe wa Isirayeli. Irya mbere rizokwitwe irembo rya Reyubeni, irya kabiri ryitwe irembo rya Yuda, irya gatatu ryitwe irembo rya Lewi.
Ku ruhande rwo mu buseruko; na ho nyene rufise uburebure bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bine n’amajana atanu, hazoba amarembo atatu: Irembo rya Yosefu, irembo rya Benyamini n’irembo rya Dani.
Ku ruhande rwo mu bumanuko, na ho nyene rufise uburebure bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bine n’amajana atanu, hazoba amarembo atatu: irembo rya Simeyoni, irembo rya Isakari, n’irya Zebuloni.
Ku ruhande rwo mu burengero, na ho nyene rufise uburebure bw’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi bine n’amajana atanu, hazoba amarembo atatu: irembo rya Gadi, irembo rya Asheri n’irembo rya Nafutali.
Inkikuro y’ico gisagara izobe ingero z’igice c’ukuboko ibihumbi icumi n’umunani. Kandi kuva ico gihe, izina ry’ico gisagara rizobe iri: Uhoraho ni ho ari.”
